cards.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: elementalist, focus, mastery. For 3 rounds, Fire, Cold and Lightning Mage spells all count as matching your current Focus for Nuke Chain eligibility. After you complete one three-distinct-name chain during this duration, you may choose any one of the three Focus finishers when it becomes primed, regardless of your current Focus. Only one finisher may be generated by this use. After that finisher resolves or expires, the mastery continues defensively but cannot prime another off-focus finisher.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Temporarily gain mastery over all elements, allowing you to use any elemental finisher regardless of your focus.

cards.name: Undying Spellform
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Undying Spellform. Tags: lich, undead, death. When damage reduces you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain conscious and able to take Actions until the end of your next regular turn. You remain at 0 HP, cannot benefit from voluntary movement faster than half Speed, and still suffer ordinary consequences of further damage. If still at 0 HP when the effect ends, become unconscious and suffer one failed death save. Healing above 0 ends this feature early.

source.originalText: Undying Spellform: When reduced to 0 HP, continue casting for 1 full round before death.

cards.name: Soul Reservoir
cards.frequency: At most once per turn and at most S times per encounter
cards.effect: Soul Reservoir. Tags: lich, resonance, damage-over-time. During a real encounter, when a hostile creature takes damage from a damage-over-time effect created by one of your Mage spells, restore 1 RP, never above maximum. The same damage event cannot restore more than 1 RP. Damage to allies, summons, trivial creatures or your own companions does not qualify.

source.originalText: Soul Reservoir: All DoT damage you deal feeds Resonance recovery.

cards.name: Necromantic Mastery
cards.effect: Necromantic Mastery. Tags: lich, necromancy. Once on each of your turns when a Mage spell deals necrotic damage, add S necrotic damage to one damaged target. Your necrotic Mage spells also ignore resistance to necrotic damage; immunity remains immunity. This feature does not convert another spell's damage type and cannot apply to companion attacks unless a card explicitly identifies them as your spell.

source.originalText: Necromantic Mastery: Gain access to enhanced necromancy spells and abilities.

cards.name: Undead Immunities
cards.effect: Undead Immunities. Tags: lich, undead. You are immune to poison damage, the Poisoned condition, disease, Frightened, Charmed and magical sleep. You no longer need to breathe. You still require the normal rest schedule for mechanical recovery and can still be affected by abilities that specifically target undead unless another feature says otherwise.

source.originalText: Undead Immunities: Become immune to poison, disease, fear, sleep, and mind control.

cards.name: Lingering Malice
cards.effect: Lingering Malice. Tags: mage-spell, lich, necrotic, zone, concentration. Choose Fear or Drain when cast. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, enemies in the zone make Wisdom saves. Failure takes S d6 necrotic. Fear mode also Frightens until the start of your next turn. Drain mode lets you gain temporary HP equal to M once per pulse if at least one enemy fails. Maximum 3 pulses; each pulse grants a new save.

source.originalText: Lingering Malice: Create a necrotic zone for 3 rounds that applies Fear or Drain effects.

cards.name: Resonance to Flesh
cards.effect: Resonance to Flesh. Tags: lich, resonance, blood. Choose one direction. RP to Flesh: spend 1-5 RP and regain 2 HP per RP spent. Flesh to RP: lose 2-10 HP in even increments and restore 1 RP per 2 HP lost. HP loss cannot be reduced, redirected or transferred and cannot reduce you below 1 HP. RP cannot exceed maximum. This feature cannot be repeated through Echoes or companions.

source.originalText: Resonance to Flesh: Convert Resonance into HP (or vice versa) once per rest.

cards.name: Flesh to Ash
cards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius sphere centered at a point within 60 feet
cards.effect: Flesh to Ash. Tags: mage-spell, lich, necrotic, damage. Creatures of your choice in the area make Constitution saves. A target at half maximum HP or more takes S d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. A target below half maximum HP instead takes 2 S d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. Determine the threshold before rolling damage.

source.originalText: Flesh to Ash: Create an AoE burst that doubles damage if target is below 50% HP.

cards.name: Corpse Gateway
cards.rangeAndTarget: One visible corpse within 60 feet and one unoccupied space within 5 feet of it
cards.effect: Corpse Gateway. Tags: mage-spell, lich, teleportation, corpse. Teleport to the chosen unoccupied space adjacent to a visible corpse. The corpse is not consumed or altered. Summoned-companion remains, repeated fragments of the same destroyed creature and illusory corpses are not legal anchors. This non-elemental spell clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Corpse Gateway: Teleport to a corpse within line of sight.

cards.name: Soulbound Ritual
cards.rangeAndTarget: One of your destroyed bound elite undead companions within 30 feet or its inert binding token
cards.effect: Soulbound Ritual. Tags: mage-spell, lich, companion, resurrection. Return one destroyed Boneflayer, Dreadblade or Wraithbound to an unoccupied space within 30 feet at half its maximum HP. It gains S+M temporary HP for 1 minute. The returned companion remains subject to the shared Companion Command limit and cannot create a corpse, XP, loot or resource event if destroyed again.

source.originalText: Soulbound Ritual: Revive a fallen undead pet with bonus stats.

cards.name: Resonance Apex — NEW Playtest Capstone
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
cards.effect: Before paying for one Mage spell, reduce that spell's printed RP cost by up to 10 RP, minimum final cost 0. This capstone is new playtest design and is not claimed as a recovered historical feature. The cast cannot also use Resonance Surge or generic Overcast. It remains one spell cast, follows ordinary Focus/Nuke Chain rules, and alters Dissonance only through rules that would already apply to that cast.

completeEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; editorial review applied; human table balance testing required

completeEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: The first replay of a newly Mirrorbound Echo ignores Refrain Dissonance; repeating the same stored Echo builds Refrain normally.
engine: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

Standard acquisition applies; baseline Mirrorbind, Echo Release and summon procedure become usable by selecting their cards. Echo Channeling and Mirrorcall are upgrades, not duplicate mandatory unlocks. The contradiction between source initial 3 slots and Expansion I 2→3 is reconciled as an archive-safety upgrade below. Perfect Reflection automatic 9, Hero choice 10, corresponding Final 20. The finale does not override copy eligibility or the shared release cap.
workedExample: Mirrorsage 5, INT 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3, RP 9, three slots; know Mirrorbind, Echo Release, Mirror Beast Summon, Reflective Shield at 1, Beast Instinct and Reflective Pulse at 2; Mimicry Focus and Reflective Analysis at 3. Begin with Focus 1.
Turn 1: witness an eligible serpent's rank 1 poison cone, then Mirrorbind on your turn. It fails WIS save; store Burst/poison/rank 1. RP stays 9; one encounter capture spent.

Turn 2: Echo Release is Action and 2 RP, RP 9→7; empty the stored slot. Up to 3 enemies roll DEX against 14 for 2d6 poison, half on success. First release ignores Refrain but still adds 1 base Dissonance.
Turn 3: without another stored Echo you cannot simply release again. Use a weapon or ordinary legal spell. A short rest restores RP but not the consumed record.

Alternative turn 2: summon Mirror Beast for 2 RP, leaving RP 7 and the Echo stored. On turn 3 use Action Echo Release plus Bonus Action command to originate it from the Beast, pay 2 RP, ending 5; the Beast cannot also attack that round.
A failed Mirrorbind capture still expends its encounter attempt. Beast Instinct's limited retry may help if known; a boss excluded by eligibility cannot be made eligible with a high roll.
balanceQuestions: Is the initial capture dependency enjoyable with an empty archive?
Are bounded profiles diverse enough without importing boss actions?
Does the shared release/companion budget keep fusions and clones manageable?

cards.name: Echo Channeling
cards.effect: After releasing an Echo, add M to one target's damage or healing. No modifier to resource effects; this upgrade does not grant another release or repeat the source's rider.

source.originalText: Echo Channeling: Cast a stored Echo ability. Consumes a slot.

cards.name: Mirrorcall
cards.effect: Beast gains+M maximum/current HP when summoned and+5 ft Speed. Echo Release or Mirror Beast Summon already provides its base procedure; this is an optional enhancement, not a second required unlock.

source.originalText: Mirrorcall: Summon a Mirror Beast that mimics one stored Echo ability.

cards.name: Echo Slot Expansion I
cards.effect: If an ordinary slot is full, replace one record while preserving its name/profile in an inert backup. Once before next long rest, after a slot empties, restore that backup without an Action. Total usable records remain at your capacity; backup cannot be cast directly or backed up again. An inert backup counts toward the absolute six-record archive ceiling. A backup cannot be created if usable records plus inert backups would exceed six.

source.originalText: Echo Slot Expansion I: Increase slots from 2 → 3.

cards.name: Reflective Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft after its first hit this round damages you
cards.effect: Deal psychic damage equal to min(M, damage actually taken). This cannot critically hit, trigger another reflection, generate resources or prevent the original damage. No effect if you take 0.

source.originalText: Reflective Pulse: First hit you take each round returns 10% damage.

cards.name: Beast Instinct
cards.rangeAndTarget: A failed Mirrorbind against eligible INT 6-or-lower source
cards.effect: Force that target to reroll its successful save; use the second result. Eligibility, line of effect and an empty slot still required. Does not create a second captured record or a new encounter attempt.

source.originalText: Beast Instinct: +10% chance to capture Echoes from INT ≤ 6 creatures.

cards.name: Mirrorbind
cards.rangeAndTarget: One eligible witnessed creature within 60 ft
cards.effect: Apply the engine's exact capture procedure: WIS save or store a bounded profile for the witnessed ability. State category/rank before save. Success prevents capture but consumes attempt; no target can be mirrored outside eligibility restrictions.

source.originalText: Mirrorbind: Attempt to capture an ability you've just witnessed, storing it in an Echo Slot if successful.

cards.name: Echo Release
cards.cost: Recorded rank RP cost; consume 1 Echo
cards.effect: Resolve the stored Strike/Burst/Mend/Ward/Hindrance profile, using current S and INT. Pay before release; empty slot even if resisted. First release ignores only Refrain addition. No original source extra actions/resources/procs.

source.originalText: Echo Release: Cast a stored Echo ability, consuming the slot.

cards.name: Mirror Beast Summon
cards.effect: Summon one standard Mirror Beast; replaces any prior Beast/Reflective Companion. Choose appearance of a stored source. It attacks only on Bonus Action command or originates your paid release with Action+command, never both. No copied anatomy, regeneration or immortality.

source.originalText: Mirror Beast Summon: Call forth a Mirror Beast that can use one of your stored Echo abilities.

cards.name: Charm Creature
cards.rangeAndTarget: One eligible INT 6-or-lower creature within 30 ft
cards.effect: WIS save or become Reflective Companion under engine restrictions. It repeats save at turn end and when harmed by your side. Replaces Mirror Beast; on end original disposition returns. Requires no suicidal orders; cannot force beliefs or permanently enslave.

source.originalText: Charm Creature: Attempt to temporarily charm a low-intelligence creature to fight alongside you.

cards.name: Reflective Shield
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self when hit by an attack from within 60 ft
cards.effect: Gain+2 AC against triggering attack, potentially making it miss. If it misses, attacker takes M force damage. This is bounded retaliation, not copying the original attack; cannot trigger another reflection or capture.

source.originalText: Reflective Shield: Create a brief defensive barrier that has a chance to reflect the next attack back at the attacker.

cards.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
cards.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

source.originalText: Advanced Mirrorcall: Mirror Beast can now shift once per fight into a new form based on a second Echo.

cards.name: Echo Slot Expansion II
cards.effect: Ordinary Echo storage capacity becomes 5, replacing 3. Restricted extra slots still obey total 6. New slots are empty; the feature creates no Echo records or spell access.

source.originalText: Echo Slot Expansion II: Max Echo Slots: 5

cards.name: Dual Echo Cast
cards.cost: RP for each of 2 Echoes; consume both
cards.effect: Release two records captured from different creatures as ONE combined release. Each deals/heals half its profile's rolled amount, round once per component. At most one Hindrance rider; no duplicated resources or additional release this round.

source.originalText: Dual Echo Cast: Spend 2 Echoes in one turn; must be from different creatures.

cards.name: Mimicry Focus
cards.effect: At genuine encounter start gain 1 Focus Point, cap 1; any previous point is replaced. Spend on Focus Channel or pay 1 Focus during a release to add 1d6 to one damage/healing target. No point generation from staged combat.

source.originalText: Mimicry Focus: Gain +1 Focus Point per battle. Can spend Focus to empower Echoes (double duration/damage).

cards.name: Mirror Shell
cards.rangeAndTarget: A hostile spell targeting only you within 60 ft
cards.effect: After a successful save against the spell or after its spell attack misses, choose its caster; it makes WIS save or takes S d8 force. Original damage/control follow normal results. No copying arbitrary spell text or redirecting an area spell.

source.originalText: Mirror Shell: Once per long rest, reflect the first ability cast at you.

cards.name: Perfect Reflection
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature within 60 ft whose observed ability targets you
cards.effect: Reduce triggering damage to you by(S+1)d8+M, minimum 0. If any is prevented, source makes WIS save or takes that prevented amount as force, maximum 30. This is your release action for the round; no reflected conditions or legendary powers. Cannot recursively reflect.

source.originalText: Capstone – Perfect Reflection: Reflect any observed ability (spell, breath, strike) back at the caster for full effect (1/day).

cards.name: Echo Fusion
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 profile targets within 30 ft
cards.effect: Choose two stored profiles. Resolve one at full dice and the other at half dice to one target each. Only one may be healing; at most one Hindrance rider. Counts as one combined release and cannot receive Dual Echo Cast simultaneously.

source.originalText: Echo Fusion: Temporarily combine two stored Echoes to create a hybrid ability with properties of both.

cards.name: Mirror Shift
cards.effect: Switch its appearance to a stored source and choose swim 30 ft or climb 30 ft until next shift. Restore no HP or attacks; no flight, incorporeality or copied creature special actions. Does not release or consume the Echo.

source.originalText: Mirror Shift: Command your Mirror Beast to change form, adopting a different stored Echo ability.

cards.name: Focus Channel
cards.effect: Next Echo release adds 1d6 to one damage/healing amount OR adds 30 ft range, chosen now. Cannot multiply duration, bypass concentration, add targets or override release caps. If no release occurs this turn the point remains spent.

source.originalText: Focus Channel: Spend a Focus Point to significantly enhance your next Echo cast or Mirror Beast ability.

cards.name: Reflective Analysis
cards.effect: Learn whether it is capture-eligible and one visible ability's bounded profile/rank before attempting. The next Mirrorbind save it makes against you has-1. Nonstacking; does not reveal private thoughts or permit boss copying.

source.originalText: Reflective Analysis: Study a creature to gain insight into its abilities and weaknesses, increasing your chance to successfully bind its Echoes.

cards.name: Mirror Dimension
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft; up to 3 enemies
cards.effect: On entry activation and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action maintenance, selected enemies make WIS save; failure gives disadvantage on next attack before your next turn. Inside, your Mirrorbind range extends 30 ft. No additional capture attempts/releases or pocket escape route.

source.originalText: Mirror Dimension: Create a small pocket dimension of reflective surfaces that confuses enemies and enhances your mimicry abilities.

cards.name: Blessed Copy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Second living ally within 15 ft of original Mend/Ward target
cards.effect: When releasing Mend or Ward, pay 1 extra RP to give a second ally half the rolled amount, rounded once. This is within the same release, no new source or healing proc. No duplication of concentration or resources.

source.originalText: Blessed Copy: Echoed heals or buffs also affect a second ally.

cards.name: Luminant Bond
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies/enemies within 10 ft of your Beast/Companion
cards.effect: Allies gain+1 to WIS saves. Invisible enemies in aura shed faint outlines and cannot gain advantage solely from invisibility, but concealment/cover still apply. This grants neither full True Sight nor targeting through walls.

source.originalText: Luminant Bond: Charmed/Beast emits aura that reveals invisible and grants +5% saves.

cards.name: Sacred Echo Slot
cards.effect: Add one slot usable only for Mend or Ward, total storage cap 6. If already at 6, designate one existing slot sacred instead; once/short rest its release costs 1 less RP, minimum 1. No duplicate slot or free record.

source.originalText: Sacred Echo Slot: +1 additional slot for healing/support abilities.

cards.name: Radiant Archive
cards.cost: RP for 3 support Echoes; consume all 3; 1 long-rest use
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 legal allies within 30 ft
cards.effect: Release three stored Mend/Ward records as ONE package; assign each to one ally. No ally receives more than two components and temporary HP never stack. All costs paid; no extra release or resurrection. Missing records cannot be invented.

source.originalText: Final – Radiant Archive: Cast 3 stored divine Echoes at once (once/day).

cards.name: Divine Reflection
cards.rangeAndTarget: Willing allied caster within 30 ft just used an eligible healing/protection spell
cards.effect: Capture a Mend or Ward profile of rank at most your learnable rank into empty slot. This explicit exception permits an allied source but excludes resurrection/resource/action generation. No extra captured use for the ally and no copying a copy.

source.originalText: Divine Reflection: Capture and enhance beneficial abilities, increasing their healing or protective power.

cards.name: Radiant Mirror Beast
cards.effect: Summon radiant standard Beast. Bonus Action command chooses normal attack or healing S d4 to one living ally within 5 ft, paying 1 RP per heal. It may instead originate your paid Echo release under common limits. Cannot perform two options in one round.

source.originalText: Radiant Mirror Beast: Summon a Mirror Beast infused with divine energy, capable of healing allies and revealing hidden threats.

cards.name: Blessing Echo
cards.cost: Recorded RP cost+1; consume offensive Echo
cards.effect: Convert a stored Strike/Burst record to Mend/Ward for this release, chosen on activation; heal S d6+M or grant same temporary HP. This explicit conversion cannot also deal offensive damage or copy a condition.

source.originalText: Blessing Echo: Transform a captured offensive Echo into a beneficial effect that can heal or protect allies.

cards.name: Light Binding
cards.effect: Choose mode: enemies make STR save or Restrained; they repeat save at turn end. OR up to 2 allies gain S d6+M temporary HP. No mixed modes; bonds are magical and not permanent objects.

source.originalText: Light Binding: Create bonds of radiant energy that can restrain enemies or create protective barriers for allies.

cards.name: Purifying Reflection
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 30 ft failing save against Charmed/Frightened/Poisoned
cards.effect: Ally rerolls that save with advantage; use new result. If it succeeds, it regains S d6 HP. No arbitrary curse or death reversal; costs remain if it fails. This is not a captured Echo and creates no record.

source.originalText: Purifying Reflection: Reflect and purify harmful effects, potentially converting them into healing or beneficial effects.

cards.name: Mirror Double
cards.rangeAndTarget: One damage Echo you released this turn
cards.effect: Create one illusory double; it repeats half the unmodified immediate damage dice to one original enemy still within 30 ft, without roll or conditions. Declare Mirror Double before the current turn ends; its pending copy remains part of this turn’s one release package and does not consume a later release allowance. Only one pending copy; cannot copy copies/healing.

source.originalText: Mirror Double: Create a copy of yourself for 1 turn. It casts your last Echo at 50% power.

cards.name: Fused Echo
cards.effect: Increase Fusion's half-strength component to full dice. Still two sources, full RP, one combined release and normal target limits. This never adds a third component or doubles resources, control duration or already copied damage.

source.originalText: Fused Echo: Combine two Echoes to create a custom hybrid. Once per long rest.

cards.name: Floating Memory Slot
cards.effect: Capacity becomes 6 if below 6; temporary slot is erased at encounter end. If already 6, choose one existing slot instead and its release gains+5 ft range. Never exceed 6 or preserve a seventh via a backup.

source.originalText: Floating Memory Slot: Temporarily store a 6th Echo. Auto-erases after combat.

cards.name: Reflected Repertoire
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 records currently in your archive
cards.effect: Mark up to 3 distinct existing records. Each one's next release keeps its record instead of consuming it; still pay release RP and obey one release/round. No restoration of already empty slots, no invented records, no reuse-preservation after its marked use.

source.originalText: Final – Reflected Repertoire: Reset all Echo slots. Next 3 Echoes cast without consuming slots.

cards.name: Echo Manipulation
cards.duration: Next release before end next turn
cards.effect: Choose +30 ft range OR change damage to acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder. No change to category, rank, targets, save ability, copied conditions or eligibility. Nonstacking modifications; record reverts after release/expiry.

source.originalText: Echo Manipulation: Modify a stored Echo, changing its element, range, or effect.

cards.name: Mirror Image
cards.effect: Create two decoys. When an attack hits you, use Reaction to erase one and impose disadvantage on that attack's reroll. Decoys do not cast, attack, intercept area damage or create Echo records. At most one decoy erased per round.

source.originalText: Mirror Image: Create multiple illusory duplicates of yourself that can confuse enemies and potentially cast Echo abilities.

cards.name: Prismatic Reflection
cards.cost: Recorded RP cost+2; consume Strike Echo
cards.effect: Replace Strike's attack with separate spell attacks; divide its S d8 dice among targets with at least 1 die each. At S 2 only 2 targets. Total dice do not increase. One combined release; no full-damage copy per target.

source.originalText: Prismatic Reflection: Split a single-target Echo into multiple weaker versions that can affect several targets.

cards.name: Echo Preservation
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Echo you are about to release
cards.effect: Preserve that record after release instead of consuming it. Pay normal RP plus 2 and obey all limits. Does not stack with Repertoire or preserve more records in Fusion; choose one. Its next release is no longer a first replay.

source.originalText: Echo Preservation: Prevent an Echo from being consumed when cast, allowing it to be used again.

cards.name: Reality Fracture
cards.effect: While you stand inside, once/turn add 1d6 to one Echo damage/healing amount or impose-1 on one target's Echo save. Choose before resolving. No free releases, random recasts, resource refunds or extra targets.

source.originalText: Reality Fracture: Create a zone where Echo abilities are enhanced and have a chance to trigger additional effects.

cards.name: Corrupted Mirrorcall
cards.effect: Roll d2:1 Ember grants its one commanded attack+1d4 fire; 2 Barbs grants+1d4 piercing. Extra dice apply once/round only. Mutation grants no aura damage, poison supply, resource gain or separate creature.

source.originalText: Corrupted Mirrorcall: Mirror Beast gains a random mutation (e.g., Burn Aura, Bleed Burst).

cards.name: Shatterbind
cards.effect: You may change its damage type to necrotic or psychic on release. Category/eligibility/rank stay unchanged; high-INT undead and bosses remain excluded unless an encounter explicitly permits them.

source.originalText: Shatterbind: Echoes from undead/demons/aberrations gain necrotic or psychic damage tags.

cards.name: Fractured Echo
cards.effect: Create one pending half-dice repeat against one original target still within 30 ft. No conditions, procs, crits, resource changes or additional capture. Replaces any pending Mirror Double/Fractured copy. Deterministic limited use replaces the old random 25% trigger.

source.originalText: Fractured Echo: 25% chance each Echo triggers again randomly the next round.

cards.name: Fractured Dominion
cards.effect: Your first damage release on each of these 2 turns adds one half-dice component against a DIFFERENT enemy within 10 ft of an original target. Same package and shared copy cap; excludes healing/control. Never recursively copies a copy or adds a release action.

source.originalText: Final – Fractured Dominion: For 2 turns, every Echo cast also generates a Glitched Clone Echo that strikes a nearby enemy.

cards.name: Corrupt Echo
cards.effect: Add 1d6 necrotic to one target on release OR force one damaged target to make WIS save or lose Reactions until end its next turn. No double rider or additional release. Added die is excluded from later copies.

source.originalText: Corrupt Echo: Twist a captured ability into a more destructive or debilitating version.

cards.name: Shattered Mirror Beast
cards.effect: Summon standard corrupted Beast. On commanded hit add 1d6 necrotic once/round; after that hit, each other creature within 5 ft of Beast, including allies, takes 1 psychic damage. This splash has no procs and cannot trigger another splash. Normal companion cap applies.

source.originalText: Shattered Mirror Beast: Summon a corrupted Mirror Beast with unstable, mutated abilities that can harm both enemies and allies.

cards.name: Echo Leech
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after direct Echo damages a hostile creature
cards.effect: Pay 1 RP to regain HP equal to min(M, actual damage dealt to one target). Copies, Do Ts and companion attacks do not trigger it. Healing has no secondary healing/resource procs; no damage means no heal.

source.originalText: Echo Leech: Drain life force from a target when casting certain Echo abilities, healing yourself.

cards.name: Fractured Reality
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft; up to 3 enemies/pulse
cards.effect: On start and each later Bonus Action+1 RP pulse, WIS save: S d6 psychic, half on success. Failure also loses Reactions until start your next turn. At most 3 pulses. Zone is not an Echo source or resource generator.

source.originalText: Fractured Reality: Create a zone of broken reflections that confuses and damages creatures within it.

cards.name: Mind Shatter
cards.cost: 6 RP; consume 1 offensive Echo; 1 long-rest use
cards.duration: Instant; control until end next turn
cards.effect: WIS save: (S+2)d8 psychic, half on success. Failure imposes disadvantage on next attack; failure by 10 also Stunned until end its next turn within denial cap. No permanent mental illness or control of the player's beliefs.

source.originalText: Mind Shatter: Use corrupted Echo energy to attack a creature's mind, potentially causing confusion or temporary insanity.

completeEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Spend 1 Ki when using a minor Weave technique to prevent 1 Dissonance from that technique; Ki and Resonance remain separate pools.
completeEnvelope.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.35, halves upward
engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Dexterity is the Monk class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Monk levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Dexterity modifier). Monk technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier. Monk technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier.

Ki Chain is a Monk-only resource from 0 to 5. Begin each real encounter at 0 Ki and clear Ki when the encounter ends or after 1 minute without a real encounter. Ki cannot be generated by sparring with willing creatures, attacking objects, repeatedly dodging harmless attacks, healing between encounters or other staged actions. Ki is separate from Resonance Points and Dissonance.

Normal Ki generation is capped at 2 Ki during your own regular turn and 1 Ki total from reactions or defensive events between the end of one regular turn and the start of your next. Explicit spending has no per-turn cap other than available Ki. A feature cannot raise Ki above 5. Incapacitation or Stunned resets Ki to 0; ordinary damage does not.

All Monks automatically know Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Stances at level 1. Only one core stance can be active at a time. While unarmored and not using a shield, you may switch to one known core stance on your own turn without an Action, at most once per round. The stance remains until changed, incapacitated or the encounter ends. The optional Stance Shift feature improves when that same once-per-round switch may occur; it does not create a second switch.

Unarmored Flow is automatic class identity rather than a selectable card. Wearing armor or using a shield suppresses the mechanical benefits printed on Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Stances, Unarmored Speed, Perfect Balance and Tortoise Discipline features unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Ki Chain itself and Monk techniques remain usable unless their card requires being unarmored.

Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Ki generation obey the global Ki-gain ceilings. Tiger can generate Ki from critical unarmed strikes. Tortoise can generate Ki from specified defensive successes. Crane provides mobility and support but does not create free out-of-combat healing. A single event can satisfy more than one generator, but total gain still cannot exceed the appropriate own-turn or off-turn ceiling.

MINOR WEAVE INTERFACE. Cards tagged weave are magical Monk techniques. If a tagged technique would add at least 1 Dissonance under the broader Weave rules, after validating all ordinary costs but before resolution you may spend 1 additional Ki to prevent that 1 Dissonance. This prevention Ki is separate from the card's printed Ki and RP costs. It cannot prevent more than 1 Dissonance from one technique and cannot reduce Dissonance already present.

All printed RP costs use the character's existing Resonance Point pool where applicable; Monk cards create no second RP pool. Ki never converts to RP unless a card explicitly says so. Generic spell-slot mechanics do not apply. Monk techniques are not ordinary spells unless their card expressly says otherwise.

STUN GUARD. A creature can be Stunned by your Monk features at most once per encounter. Mark it after the first Monk-caused Stunned condition successfully applies. If another of your Monk features would Stun that marked creature later in the same encounter, the creature still makes the required save; on failure it instead loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This guard is tracked separately for each Monk.

Temporary maximum-HP reductions caused by Monk features do not stack on the same creature; use the largest reduction from your Monk features. Maximum HP cannot be reduced below 1. Unless a card specifies an earlier end, the reduction lasts until the creature completes a short or long rest. Restoring maximum HP does not restore current HP. These effects are temporary combat trauma, not unstated permanent injuries.

Only one concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; any required half-damage rounding is down for this pilot. Round recharge ticks once at the start of the Monk's regular initiative turn, including while incapacitated; extra Actions and extra turns never create additional ticks.

All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. A named ability can receive at most one positive-counter recharge reset or shortening per round. Only an ability whose current recharge counter is above 0 can be reset or shortened.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION. Monk 1 automatically gains Ki Flow, Unarmored Flow, all three core Stances and basic once-per-round stance switching, then chooses 4 Base cards, at least 2 Active. Monk 2 chooses 2 additional Base cards. Monk 3 enters Master and chooses 2 Arch cards, at least 1 Active. Levels 4 through 8 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Level 9 grants one eligible Arch choice and Martial Apex automatically.

Discipline Initiate is an optional Base selection. Choosing Tank does not grant five free Base abilities: it unlocks the four non-final Tortoise Discipline cards as additional Arch-selection options at their listed Monk levels. Final Form — Bastion of Breath is never a normal selection; at Monk 9 or the first later level when eligible it is gained automatically only if you chose Tank through Discipline Initiate and know at least three of Stone Shell Discipline, Redirecting Palm, Iron Shell Pulse and Echoing Guard. Tortoise Discipline remains compatible with any Hero path chosen later.

At Monk 10 choose Enlightened Master, Iron Fist Master or Way of Shadow and choose 2 cards from that Hero path. Levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 each grant one eligible unselected Base/Arch card, including unlocked non-final Tortoise cards. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one Hero-path choice. At Monk 20 the chosen Hero path's Final is automatic and cannot be selected earlier. ASI/feat milestones remain separate.

All acquisition and scaling gates use Monk class level, not total character level. Normal character proficiency bonus still uses the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. A multiclass dip cannot unlock Master, Tortoise Final Form, Hero features or a level-20 Final.

Healing from Monk cards cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless explicitly stated. Permanent HP recovery and Ki generation cannot be farmed outside encounters. Resurrection effects are explicitly limited-use. No Monk card can instantly kill a target merely because a descriptive source used language such as Death Touch; death continues to follow the game's ordinary damage and dying rules.

Unarmored Flow completion: while wearing no armor or shield, AC=10+DEX modifier+WIS modifier, or ordinary armorless AC if higher, never both. Unarmed strikes use DEX for attack/damage and 1d6 at 1, 1d8 at 5, 1d10 at 11, 1d12 at 17. This is a new numeric completion; no automatic Extra Attack beyond printed techniques.

Each technique tagged weave creates 1 D in this pilot, unless it explicitly says otherwise. Ki can prevent up to 1 D before resolution only if remaining Ki pays that additional cost. Full-Ki capstones may legally accept D. The Stun Guard shares the suite-wide once/character/target hard-denial mark; its later failed-save fallback of reaction loss is an explicit Monk exception, not a second Stun.
workedExample: Monk 5 example: Dexterity 16 gives M=3, PB=3 and S=2. The Monk is unarmored, starts a real encounter in Tiger Stance with Ki 0, knows Flowing Form, Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Focused Ki Burst, and begins with Dissonance 2 and 6 RP.

Turn 1: move at least 10 feet and use Flurry of Blows. Both unarmed strikes hit. Flurry grants 1 Ki from its first successful hit and Flowing Form grants 1 Ki for the move-plus-strike sequence, reaching the own-turn gain ceiling: Ki 0→2. A Tiger critical could not raise this turn above 2.

Turn 2: spend 1 Ki on Patient Defense, Ki 2→1. Before the next turn an enemy attacks and misses; Patient Defense grants 1 off-turn Ki, Ki 1→2. Even if another enemy also missed during that interval, the off-turn defensive gain ceiling prevents another Ki gain.

Turn 3: Flurry of Blows again. One strike critically hits in Tiger Stance. Tiger grants 1 Ki and Flowing Form grants 1 Ki, so Ki 2→4. Flurry cannot add a third point because the own-turn gain ceiling is 2.

Turn 4: use Focused Ki Burst, paying its printed 2 Ki and 2 RP, Ki 4→2 and RP 6→4. Because it is tagged weave and would add 1 Dissonance in this example, spend 1 additional Ki to prevent that Dissonance, Ki 2→1. The burst then resolves normally; the prevention payment does not alter RP.

Turn 5: switch from Tiger to Crane using the automatic once-per-round stance switch, then use Breath of Focus instead of attacking. Breath grants 1 Ki during a real encounter, Ki 1→2. No out-of-combat repetition could generate this Ki, and changing stance itself generates none.
balanceQuestions: Does the 2-Ki own-turn and 1-Ki off-turn generation ceiling preserve a satisfying martial flow while preventing Flurry, Tiger criticals, Flowing Form and Tortoise reactions from filling the entire 0-5 chain immediately?
Does the gated Tortoise Discipline provide a meaningful off-tank identity without becoming strictly better than ordinary Arch selections or forcing Tank-discipline Monks into a specific Hero path?

Are healing, Stunned effects, temporary maximum-HP reduction and high-level multi-strike techniques sufficiently bounded across repeated encounters without erasing the tactical differences among Enlightened Master, Iron Fist Master and Way of Shadow?

cards.name: Tiger Stance (Offense)
cards.effect: Tiger Stance. Tags: stance, offense. While unarmored, your unarmed strikes score a critical hit on a natural 19 or 20. Once on each of your turns when an unarmed strike critically hits, gain 1 Ki subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Once on each of your turns after an unarmed strike hits, add S damage of the strike's normal damage type to that hit.

source.originalText: Tiger Stance (Offense): +15% attack speed, +10% crit chance on unarmed strikes. Gain Ki Chain on crits.

cards.name: Tortoise Stance (Off-Tank)
cards.effect: Tortoise Stance. Tags: stance, defense. While unarmored, reduce the first damage you take each round by PB, minimum 0. Enemies within 10 feet take -1 on attack rolls against your allies other than you. Once per round when an attack misses you, or Deflect Missile reduces a ranged attack to 0 damage, gain 1 Ki subject to the off-turn gain ceiling.

source.originalText: Tortoise Stance (Off-Tank): +20% DR, soft taunt aura (enemies within 2 tiles targeting allies get -20% accuracy). Blocks/dodges grant Ki Chain.

cards.name: Crane Stance (Support)
cards.cost: 0 for stance; healing costs 1 Ki and 1 RP
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 15 feet for healing rider
cards.effect: Crane Stance. Tags: stance, support. While unarmored, whenever you move at least 15 feet on your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. HP healing you receive from another creature gains +S HP once per round. When you begin an unarmed strike at exactly 5 Ki and hit, spend 1 Ki and 1 RP; you and one living ally within 15 feet each regain S+M HP, at most once per turn.

source.originalText: Crane Stance (Support): +10% healing received. Moving 3+ tiles grants +15% dodge. At 5 Ki, next strike heals self and ally.

cards.name: Flowing Form
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Flowing Form. Tags: base, passive, ki. If you move at least 10 feet on your own turn and then hit with an unarmed strike or monk weapon attack before that turn ends, gain 1 Ki. Standing still and attacking, moving without landing a strike, or repeating staged movement outside a real encounter grants nothing.

source.originalText: Flowing Form: Alternating move + strike each round grants +1 Ki Chain.

cards.name: Striking Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your unarmed strike
cards.effect: Striking Palm. Tags: base, passive, critical. When your unarmed strike scores a critical hit, add S d4 force damage to that target. This added force damage ignores resistance to the physical damage type of the triggering unarmed strike but does not ignore force resistance or immunity. It is one rider, not another attack.

source.originalText: Striking Palm: Crits with unarmed attacks deal +50% armor-piercing internal damage.

cards.name: Unarmored Speed
cards.effect: Unarmored Speed. Tags: base, passive, mobility. While wearing no armor and using no shield, increase walking Speed by 5 feet and gain +1 on initiative rolls. At Monk 11 the Speed increase becomes 10 feet. This bonus does not multiply other Speed increases and is suppressed while armored.

source.originalText: Unarmored Speed: +10% movement and initiative while unarmored.

cards.name: Stance Shift
cards.frequency: Uses the same once-per-round stance switch
cards.effect: Stance Shift. Tags: base, passive-upgrade, stance. Your automatic core stance change may be used as a Reaction when you are targeted by an attack, forced to make a saving throw, or immediately before an ally within 15 feet receives healing. The new stance applies before the triggering roll or healing resolves. This consumes your one stance switch for that round and never grants a second switch.

source.originalText: Stance Shift: Switch stance freely once per round.

cards.name: Discipline Initiate
cards.effect: Discipline Initiate. Tags: base, discipline. Choose Offense, Tank or Support. Offense technique: once per turn in Tiger after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to deal +S damage and push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger. Tank: unlock the Tortoise Discipline Arch cards under the common gate. Support technique: once per turn in Crane after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to grant one ally within 15 feet S+M temporary HP. The chosen discipline cannot be changed without a future retraining rule.

source.originalText: Discipline Initiate: Choose a discipline (offense, tank, support) and gain 1 technique based on it.

cards.name: Flurry of Blows
cards.rangeAndTarget: One or two creatures within your unarmed reach
cards.effect: Flurry of Blows. Tags: base, active, attack, ki. Make exactly two separate unarmed strikes. The first successful Flurry strike on your turn grants 1 Ki. If both strikes hit different creatures, the second may grant 1 additional Ki, subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Tiger critical generation and Flowing Form may occur, but the total Ki gained on your turn still cannot exceed 2.

source.originalText: Flurry of Blows: Deliver a rapid sequence of unarmed strikes, with each hit having a chance to generate Ki Chain.

cards.name: Deflect Missile
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; triggering ranged weapon or projectile attack
cards.effect: Deflect Missile. Tags: base, active, defense. Trigger when a ranged weapon or physical projectile attack hits you. Reduce its damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level, minimum 0. If damage becomes 0 and the projectile can be held, you catch it. You may immediately spend 1 Ki to throw that projectile at one creature within 30 feet as part of the same Reaction, making a normal ranged attack with it.

source.originalText: Deflect Missile: React to a ranged attack by reducing its damage and potentially catching the projectile.

cards.name: Step of the Wind
cards.effect: Step of the Wind. Tags: base, active, mobility, weave. Until the end of the turn, your walking Speed increases by 15 feet, your jump distance doubles, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki under the common Weave interface if needed to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Step of the Wind: Harness your ki to dramatically increase your movement speed and jumping distance for one turn.

cards.name: Patient Defense
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Patient Defense. Tags: base, active, defense. Gain +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The first time before then that an attack misses you, gain 1 Ki subject to the off-turn gain ceiling. Multiple misses do not generate additional Ki from Patient Defense during that interval.

source.originalText: Patient Defense: Enter a defensive state that increases your dodge chance and generates Ki Chain when successfully avoiding attacks.

cards.name: Stunning Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
cards.effect: Stunning Strike. Tags: base, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the common Monk Stun Guard. On success it suffers only the strike's normal damage. A creature already marked by your Stun Guard instead loses its Reaction on a failed save.

source.originalText: Stunning Strike: Channel ki into a precise strike that can temporarily paralyze an opponent if they fail to resist.

cards.name: Combo Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by three different named Monk attack techniques in the same round
cards.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
cards.effect: Combo Step. Tags: arch, passive, combo, control. When you hit the same creature during one round with three different named Monk attack techniques, it makes a Constitution save after the third hit. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Stun Guard. Ordinary repeated unarmed strikes with no distinct technique names do not satisfy the three-technique requirement.

source.originalText: Combo Step: Use three different unarmed attacks in one round to stun the target.

cards.name: Ki Reversal
cards.cost: 1 Ki; requires at least 4 Ki before spending
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature that hits you with a melee attack
cards.effect: Ki Reversal. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, defense, counter. When a melee attack hits you while you have at least 4 Ki, spend 1 Ki to reduce the triggering damage by 1d8+M, minimum 0, then make one unarmed strike against the attacker if it is within reach. The counter is part of the Reaction and cannot generate an additional Action.

source.originalText: Ki Reversal: At 4+ Ki Chain, auto-counter the next melee hit.

cards.name: Perfect Balance
cards.effect: Perfect Balance. Tags: arch, passive, stance. If you have not moved before making your first unarmed attack on your turn, that attack scores a critical hit on natural 19 or 20; this does not widen Tiger beyond 19-20. If instead you move at least 10 feet during your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The AC benefit does not stack with itself.

source.originalText: Perfect Balance: Standing still: +15% crit. Moving: +15% dodge.

cards.name: Breath of Focus
cards.frequency: Once per turn in a real encounter
cards.effect: Breath of Focus. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, ki. Use your Action and make no attack as part of this feature. Gain 1 Ki, subject to the own-turn gain ceiling. This represents deliberately surrendering offense to center yourself and cannot generate Ki outside a real encounter, during a rest, or by repeatedly entering initiative without opposition.

source.originalText: Breath of Focus: Skip an attack to gain +1 Ki Chain.

cards.name: Rhythmic Flow
cards.frequency: Every third regular turn while at 5 Ki
cards.effect: Rhythmic Flow. Tags: arch, passive, critical. Count your regular Monk turns during a real encounter. On every third such turn, if you begin an unarmed strike while at 5 Ki, that strike automatically becomes a critical hit if it hits. The effect applies to the first qualifying strike only, then the three-turn count restarts. Encounter end resets the count.

source.originalText: Rhythmic Flow: Every 3rd round, next strike auto-crits at max Ki.

cards.name: Martial Apex (Capstone)
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Monk Action technique you are beginning to use
cards.effect: Martial Apex. Tags: arch, capstone, action. When at exactly 5 Ki, spend all 5 as you begin a Monk technique that normally requires an Action. That technique does not consume your normal Action but counts as the one additional full Action allowed to you that round. Add one additional copy of its base rolled damage dice to one damage roll. It cannot be used on healing-only techniques or a Hero Final. Spending all 5 Ki replaces only that technique's printed Ki cost; any RP, rest-use, target and recharge requirements are still paid/met. The bonus dice apply to one target only, cannot copy critical bonus dice, and cannot generate further attacks or resources.

source.originalText: Martial Apex (Capstone): At 5 Ki, your next ability costs no action and deals +100% damage (1/encounter).

cards.name: Stone Shell Discipline
cards.duration: While unarmored and Tortoise is active
cards.effect: Stone Shell Discipline. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. While in Tortoise Stance and at 3 or more Ki, gain +1 AC and you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone by a creature no more than one size larger than you. Dropping below 3 Ki immediately suspends these benefits until you return to 3 or more.

source.originalText: Stone Shell Discipline: +15% DR and Ki Chain protection at 3+ Ki. Immune to forced movement.

cards.name: Redirecting Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Triggering melee attacker and one other enemy within 5 feet of you
cards.effect: Redirecting Palm. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, counter. When a melee attack damages you, spend 1 Ki. Reduce the actual damage you take by half, rounded down. Choose one enemy other than you within 5 feet; it takes force damage equal to the amount prevented, maximum Monk level. If no second enemy is present, you still receive the reduction but redirect no damage.

source.originalText: Redirecting Palm: Spend 1 Ki to redirect 50% of incoming melee damage to a nearby enemy.

cards.name: Iron Shell Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: You and up to three allies within 15 feet
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Iron Shell Pulse. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, protection, weave. Each target reduces the first damage it takes before the duration ends by PB. After that reduction occurs, the attacker takes S force damage if within 30 feet, at most once per protected creature. This is a minor Weave technique; the optional common extra Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Iron Shell Pulse: Spend 3 Ki: grant nearby allies 10% DR and retaliation aura.

cards.name: Echoing Guard
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature whose attack misses you or whose attack you reduce to 0 damage
cards.duration: Until end of that creature's next turn
cards.frequency: At most once per attacker per round
cards.effect: Echoing Guard. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. When an attack misses you, or one of your defensive techniques reduces the triggering attack to 0 damage, the attacker becomes Staggered: -1 to attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: Echoing Guard: Blocking/dodging applies Stagger (-10% damage, -1 move).

cards.name: Final Form – Bastion of Breath
cards.cost: Spend all 5 Ki; requires Tank Discipline and at least three other Tortoise cards
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; shockwave then resolves
cards.frequency: 1/long rest; automatic gated Tortoise Final Form
cards.effect: Final Form — Bastion of Breath. Tags: arch, tortoise, final-form, defense, weave. Spend all 5 Ki. Until the start of your next regular turn you are immune to damage, though conditions that do not require damage may still affect you. Each enemy that hits you during this period makes a Constitution save; failure would Stun it, subject to the Stun Guard. At the start of your next turn, creatures of your choice within 15 feet make Strength saves, taking 2 S d8 force damage and being pushed 10 feet on failure, half damage and no push on success. This is the Arch-discipline exception and does not replace your later Hero path.

source.originalText: Final Form – Bastion of Breath: Become immune for 1 round. Enemies who strike are stunned. On next round, release a force shockwave.

cards.name: Whirlwind Stance
cards.effect: Whirlwind Stance. Tags: arch, active, attack. Despite its historical name, this is a technique rather than a fourth core Stance and does not replace Tiger, Tortoise or Crane. Make one unarmed strike against each of up to three different creatures within reach. Roll separately. Ki generation from these hits remains subject to the normal own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: Whirlwind Stance: Enter a flowing stance that allows you to strike multiple adjacent enemies with each attack.

cards.name: Focused Ki Burst
cards.effect: Focused Ki Burst. Tags: arch, active, weave, damage. Creatures of your choice in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking S d8 force damage on failure or half on success. This is a minor Weave technique. After validating its printed costs, you may spend 1 additional Ki to prevent the 1 Dissonance it would otherwise create under the protected interface.

source.originalText: Focused Ki Burst: Channel your ki into a powerful energy discharge that damages enemies in a small area.

cards.name: Diamond Soul
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Diamond Soul. Tags: arch, active, weave, defense. Until the start of your next regular turn, gain +2 on saving throws and reduce each instance of damage you take by PB, minimum 0. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki through the common interface to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Diamond Soul: Temporarily harden your body against physical and magical attacks, gaining resistance to damage.

cards.name: Pressure Point Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Pressure Point Strike. Tags: arch, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose Arm or Leg: Arm gives -1 on attack rolls; Leg reduces Speed by 10 feet, minimum 0. This represents temporary disruption only and causes no persistent limb injury.

source.originalText: Pressure Point Strike: Target a specific vulnerability in your opponent, potentially disabling a limb or ability temporarily.

cards.name: Meditative Healing
cards.effect: Meditative Healing. Tags: arch, active, healing, weave. Regain S d8 + M HP, then regain 1 Ki after resolution, never above 5. The restored Ki does not count as a normal generator but cannot be used if this feature was activated outside a real encounter merely to farm Ki. It removes no Wounds. As a minor Weave technique, you may spend 1 additional Ki before resolution to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Meditative Healing: Enter a brief meditative state that rapidly restores your health and ki.

cards.name: Tranquil Lotus Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within your walking Speed
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Tranquil Lotus Step. Tags: hero, enlightened, support, cleanse. Move up to your Speed toward a willing ally without provoking opportunity attacks. If you finish within 5 feet, choose Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned currently affecting that ally; end it on the ally and apply that same condition to yourself until the end of your next regular turn if you are not immune. The ally gains +S HP the next time it receives healing before then.

source.originalText: Tranquil Lotus Step: Move to ally, absorb their debuff, and grant +15% healing received (2 Ki).

cards.name: Serenity Breaker Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within unarmed reach; allies within 10 feet
cards.effect: Serenity Breaker Palm. Tags: hero, enlightened, attack, cleanse. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, choose up to M living allies within 10 feet of you; each may end either Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned. The cleansing occurs only if the strike hits. It removes no Wounds, curses or disease and generates no Ki beyond ordinary attack generators.

cards.name: Balance Beyond Flesh
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 feet while you are in Crane Stance
cards.effect: Balance Beyond Flesh. Tags: hero, enlightened, support, healing. During a real encounter, when an ally within 15 feet spends at least 1 point from a finite class resource such as Ki, RP or Conviction, you may pay 1 RP for that ally to regain S HP, at most once per round. It cannot trigger from free abilities, staged spending outside combat or resources immediately refunded by the same event.

cards.name: Breath of the Thousand Petals
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to six allies within 20 feet

cards.name: Purifying Palm
