cards.name: Centerline Blitz
cards.rangeAndTarget: 20-foot line ending in an unoccupied space you can occupy
cards.effect: Centerline Blitz. Tags: hero, iron-fist, mobility, attack, control. Move along the line without provoking opportunity attacks and make one unarmed strike against each of up to three different creatures whose spaces you pass within reach of. If you had exactly 5 Ki before paying the cost, the final creature hit makes a Constitution save; failure would Stun it until the end of its next turn, subject to the Stun Guard.

source.originalText: Centerline Blitz: Dash in a line, striking all targets. Final one is stunned at max Ki (3 Ki).

cards.name: Steel Reflection Form
cards.effect: Steel Reflection Form. Tags: hero, iron-fist, defense. For 3 rounds, once per round when a creature within 5 feet deals melee damage to you, that creature takes force damage equal to S+M after the triggering damage resolves. Reflected damage cannot trigger another reflection, counterattack, resource gain or proc chain.

source.originalText: Steel Reflection Form: Reflect 15% melee damage for 3 turns.

cards.name: Limit Break Spiral
cards.effect: Final — Limit Break Spiral. Tags: hero, iron-fist, final, attack. This pilot does not grant two Bonus Actions. Instead, after activation your unarmed strikes score critical hits on natural 19 or 20 for the rest of the turn, and once this turn when you use an Action Monk attack technique you may make one additional unarmed strike as part of that same technique. This grants no extra Bonus Action and cannot exceed the universal additional-full-Action cap.

source.originalText: Final – Limit Break Spiral: 2 bonus actions; all strikes crit this turn (1/day).

cards.name: Iron Palm
cards.effect: Iron Palm. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit add S d6 force damage. For this attack only, resistance to the strike's normal bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage is ignored; immunity remains immunity. The force rider uses normal resistance and immunity.

source.originalText: Iron Palm: Channel ki into your strike to ignore a portion of the target's armor and resistance.

cards.name: Flowing Combo
cards.effect: Flowing Combo. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack. Make exactly three separate unarmed strikes against one creature. The first deals normal damage, the second successful hit adds S damage, and the third successful hit adds 2 S damage. These are flat bonuses, not extra attacks. Ki generation from the strikes remains capped by the normal own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: Flowing Combo: Execute a series of perfectly coordinated strikes that build upon each other, with increasing damage per hit.

cards.name: Focused Breathing
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Focused Breathing. Tags: hero, iron-fist, focus. Until the end of your next regular turn, your unarmed strikes score critical hits on natural 19 or 20. If another feature already provides 19-20, the ranges do not widen further. You also gain advantage on the next Constitution save you make before the effect ends.

source.originalText: Focused Breathing: Enter a state of perfect concentration, significantly increasing your critical hit chance for a short duration.

cards.name: Bone-Breaking Strike
cards.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
cards.effect: Bone-Breaking Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by 2 S+M under the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule. This creates no persistent broken-limb injury; the maximum returns after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Bone-Breaking Strike: Deliver a powerful blow that can temporarily reduce the target's maximum health.

cards.name: One Hundred Fists
cards.rangeAndTarget: One or more creatures within unarmed reach
cards.effect: One Hundred Fists. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack. Make exactly four separate unarmed strikes, distributing them among creatures within reach as desired. Each uses normal attack and damage rules. No strike grants another attack or Action. Ki generators may trigger, but because the activation spent all 5 Ki, total Ki gained during the turn remains subject to the usual own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: One Hundred Fists: Ultimate technique that allows you to strike with incredible speed, delivering numerous attacks in a single moment.

cards.name: Veinlock Nerve Jab
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your unarmed strike
cards.effect: Veinlock Nerve Jab. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, control. After an unarmed strike hits, spend 2 Ki. The target makes a Constitution save. On failure it cannot regain HP or finite class resources until the end of its next turn and repeats the save then; failure extends the effect one final round. If you were hidden from it when the strike began, the initial failed save also Silences it until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: Veinlock Nerve Jab: Strike blocks healing/resource gain (2 turns). Silences if hidden (2 Ki).

cards.name: Twilight Mirage
cards.rangeAndTarget: One unoccupied space within 5 feet of you
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Twilight Mirage. Tags: hero, shadow, illusion, weave. Create one illusory duplicate. The first attack that would hit you before the duration ends instead destroys the duplicate and misses you. Once before the duplicate disappears, after you hit with an unarmed strike it mirrors that strike for force damage equal to half the triggering strike's unmodified rolled damage dice total, rounded down once, minimum 1. The mirror is not another attack and triggers nothing.

source.originalText: Twilight Mirage: Summon a 1-turn clone to mirror strikes and intercept attacks (3 Ki).

cards.name: Nerve Fade Technique
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your unarmed strike
cards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
cards.effect: Nerve Fade Technique. Tags: hero, shadow, shadow-rot. After an unarmed strike damages a creature, spend 1 Ki to apply one Shadow Rot stack, maximum 2. At the start of the target's turn each stack deals 1d4 psychic damage. At one stack it has -1 on its first saving throw that turn; at two stacks it has -1 on all saving throws that turn. At the end of each turn it makes a Wisdom save, removing all stacks on success.

source.originalText: Nerve Fade Technique: Stacking Shadow Rot debuff (-saves, psychic DoT) (1 Ki).

cards.name: Deathless Silence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to three enemies you can perceive within 60 feet
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; max-HP reduction until rest
cards.effect: Final — Deathless Silence. Tags: hero, shadow, final, teleportation, max-hp, weave. Until the start of your next regular turn you cannot be targeted by opportunity attacks or Reactions. Teleport adjacent to up to three different chosen enemies in sequence and make one unarmed strike against each. On each hit, the target makes a Constitution save. Failure reduces its maximum HP by 4 S+M under the common non-stacking rule and suppresses one non-core defensive passive it possesses until the end of its next turn; the Director identifies an applicable visible passive before the save. This does not disable core class engines, legendary rules or creature type traits.

source.originalText: Final – Deathless Silence: Untargetable 1 turn → teleport to 3 enemies and apply Void Palm (max HP -25%, passive disable).

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Shadow Step. Tags: hero, shadow, teleportation, weave. Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you perceive. You become Invisible until you make an attack, deal damage, force a saving throw, start another technique or the duration ends. This movement provokes no opportunity attacks. As a minor Weave technique, the common extra-Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Briefly step into the shadow realm, becoming untargetable and reappearing at a different location.

cards.name: Nerve Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Nerve Strike. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose one: its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, or it loses its Reaction and cannot take Bonus Actions during that period. This causes no permanent nerve injury.

source.originalText: Nerve Strike: Target critical pressure points to temporarily disable an opponent's abilities or movement.

cards.name: Poison Hand
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your next unarmed strike this turn
cards.effect: Poison Hand. Tags: hero, shadow, poison, attack. The next unarmed strike you hit with before the end of this turn deals S d4 additional poison damage. The target then makes a Constitution save; on failure it takes 1d4 poison damage at the start of each of its next 2 turns. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks the damage-over-time effect.

source.originalText: Poison Hand: Infuse your strikes with toxic ki that causes continuing damage over time.

cards.name: Mind Cloud
cards.effect: Mind Cloud. Tags: hero, shadow, psychic, control, weave. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it loses its Reaction and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of that turn; on failure the effect lasts one additional round, then ends automatically. The effect never forces the target to attack allies or surrender control of its full turn.

source.originalText: Mind Cloud: Disrupt an enemy's mental clarity, causing confusion or hallucinations.

cards.name: Death Touch
cards.effect: Death Touch. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, finisher. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit add 3 S d8 necrotic damage. If the target began the strike at or below one-quarter maximum HP, it also makes a Constitution save; on failure add another 2 S d8 necrotic damage. This never causes automatic death, bypasses no ordinary dying rules and creates no permanent injury beyond the damage actually dealt.

source.originalText: Death Touch: Legendary technique that can potentially kill a weakened target instantly by stopping their heart.

completeEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; editorial review applied; human table balance testing required

completeEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Oracle does not track Weave Dissonance. Revelation Charges, the permanent Curse, and Prophecy Triggers are the Oracle's anti-spam architecture.
engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Charisma is the Oracle class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Oracle levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Charisma modifier). Revelation attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. Revelation save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier.

HIT DIE CONFLICT. The class overview registry lists d8, while the detailed Player Rulebook Oracle entry states 6 + Constitution modifier at level 1 and d6 per Oracle level thereafter. This pilot uses the detailed rulebook d6 chassis: 6 + Constitution modifier at Oracle 1 and 1d6 per later Oracle level. The d8 registry value remains a preserved alternative pending owner adjudication.

The Oracle is an exceptional progression class rather than a 25-choice Base/Arch/Hero class. Base Oracle is levels 1-2, Revelation Tier development is the Arch-stage progression at levels 3-9, and Revelation Mastery is the Hero-stage progression at levels 10-20. Mystery and Curse are chosen at level 1 but their later Revelations, Boons and Final abilities remain class-level gated.

Choose exactly ONE Mystery and exactly ONE Curse at Oracle level 1. They are not parallel subclasses that stack. You never gain another Mystery or Curse unless a future explicit retraining or transformation rule says otherwise. Curse limitations are permanent and cannot be removed by ordinary cleansing, curse removal, resurrection or rest.

REVELATION CHARGES are the Oracle's only class power resource. Oracles do not use Resonance Points, spell slots, Weave Dissonance, Overcast or ordinary spell-rank casting for Revelations. Revelation Charges are abbreviated RC. A Revelation card's printed RC cost is paid once before resolution. An illegal activation spends nothing.

RC CAP SCHEDULE for this provisional module: maximum 3 at Oracle levels 1-2, 4 at levels 3-5, 5 at levels 6-8, 6 at levels 9-10 and 7 at level 11+. Increasing the maximum does not automatically refill spent charges except where another feature explicitly says so.

RC RECOVERY. A completed long rest restores RC to maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent RC, never above maximum. Each Mystery has exactly one Prophecy Trigger. During a real encounter, your Prophecy Trigger can restore at most 1 RC per round and never above maximum. Trivial enemies, willing staged targets, summoned sacrifices, repeated corpse abuse, copied damage, copied healing and events generated solely to trigger recovery do not qualify.

A single event can satisfy only one Prophecy Trigger recovery for you even if several descriptions could apply. A Revelation repeated or copied by another feature does not independently trigger Prophecy recovery unless that feature explicitly says it counts as a new Revelation use. Restored charges never recursively trigger another recovery.

At Oracle level 11, the preserved registry draft additionally sets your starting RC when a real encounter begins to at least max(3, your Charisma modifier), capped by your current RC maximum. If you already have more RC, keep the higher current value. This encounter-start floor occurs once per encounter and cannot be triggered by staged initiative.

REVELATIONS are divine class techniques, not ordinary spells. Unless a Revelation explicitly says otherwise, magical silence does not prevent a purely mental Revelation, but a Revelation requiring speech, touch, visible symbolism or another listed component obeys that requirement. Revelations do not generate Dissonance and cannot be modified by spell-slot, RP, spell-rank discount or ordinary spell-proc mechanics.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time unless a specific Oracle feature explicitly creates a narrow exception. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration procedure; if half-damage rounding is required in this pilot, round down. Sustained Revelation control effects grant repeat saves at the cadence printed on the Revelation.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Oracle-caused full-turn denial such as Stunned, Paralyzed, Incapacitated by control, or loss of its full Action from your Oracle features per encounter. After that succeeds once, later Oracle effects from you that would fully deny its turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. An additional Action cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Features that say a creature acts out of turn use this same cap. Movement-only grants do not count as additional full Actions.

Healing from Oracle features cannot exceed maximum HP, resurrect the dead or remove Wounds unless a feature explicitly says so. Temporary HP never stack. Encounter-only regeneration and drain cannot be farmed outside meaningful combat. Corpse effects create no XP, loot, RC or repeatable corpse resources unless expressly stated.

Copied, echoed, repeated or redirected damage/healing uses only the explicitly copied numeric component. It cannot repeat RC recovery, Prophecy Triggers, action grants, conditions, passive triggers, resource restoration or another copy effect unless the copying feature explicitly says otherwise.

BASE PROGRESSION. At Oracle 1 choose Mystery and Curse; gain the RC engine, Channel Revelation, Prophetic Insight and Divine Sense. At Oracle 2 gain Curse Manifestation, Oracular Trance and Oracle's Burden. No Base feature-selection currency or Skill Points are used.

ARCH-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 3: choose one Tier I Revelation from your Mystery and automatically gain Curse Boon I. Oracle 4: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 5: automatically gain Curse Boon II; any Mystery-specific level-5 feature recorded by the registry belongs to the Mystery module below and does not create an additional generic feature here. Oracle 6: choose one Tier II Revelation and gain Mystery Surge. Oracle 8: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 9: gain your Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation.

HERO-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 10: gain Curse Boon III and Grand Revelation Foreshadow. Oracle 11: RC cap reaches 7 and the preserved encounter-start RC floor becomes active. Oracle 12: gain the Mystery-specific Mystic Insight. Oracle 13: preserved registry draft grants a second Tier II Revelation; after each completed short rest choose which of your two Tier II Revelations is Attuned for features that specifically refer to an active Tier II option, though both remain known and usable. Oracle 14: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 15: gain Revelation Mastery and Curse Boon IV. Oracle 16: preserved Prophecy Trigger Mastery. Oracle 17: preserved Grand Revelation Foreshadow upgrade. Oracle 18: Prophetic Surge. Oracle 19: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 20: gain the Mystery's Final Revelation and Curse Boon V.

REVELATION MASTERY at level 15 never grants a Revelation you do not know. Choose one mastery enhancement explicitly listed by your Mystery for a Revelation you know. If a listed mastery names a Revelation you did not select, that mastery option is unavailable. Mastery cannot reduce RC below 0, create additional Actions beyond the shared cap or remove repeat-save requirements unless its exact Mystery text says so.

PROPHECY AND DIVINATION never force player beliefs, future choices or confessions. Information features can provide truthful clues, likely outcomes, symbolic visions or current facts, but the Director is not required to reveal unknowable future player decisions. Effects that command or compel a player-controlled character preserve the player's choice of targets and prohibit self-harm, permanent allegiance changes and belief alteration.

CURSE MANIFESTATION provides a common operational intensification rather than ten different hidden sub-engines. When activated, your Curse becomes visibly or metaphysically dominant for 3 rounds: gain +1 on Revelation attacks and +1 to Revelation save DC, but take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws for the duration. Any Curse limitation that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed during Manifestation.

CURSE BOONS are automatic at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 for your ONE selected Curse. You do not choose between Curse Boons and do not gain Boons from unselected Curses. Each Curse card below operationalizes all five Boon gates and its permanent limitations.

All class gates use Oracle class level, not total character level. Normal proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. Non-Oracle levels do not raise RC maximum, unlock Curse Boons, Revelations, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery, Prophetic Surge or Final Revelation.

INTEGRATION PRECEDENCE. The source ceiling draft conflicts with the registry on short rests and extra Revelation activations. This pilot explicitly chooses 1 RC on a completed short rest and permits a second Revelation only through an expressly granted extra Action or double-cast feature, never more than two Revelation resolutions per round. The preserved ceiling alternative is no short-rest recovery and one activation per round; do not combine both configurations.

All combat-triggered RC refunds, including Prophecy, damage riders and Curse Boons, share ONE recovered RC per round. Rest recovery, encounter-start floor and explicitly limited Final refills are separate. A free, copied or refunded use cannot recursively trigger another recovery. Apply this global cap even if an individual card says its recovery is separate.

The shared Prophetic Surge and your Mystery-specific level-18 Prophecy are two descriptions/options of ONE long-rest use, not two charges. Framework cards such as Tier III, Mystic Insight, Mastery and Final Revelation unlock the named Mystery card and never grant duplicate uses. A level-5 registry Mystery label grants no extra unnamed ability.

Oracle zone default: choose at most three allies and three enemies for each pulse or aura benefit, fixed at activation unless the card names fewer. Persistent damaging/healing zones require concentration and at most three pulses. Pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first, or end the effect; once-per-long-rest Finals include their printed pulses in that limited use. One pulse can affect a creature only once per round. Passive personal resistance and a single-target temporary buff are not zones.

Revelation backlash is the local one-turn penalty of -1 to attacks and saves and -5 feet Speed, ending at the end of your next turn. It is not a level of the general Exhaustion condition. Wound Eater's missed-feeding Exhaustion remains the general condition.

Initiative adjustments change order beginning next round. They never produce or erase a regular turn in the current round; a creature still gets at most one regular turn each round. Ties use the original initiative order. Fixed encounter-start bonuses do not retroactively reorder an encounter.

Extra attacks and echoed damage use base weapon/spell dice before critical-hit extra dice. A redirected damage event cannot be reduced a second time, reflected again or generate RC. Charmed alone does not grant command of a creature's actions.

Oracle’s exceptional ASI/feat schedule is 4, 8, 14 and 19. It does not gain extra ASIs at 12 or 16 from the generic class schedule. The rejected five-milestone draft remains in superseded Playtest Overrides for traceability.
workedExample: Oracle 5 example: Charisma 16 gives M=3, PB=3 and S=2. The Oracle has maximum RC 4 under the pilot schedule, begins a real encounter at RC 4, selected Spiral-Touched as the Curse, and knows one Tier I Revelation costing 1 RC.
Turn 1: use the known Tier I Revelation for 1 RC, so RC 4→3. Suppose its Mystery Prophecy Trigger does not occur. Because Revelations use RC only, no RP, spell slot, Burn or Dissonance value changes.

Turn 2: use Curse Manifestation as a Bonus Action for 1 RC, RC 3→2. For 3 rounds the Oracle gains +1 to Revelation attacks and save DC but suffers -1 AC and -1 on its own saving throws. The permanent Spiral-Touched limitations continue.

Enemy turn: the Oracle fails a saving throw. Spiral-Touched Curse Boon I is already unlocked at Oracle 3, so once per long rest the Oracle rerolls that failed save and uses the new result. This reroll costs no RC.

Turn 3: Spiral-Touched Curse Boon II is unlocked at Oracle 5. Spend 1 RC to take its once-per-combat out-of-turn Action after another creature finishes its turn, RC 2→1. This uses the universal one-additional-full-Action-per-round allowance and cannot generate another extra Action.
After combat, a completed short rest restores 1 RC, RC 1→2. A long rest would instead restore the Oracle to the current maximum of 4. Neither rest removes the Spiral-Touched Curse.
balanceQuestions: Does the provisional RC cap schedule 3→4→5→6→7, combined with short-rest recovery, Prophecy Triggers and the level-11 encounter-start floor, sustain Revelations without making charge management irrelevant?

Do Curse limitations remain meaningful after their Boons accumulate, especially for Spiral-Touched, Wound Eater, Shattered Mind and False Life, without producing excessive involuntary turn loss or noninteractive penalties?
Do the shared hard-control and additional-Action caps adequately contain Time, Tongues, Shattered Mind and other future Mystery interactions while preserving each Curse's identity?

cards.name: Revelation Charges
cards.effect: Gain the Revelation Charge resource. Maximum RC follows the pilot schedule: 3 at Oracle 1-2, 4 at 3-5, 5 at 6-8, 6 at 9-10 and 7 at 11+. Long rest restores all RC; short rest restores 1. Mystery Prophecy Triggers restore at most 1 RC per round in meaningful encounters.

value.note: Revelation Charges power Mystery Revelations (initially 3, maximum 7). Each Mystery has a Prophecy Trigger to recover charges.

cards.name: Mystery
cards.effect: Choose exactly one Mystery: Ancestor, Battle, Bones, Cataclysm, Dream, Flame, Life, Shadow, Stars or Time. It determines your Prophecy Trigger, level-1 Mystery identity, Revelation choices, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery options, Prophetic Surge variant and Final Revelation. The Mystery cards below define those features.

cards.name: Oracle's Curse
cards.effect: Choose exactly one Curse from the ten Curse cards below. Its limitations apply immediately and cannot be removed by ordinary magic or rest. Its Boons unlock automatically at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20.

cards.name: Channel Revelation
cards.cost: Use the Revelation's printed RC cost
cards.frequency: Whenever a known Revelation is legally usable
cards.effect: Channel Revelation is the framework for activating a known Mystery Revelation. Use that Revelation's printed activation, target, range, RC cost, duration, recharge and save/attack procedure. Channel Revelation adds no extra Action or RC cost and cannot be activated without a known Revelation.

originalObjects.value: Channel Revelation — activate a Mystery Revelation (costs Revelation Charges)

cards.name: Prophetic Insight
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until used
cards.effect: Glimpse several immediate possibilities. Gain advantage on your next attack roll, saving throw or ability check before the end of your next regular turn. You must choose which roll receives the advantage before rolling it. This grants no knowledge of another player's future choice.

originalObjects.value: Prophetic Insight — brief glimpse of possible futures; advantage on next action

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.effect: For 1 minute sense the presence, approximate direction and broad nature of divine, undead and extraplanar creatures or active presences within 60 feet that are not behind an effect specifically blocking divination. You learn only broad categories such as celestial/divine, undead, fiendish, fey, elemental or other extraplanar, not identity, alignment, statistics or intentions.

originalObjects.value: Divine Sense — detect divine, undead, or extraplanar entities

cards.name: Curse Manifestation
cards.effect: Intensify your chosen Curse. For 3 rounds gain +1 on Revelation attack rolls and +1 to your Revelation save DC. For the same duration take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws. Any part of the selected Curse that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed while Manifestation lasts.

originalObjects.value: Curse Manifestation — intensify Curse for benefits at increased limitations

cards.name: Oracular Trance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one stated question or situation
cards.effect: Enter a prophetic trance and state one specific question concerning a current situation, danger, location or course of action. The Director provides one truthful symbolic vision, omen or useful clue based on information available to the Oracle's Mystery. The trance cannot guarantee another character's future decision or reveal facts that no relevant supernatural source could know.

originalObjects.value: Oracular Trance — prophetic visions related to a question or situation

cards.name: Oracle's Burden
cards.effect: Your selected Curse is recognized as an intrinsic Oracle class condition rather than an ordinary removable curse. Remove Curse, cleansing, resurrection and similar generic effects cannot remove or suspend it. Only a feature that explicitly names your Oracle Curse can suppress, transform or replace one of its effects.

cards.name: Tier I Revelation
cards.effect: Choose one Tier I Revelation from your selected Mystery. Tier I Revelations normally cost 1 RC unless the Mystery card explicitly says otherwise. You know the chosen Revelation permanently.

value.feature: Tier I Revelation (choose 1, 1 charge) + Curse Boon I

cards.name: Curse Boon I
cards.effect: Unlock the Oracle 3 Boon printed in your selected Curse card. You gain no Boon from unselected Curses.

value.feature: Tier I Revelation (choose 1, 1 charge) + Curse Boon I

cards.name: Ability Score Improvement — Oracle 4
cards.effect: Choose the campaign's normal Ability Score Improvement option or one eligible feat. This milestone is separate from Revelations, Mysteries and Curse Boons.

cards.name: Curse Boon II
cards.effect: Unlock the Oracle 5 Boon printed in your selected Curse card. The main registry also names a level-5 Mystery feature; that Mystery-specific feature is represented by its explicit Mystery card below and does not create an additional generic shared feature here.

cards.name: Tier II Revelation
cards.effect: Choose one Tier II Revelation from your selected Mystery. Tier II Revelations normally cost 2 RC unless their Mystery card explicitly says otherwise. You know the chosen Revelation permanently.

cards.name: Mystery Surge
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Tier II Revelation you are activating
cards.effect: When you activate a known Tier II Revelation, choose one applicable surge: increase its Revelation attack roll or save DC by 1 for that use; add S to one rolled damage or healing result; or increase one printed non-concentration duration of 1-2 rounds by 1 round. A Surge cannot create additional Actions, targets, RC recovery or hard-control repetitions.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6 and a known Tier II Revelation

cards.name: Ability Score Improvement — Oracle 8
cards.effect: Choose the campaign's normal Ability Score Improvement option or one eligible feat. This is separate from Revelation progression.

cards.name: Tier III Revelation
cards.effect: Gain your selected Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation. It normally costs 3 RC unless its Mystery card explicitly states otherwise. This is the Arch-stage Mystery capstone and is not selected from another Mystery.

cards.name: Curse Boon III
cards.effect: Unlock the Oracle 10 Boon printed in your selected Curse card.

cards.name: Grand Revelation Foreshadow
cards.effect: You learn the title, broad theme and narrative omen associated with your selected Mystery's Final Revelation. This grants no early mechanical access, no RC discount and no additional Revelation.

cards.name: Revelation Charge Cap VII
cards.frequency: Once at start of each real encounter
cards.effect: Your RC maximum becomes 7. When a real encounter begins, if your current RC is below max(3, your Charisma modifier), raise current RC to that value, capped at 7. If current RC is already higher, keep it. Staged initiative, willing sparring and trivial encounters cannot trigger this floor.

value.text: Revelation Charge cap reaches 7 — enter combat with charges equal to Charisma mod (min 3, max 7); track on sheet

cards.effect: Gain the Mystic Insight printed for your selected Mystery in the Mystery cards below. If that Mystery presents multiple Minor Revelation/passive choices, choose exactly one as specified there.

value.feature: Mystic Insight — minor Revelation or passive from your Mystery

cards.effect: Choose a second Tier II Revelation from your selected Mystery. Both are known and may be used normally. After each completed short rest, designate one of the two as Attuned; only the Attuned option receives features that explicitly refer to your active Tier II Revelation.

This remains one use per long rest even when the recovery is prevented by the cap.

cards.name: Spiral-Touched
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: your temporal dislocation is obvious in conversation. Once per real encounter, at the start of each of your regular turns until this occurs, roll d20; on 1 you lose your Bonus Action and Reaction for that turn as you desynchronize, but retain Action and movement. You have disadvantage on ability checks requiring more than 10 uninterrupted minutes of mundane concentration.

value.name: Spiral-Touched
value.blurb: Manipulates initiative, gains time-based echoes
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations
You occasionally experience time differently than others, potentially missing turns in combat (5% chance)
You cannot maintain concentration on mundane tasks for extended periods

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: You gain the ability to create a time loop, resetting an entire combat encounter to its beginning state once per day. All allies retain knowledge of the original timeline, allowing them to make different choices.

cards.name: Spiral-Touched — Boon V
cards.effect: 1/long rest as a Reaction before the fourth round of the encounter begins, rewind the current encounter to its initiative-start snapshot: restore combatant positions, HP, temporary HP, conditions, RC and per-encounter uses to that snapshot. Short-/long-rest uses, physical consumables and this Time Loop use remain spent. Slain encounter participants return to their snapshot state and no duplicate XP, treasure or consumables are created. Allies retain memory of the previous timeline. Time Loop does not restore RP, Ki, Conviction, Blood Gauge, device stock, healing reserves or any other daily/rest resource; only the named RC and per-encounter states rewind. No loot changes ownership through rewinding. Record the snapshot at initiative; if no complete snapshot exists, this option is unavailable and unspent. It cannot undo a previous encounter or duplicate a per-rest use.

cards.name: Wound Eater
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: HP recovery from rests and from another creature's healing is halved, rounded down; your own Wound Eater drains and your own Revelations are not halved. Before a long rest completes, you must have successfully drained HP from a meaningful hostile living creature since your previous long rest or gain one level of Exhaustion after the rest. Your corpse-like appearance imposes disadvantage on the first friendly social check with an unfamiliar mortal who can clearly see you, unless circumstances make the appearance irrelevant.

value.name: Wound Eater
value.blurb: Lives by wounds taken from the living, never by an easy cure
limitations: Natural healing and healing granted by another restore only half their usual amount to you
Before each long rest ends, you must drain life from a living foe or gain Exhaustion
Your flesh carries a hollow, withered look that makes many mortals recoil at first meeting

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: When you hit a living foe with a weapon or touch attack, drain 1d6 HP; you heal for half the amount drained. Undead and constructs are immune.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: When you reduce a living foe to 0 HP, regain 1 Revelation Charge. Resistance to necrotic damage from non-Revelation sources.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Once per short rest, siphon a dying enemy's remaining HP as a burst heal (up to 25% of your max HP). The Pale Ledger records their final breath.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Drain aura: at the start of your turn, living enemies within 2 tiles take necrotic damage; you heal for the total drained. You may suppress this aura in civilized areas.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a conduit of the unfinished hunger — all living enemies within 4 tiles lose 25% max HP; you heal for half the total. Allies are unaffected.

cards.name: Soul-Cracked
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination that attempts to read your alignment, aura or intent returns inconsistent results unless it specifically overcomes Oracle curses. Once each encounter, before your first damaging Revelation resolves, roll d6: 1 fire, 2 cold, 3 lightning, 4 necrotic, 5 psychic, 6 radiant; that Revelation's damage becomes the rolled type. While subject to a geas, binding oath or magically enforced pact, the first time each turn you knowingly act against its terms you take S psychic damage.

value.name: Soul-Cracked
value.blurb: A fractured spirit refuses easy command and answers magic unevenly
limitations: Divination reads your aura and alignment inconsistently; even allies struggle to scry your intent
Once each encounter, the resonance type of your Revelations may shift without warning
Binding oaths and geas magic cause you physical pain until they are resolved

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Immune to charm and compulsion. Once per day, reroll a failed save against mind-affecting effects as your soul fractures around the blow.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: After rolling initiative, choose once per combat to shift the damage type of your next Revelation (fire, cold, lightning, necrotic, psychic, or radiant). Until that Revelation resolves, your aura reads as blank to divination — scrying your intent fails for the round.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be charmed or dominated, reflect the effect onto the source (once per long rest). The source must save or suffer the effect instead.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Fractured soul: gain resistance to psychic damage and +2 to saves vs control. Divination targeting you has 50% chance to return contradictory results.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, shatter a binding curse, geas, or possession on yourself or an ally within 3 tiles. The broken magic lashes the originator for psychic damage.

cards.name: Tongues
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: unless you suppress the chorus, take -2 on social checks with mortals who do not understand your overlapping speech. You may suppress it as an Action for 10 minutes; while suppressed you cannot use Tongues Boons requiring supernatural speech. Prophetic statements may be misunderstood narratively but the Director should not falsify player intent. After more than 1 uninterrupted hour of mundane concentration, make a DC 10 Wisdom save or lose the final 10 minutes of progress to intrusive voices.

value.blurb: Many voices share your speech, making truth harder to hear cleanly
limitations: Unless you suppress the curse, social checks with mortals who do not share your mystery tongue suffer −2
Even accurate prophetic speech is often misheard; listeners may hear what they fear
You cannot fully silence the chorus; concentrating on mundane tasks longer than 1 hour requires a Wisdom save

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Understand all spoken languages and read divine script fragments. Allies within 5 tiles gain +2 to Lore and Insight checks when you interpret for them.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Confounding babble: one enemy within 3 tiles must save or lose their next action, overwhelmed by overlapping voices. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Prophetic utterance — force one creature within 3 tiles to truthfully answer a yes/no question drawn from the Choir's echo. Once per day.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Polyglot surge: communicate with beasts, plants, and spirits for 1 hour as the First Song's vocabulary flows through you. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, speak a single Word in the tongue of creation — all who hear must save or obey one short command. Those who resist take psychic damage.

cards.name: Burning Blood
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: once per round when slashing or piercing damage deals actual HP damage to you, your blood ignites: you and hostile creatures within 5 feet each take 1d4 fire damage. You cannot gain cold resistance from a beneficial spell, item or class feature and cold-tagged healing restores 0 HP to you. After slashing or piercing damage wounds you, take -2 on Stealth until a creature spends an Action succeeding on DC 10 Medicine to bind the wound or you complete a short/long rest.

value.name: Burning Blood
value.blurb: Air kindles your spilled blood into a fire that harms friend and foe alike
limitations: When slashing or piercing damage wounds you, you and adjacent foes take 1d4 fire damage as your blood sparks
You cannot benefit from cold-based healing or resistances; your curse rejects the chill
Open wounds glow faintly, imposing −2 to Stealth until treated or until you rest

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Resistance to fire. Melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage when they hit you with a weapon attack. Your wounds smolder briefly — enemies within 1 tile take 1 fire damage when your blood first ignites each round.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to ignite your blood — your next Revelation deals +50% fire damage and cannot be extinguished by mundane means. While ignited, slashing and piercing damage against you no longer sparks fire on adjacent allies; the Crown's flame answers only to your will.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When your blood ignites from damage, allies within 2 tiles gain +10% weapon damage for 1 round as shard-fire answers your pain. You may extend the flare to 3 tiles by spending 1 Revelation Charge — enemies in the burst take 1d4 fire damage as embers leap from your wounds.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Blood flare: when reduced below 50% HP, erupt fire in a 3-tile burst (once per short rest). Enemies take fire damage; you are not harmed by your own flare.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a living pyre for 3 rounds — fire aura in 3 tiles; enemies take fire damage at start of turn; you heal 1d6 when an enemy takes fire damage from you. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and treat your ignited blood as bright light that reveals hidden foes within 2 tiles.

cards.name: False Life
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination treats you as undead unless it specifically pierces Oracle curses. Before a healing spell from another creature restores HP to you, its caster may make Wisdom (Insight) against your Revelation save DC. On success healing works normally. Social hesitation from life-focused clergy remains narrative unless the scene calls for an ordinary reaction check.

limitations: Healing spells cast on you without a successful Insight check have a 50% chance to fail; magic reads you as corpse-cold

cards.name: Shattered Mind
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: take -2 on concentration saves. Once per tense social scene, make a DC 10 Wisdom save when the Director identifies a meaningful pressure point; on failure you involuntarily speak a brief prophetic fragment, but the player chooses wording that does not reveal protected secrets unless already known. After each long rest make a DC 10 Wisdom save; failure gives fragmented memories of others' dreams, a narrative complication with no automatic mechanical penalty.

value.name: Shattered Mind
value.blurb: Your thoughts divide into competing fragments that act before they agree
limitations: Concentration checks are at −2 as competing thoughts contend for control
In tense social scenes, make a Wisdom save or speak a prophetic fragment aloud on an impulse not wholly your own
After a long rest, make a Wisdom save or wake with fragmented memories of others' dreams

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Once per combat, take a bonus move or activate one Tier I Revelation as a bonus action (not both a full action and bonus action in the same turn). The fragment acting is not wholly yours — observers may hear you answer questions you were never asked.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Fragmented focus: +2 initiative; immune to being stunned. Your initiative roll may be made twice — take the higher result.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Split thought: maintain two Revelation effects simultaneously for 1 round without paying double charges. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Mind echo: reroll one failed Intelligence or Wisdom check per short rest. Prophetic fragments grant +2 to Insight when reading motives.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, act twice in a single round — second action may be a Revelation or move only. Each action uses a different fragment of your mind.

cards.name: Fate-Bound
cards.effect: LIMITATIONS: when you voluntarily swear a specific oath or explicitly accept a prophetic obligation in play, record it. Knowingly and voluntarily breaking it costs 1 RC if available and deals S d6 psychic damage; if you have 0 RC you still take the damage. This never forces you to keep the oath. When the Director presents a clearly identified foreseen disaster that you previously accepted as an omen, deliberately abandoning it without confronting its immediate consequence gives -2 on saving throws until you confront the omen, the omen passes, or you complete a long rest; this is consequence, not compelled behavior.

value.name: Fate-Bound
value.blurb: Foreknowledge marks your path, but each omen narrows the road ahead
limitations: You cannot voluntarily break a sworn oath or prophecy without losing 1 Revelation Charge and suffering psychic backlash
Major life choices may feel predetermined once you have seen the threads that lead to them
Trying to flee a foreseen disaster without confronting it imposes −2 to saves until you face the omen

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Once per day, glimpse one likely outcome before a party decision — the ally acting gains +2 to the related check or save. You must speak the omen aloud; allies who heard it retain the bonus even if the party chooses a different path.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Fated dodge: once per combat, force an attack against you to reroll as fate rewinds the strike. You must declare after the roll but before damage.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When an ally within 5 tiles would critically fail a save, you may accept the failure on yourself instead (once per long rest). The thread binds to you.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Thread of destiny: +2 to saves vs death, fate-altering magic, and effects that would remove you from a prophesied path. Once per long rest, reroll a failed death save as the Concord refuses to cut your thread early.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, declare a prophetic outcome — one ally within 6 tiles auto-succeeds their next save or attack as the Concord enforces the written thread. You must describe the outcome aloud before the roll; if the prophecy fails to come true by end of combat, you lose 1 Revelation Charge as the thread frays.

cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When an ally benefits from one of your Oracle features and then lands a critical hit before the end of its next turn, regain 1 RC, never above your maximum. One critical event restores at most 1 RC and copied attacks or staged targets do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: When you aid an ally who lands a critical hit, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Ancestral Guardian
cards.effect: A spectral guardian accompanies you. Gain +1 AC against the first attack targeting you each round and +1 on saves against charm, fear and other mind-affecting control. Once per long rest when an ally within 3 tiles is targeted by a single-target attack, use your Reaction before the roll; the guardian becomes the target instead and the attack automatically hits the guardian harmlessly, then the guardian vanishes until your next long rest. The interception cannot stop area effects.

value.name: Ancestral Guardian
value.description: Passive: spectral guardian grants +1 AC vs first attack each round and +5% resistance to mind-affecting effects. Once per long rest, intercept a single-target attack against an ally within 3 tiles (guardian takes the hit and vanishes until long rest).

cards.name: Echo Voice
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 5 tiles; telepathy with willing allies within 5 tiles
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one reroll per failed roll
cards.effect: You may communicate telepathically with willing allies within 5 tiles. When one such ally fails an attack roll, saving throw or ability check, use your Reaction and spend 1 RC before another roll is made. That ally rerolls the failed roll with +2 and must use the new result. The reroll cannot itself trigger another Echo Voice.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Echo Voice
value.description: Passive: telepathy with allies within 5 tiles. Active: spend 1 charge to let an ally repeat their last failed roll (attack, save, or skill) with +2.

cards.name: Ancestral Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; next weapon or touch attack before end of turn
cards.duration: Until end of current turn or until attack resolves
cards.effect: Empower your next weapon or touch attack this turn. On a hit, add damage equal to half the attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If that attack is a critical hit, the target makes a Constitution save; on failure it would be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Ancestral Strike
value.description: Spend 1 charge to channel a warrior ancestor. Next weapon or touch attack deals +50% bonus weapon damage and stuns on crit.

cards.name: Bloodline Sight
cards.effect: For 2 rounds you perceive undead, invisible and ethereal creatures within 6 tiles that are not behind total cover or an effect explicitly blocking supernatural detection. Those creatures cannot gain concealment or hide from you solely through invisibility, ethereal overlap or mundane Stealth while in range. This does not expose illusions unrelated to those categories.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Bloodline Sight
value.description: Spend 1 charge to reveal all undead, invisible, or ethereal creatures within 6 tiles for 2 rounds; they cannot benefit from concealment or stealth.

cards.name: Spirit Walk
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Your spirit leaves your body until the end of the turn. During the effect you may move through creatures and nonmagical solid barriers, ignore difficult terrain and cannot be targeted by attacks or effects that require a physical target. You may activate one other known Revelation at its normal RC cost while in spirit form. You cannot manipulate physical objects or make weapon attacks. At turn end choose your original space or a legal unoccupied space you reached; if none is legal, return to the original space. Your physical body remains in its original space and can still be attacked normally; damage and conditions on either form affect your one character. The optional Revelation uses its normal activation and cost: this feature grants no free Action. Ending in an occupied or illegal space returns the spirit to its body.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Spirit Walk
value.description: Spend 2 charges: leave your body for 1 turn — intangible, move through walls/creatures, cannot be targeted, may cast a Revelation through your spirit at full range.

cards.name: Echo Armor
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.frequency: Damage reduction always; death prevention 1/short rest
cards.effect: Reduce the first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by PB, minimum 0. Once per short rest, when damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP instead. The prevention removes no Wounds and cannot trigger if another effect has already prevented that same reduction to 0.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Echo Armor
value.description: +10% resistance to non-magical damage. Once per short rest, when reduced to 0 HP, an ancestral echo absorbs the blow and leaves you at 1 HP.

cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies of your choice within 3 tiles
cards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. At the end of that turn it repeats the save, ending Dread on success; failure extends Dread one final round. This is fear-based and a creature immune to fear is immune.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Ghost Chant
value.description: Spend 2 charges to inflict Dread on enemies within 3 tiles (−10% hit chance and saves for 2 turns).

cards.name: Bloodline Convergence

Allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls, reduce the first damage they take each round by S and are immune to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Ancestor Revelation for 0 RC; it still uses its normal action type. When Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required. At most three chosen allies gain its aura. The free Tier I activation uses its ordinary action type and shares the two-Revelation ceiling.

value.name: Bloodline Convergence

cards.name: Ancestral Whispers

value.name: Ancestral Whispers
