completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP mounting or voluntarily dismounting costs half the rider's current walking Speed, rounded down in feet, from that rider's actually remaining regular movement budget. NEW: at most one mount OR dismount operation per regular turn; an extra turn does not grant another through this bridge. Rider Speed0, an unavailable required hand, incompatible body/seat, inaccessible destination or insufficient remaining movement prevents that ordinary operation; zero/odd Speed does not create a free mount. A positive Speed whose half rounds below1 costs1ft for this operation. This is ordinary movement cost, not a Bonus Action or the object's free interaction; specific independently operative features can override only their actual clause.

Begin within5ft of the actual accessible saddle/seat at a reachable height, with a stable legal approach, one usable supporting hand and an actual fitting destination. A high Elephant seat may need real steps/help or another legal movement route; an 'exotic saddle' does not lift the rider. A Prone rider first stands through its real movement cost, or needs actual assistance/another procedure; the mount operation alone does not remove Prone. The selected saddle cell/location and real supporting surface are recorded. Dismount to a visible actually free adjacent space within5ft of the relevant body boundary at a reachable level; cannot choose through a wall, onto another creature, inside an inadequate gap or across an unpaid fall. The mount retains its current movement/action/state, with no refill.

KEEP one DC10 Dexterity SAVE when the mount is actually moved against its will OR knocked Prone by one resolved source event while the rider is seated. It is a Core binary save: no natural1/20 shifts unless an actual specific rider grants them. The same event satisfying both descriptions triggers one save, not two. Several genuinely distinct events may each trigger their own save; current immunity/source restrictions apply. No save is created merely by voluntary ordinary mount travel, a harmless template rename, or by the rider's own Prone condition.

On a failed seat save the rider leaves the seat and lands Prone in the first legal adjacent space in its preregistered dismount preference or the Director's neutral accessible order. Resolve any actual height/fall under current falling rules; do not add an invented fixed damage packet just for unseating. On success retain the seat/control only if physical support remains possible. If the mount is Prone, a successful rider remains supported on the actual body but gains no immunity to its awkward seat, blocked movement or required later dismount; the rider does not automatically become Prone solely because the mount did. An impossible destination/support must be resolved as actual fall/entrapment, never occupancy of a wall. If the rider is independently made Prone, apply that condition without inventing a second DEX save; usable seat/control requires actual compatibility and TR-02. If a source physically ejects the rider irrespective of a save, use that source and the real landing instead of treating this ordinary seat save as a universal defense.

originalQuestion.title: Opportunity attacks and mounted geometry
originalQuestion.question: The Player permits an opportunity attack provoked by a mount to target rider or mount. Define rider position/footprint and area targeting without treating rider and mount as one creature, unlimited cover or a free extra attack.

completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
NEW ordinary mounted geometry: the mount occupies its own declared space. Record one saddle/seat point or fitting5ft subspace on that physical body before movement; a rider's attacks, interaction reach, line and area exposure originate from its actual seat, not every edge of an Elephant's15ft footprint. Shifting to a different accessible position on the mount requires the rider's actual movement/path/support; it is not a free change of targeting origin. They remain two creatures with separate AC/HP/conditions/attunements/resources. An area can affect both if it actually includes each; roll separate saves and apply separate damage histories. Neither gains automatic cover, a sharedHP shield or a new immunity by riding. Ordinary actual cover from a barrier/body is adjudicated from its real geometry, never presumed whole-mount cover.

KEEP the Player's specific exception: when the mount's own actual voluntary movement provokes a legal opportunity attack, the reactor may select mount OR rider as the target. There must be actual visibility and a legal reach/line to that chosen target at the departure edge. Spend the reactor's one available Reaction and make one ordinary permitted attack before completing that departure step. The choice is not one attack on each, and selecting the rider does not extend a weapon's reach to an unreachable seat. One source movement provoking both labels is one opportunity, not two. The target uses its own actual AC/defenses and any genuinely legal defensive reaction; an attack against the mount does not automatically hit the rider or unseat them unless its actual consequence moves/prones the mount or another effect says so.

The mount's valid Disengage protects against opportunity attacks provoked by its movement and therefore removes this mounted target-choice opportunity for that move. The rider's own Disengage protects the rider's own voluntary movement; it does not give the mount Disengage or erase its provocation. Rider-only movement around/dismounting from the seat uses the rider's actual OA predicates. Forced displacement or teleportation of the mount does not provoke a generic movement OA; it may still trigger TR-04's actual unseating test or another exact source effect. No new OA follows merely from turning initiative into travel. completeTransportDirections.title: Porter, bearer and pack-animal services

originalQuestion.title: Core porter and pack-animal services
originalQuestion.question: Core lists hired porter2Loads/2sp per day plus danger pay, skilled bearer3Loads/1gp per day, and pack animal6Loads/5sp per day plus feed. Reconcile these actual service commitments with reviewed body-specific pound/Load capacity, individual purchased mount profiles and actual crew assignments. Define whether the service figure is contracted cargo allowance rather than biological maximum; do not choose silently or double charge purchase/hire/feed. Keep people, wages, consent, information, fatigue and morale distinct from inert cargo.

completeTransportDirections.disposition: KEEP exact service commitments; NEW allowance versus physiology
completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP Core hired porter2Loads at2sp/day plus genuine agreed danger pay; skilled bearer3Loads at1gp/day; pack-animal hire6Loads at5sp/day plus feed. NEW explicit binding: these are contracted customer cargo allowances, not universal human/animal biological maxima or a free caste of magically stronger workers. A real hired individual must actually carry the promised allowance plus their own gear within both their body-specific pounds/Load, shape, skill, fatigue and terrain constraints. The service allowance does not increase because a strong porter could carry more; extra carriage needs an actual amended agreement and feasible body, not duplicate staffing. Core porter safe2/max4 and pack safe6/max10 are emergency offer limits, not overrides of actual capacity. Only an expressly agreed feasible extra-load operation may use them, with ordinary Burden/drag and risk; no free overflow.

A purchased Camel/Donkey/etc retains its own exact source pounds and newly authored profile Load; a hired6-Load pack service supplies one actual suitable identified trained animal for that duty, not a generic replacement with arbitrary statistics. Record operator separately:5sp hire does not automatically supply a human handler, saddle, feed, water or unlimited stabling unless an actual documented inclusive offer states them. Don't charge purchase plus hire for the same delivered ownership interest; purchase transfers the actual body under its contract, hire is time-limited custody. A loss/late-return obligation must be agreed, not guessed from source market price.

NEW service day is24 elapsed hours of custody with at most two eight-hour assigned work Watches and actual Rest. A started hire day is charged once under the actual daily agreement; repeated loading or crossing a Haven gate doesn't begin another bill. The source's named porter/bearer/pack rates take precedence over the generic1/3/10gp wage table for that actual service. Dangerous duty's default modifier is×2 where the actual contract accepts the stated danger; it is applied once, not a new doubled fee per risk adjective. Any different genuinely negotiated rate is recorded prospectively. Work already performed earns its agreed wage even when a task fails; other refund/liability terms are the actual contract.

Hireling people are members when assigned ordinary Expedition jobs and count toward12. Public carrier crew retains its own external service roster, no free party tasks/combat. Record consent, promised duties, actual knowledge, communication, pay, supplies, HP/Strain/rest, custody and departure; treatment of a worker as 'cargo' grants no compelled obedience. A wounded, exhausted or unavailable provider cannot be replaced by a fresh invisible body without actual recruitment/transfer and time. Ordinary calm loading/transfer follows TR-12; dangerous movement uses the actual route or encounter, not a second service roll that duplicates its consequence.

completeTransportDirections.title: Hauler, caravans and specialist extraction

originalQuestion.title: Hauler construct and specialist transport
originalQuestion.question: Core's hauler construct20Loads/500gp plus fuel is a service/item source, not automatically a current Tinker feature or reviewed recipe chassis. Complete its actual fuel, service, controls, capacities, body and repair against the appropriate full recipe/device records. Keep Gate caravan100+Loads/10% cargo and teleport extraction Tier×100gp per Load as conditional source services; a price table grants neither availability nor an unknown operative teleport or post-push cosmological permission.

completeTransportDirections.disposition: KEEP Core prices; NEW noncreature hauler profile; particular specialist effects remain bounded
completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP Core's bound-hauler reference20 normal/30 emergency Loads,500gp plus fuel and Tier-IV+ actual availability. NEW ordinary operational interpretation is the separate 'core.transport.hauler' profile supplied with this verdict: a transport-only magical nonartifact machine, not a living/summoned creature, class companion, AEX automaton,507/670 recipe or new PC. It has no CR, mental ability, own creature turn, attack, spell, RP, independent agenda, corpse/drop or class-command entitlement. Its actual mechanical chassis, controls, fuel and maintenance must exist; the quoted purchase is not proof of a powered available machine.

NEW complete body:120lb empty,wood/metal wheeled frame5×3×4ft,clear load bed4×2×2ft,structuralAC19,maximumHP60; normal payload200lb/20Loads, emergency300lb/30Loads, actual shape/height and total supported gross checked. Normal walking-equivalent mechanical Speed30ft/3mph, emergency over normal rating Speed5ft/0.5mph; never over either hard emergency pounds/Load cap. One real adjacent operator within5ft with access and both manipulating hands spends an Action for its one drive event per numbered round, giving at most that current Speed over a physically feasible clear firm route. No remote control, extra-Action extra drive, riding while unable to reach the controls, Dash, climb, flight, stairs or autonomous program. Outside initiative that operator works continuously. This NEW local mechanical control neither uses nor bypasses TI04's different binding/channel/BA/shared offensive-device budget: no TI04 control applies to this item by name.

NEW fuel: one actual compatible ordinary lamp-oil pint (source flask10cp/1lb) powers eight accumulated active hours of propulsion. Reservoir holds one pint; consume exact fuel proportion at actual moving time, not at a day boundary or a favorable die. Refilling a stationary machine takes one active minute/two hands and real available oil; no free flask or fuel on purchase. Fuel loss/leak/damage actual events persist. Fuel supplies only transport power, no transferable free energy/RP/spellcasting or distillate. It cannot be simultaneously burned in a lamp or counted as unspent Supply. Suspension/repair/stowage pauses use only when actually not operating, with ordinary fuel stock history unchanged.

NEW servicing: after each40 accumulated moving hours a service is due before further propulsion. A qualified Vehicles(Land) or appropriate Tinker's-tools practitioner spends one active hour on the stationary intact serviceable mechanism, with one real1gp/0.5lb ordinary grease/fastener pack and actual suitable tools; routine complete service has no roll, clears only that due-service counter and records the performed work. It restores neitherHP nor fuel nor a lost part. It cannot be performed as rest, and partial interruption retains work but no completion; loss of necessary work is recorded. Do not use an AEX maintenance pack or cost interchangeably unless its exact identity and quantities really fit.

NEW hauler restoration bridge: positiveHP functional repair requires qualified Vehicles(Land)/Tinker tools, actual compatible125gp material reference (25%of500),DC10, six active hours atHPmax60, available stationary suitable worksite. HP0 reconstruction requires original primary frame, drive unit and controller assembly, same actual material reference,DC15,eight active hours; Core task shifts collapsed binary, no critical extra. Ordinary subordinate wheel/strap/fastener replacement is allowed with real stock. Success restores recorded maximumHP/function only; failure spends actual work/materials. Missing primary chassis/drive/controller, terminal dismantling or absent wreck cannot be recreated by a quote. No fuel/service/ownership/history reset. No general magical-item salvage permission is supplied.

KEEP Gate caravan100+Loads/10% actual cargo value as a large real service: the contract must state its actual finite cargo/occupant pounds/Load/geometric limit (at least100 offeredLoads, never infinity), journey, crew, tools/containers, custody, appraisal base, danger, schedule and available route. Its own staffing is not free Expedition combat/support. Transfers and extraction checkpoints are actual events; paying10% does not bypass a Gate restriction or physically move cargo. A particular carrier's verified slot is a world input, not a new unresolved rules conference.

KEEP teleport extraction reference Tier×100gp per actual accepted Extraction Load. NEW billing rounds accepted total positive Load upward to the next whole Load once per real commissioned bill, not separately per gem; actual quote can explicitly state a different finite source service contract. Physical execution requires an actually operative acquired source effect with its full range, endpoints, persons/objects/mass/volume limits, target consent, access/cost and containment. A price table supplies neither that spell nor safe post-Opening/plane access. Missing the named actual teleport procedure is an explicit particular-service dependency; keep that service unavailable until an already-authorized procedure/endpoint exists, without blocking authorship of ordinary transport. completeTransportDirections.title: Passengers, casualties and exact transfer work

originalQuestion.title: Passengers, casualties and nested cargo
originalQuestion.question: Apply the reviewed separate effective pounds and casualty Load, including all associated equipment once. The carrier counts a passenger's melded equipment too; Petrified changes body pounds but not casualty Load. Complete shared stretcher teams, vehicle occupants, safety restraints and loading/unloading costs without turning people into generic items or equating Extraction Class with mass. FL-25 owns any old captive-load conflict; preserve voluntary passenger status and actual person agency.

completeTransportDirections.disposition: KEEP separate pounds/Load/custody; NEW stretcher and loading procedure
completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
A living passenger remains an actor, not a container item. Each actual carrier/vehicle checks its occupant/seat geometry and total effective pounds, plus the separately assigned casualty/passenger Load. KEEP Tiny1.5/Small3/Medium6/Large12 casualtyLoad. NEW Huge casualtyLoad24 completes these new Elephant profiles; this is not a hidden earlier source value. Voluntary seated passengers use the same size-based burden units for these vehicles when they are actually being carried, while preserving voluntary status, ability to act/exit and seat requirements. A walking crew member bears their own load, not passenger load on another person. An actual animal standing on a ship contributes its whole physical mass plus carried cargo once and its separate passengerLoad; the ship cannot ignore a5000lb Elephant by calling it24Load.

KEEP external-carrier weight includes passenger's effective body weight and ALL associated equipment, including equipment melded into that passenger's form. Petrified multiplies recorded base-body pounds by10 once, not gear pounds and not casualtyLoad. Personal transformed carry uses its own different active/melded rule. Do not double-count one bag on both the body and a separate cargo row, or omit it from both. Attachments, frames, blankets, harnesses and containing vehicles retain their real weights. Known pounds do not become 'unknown' to evade a carrier limit; a Load-only source may retain its explicit approximate10lb/Load fallback but is never relabeled measured weight.

NEW ordinary two-person stretcher profile5gp/10lb,7×2.5ft,one fittingSmall/Medium patient up to300lb and6casualtyLoads,structuralHP5/AC15. Both carriers require two hands. Assign actual weight/load shares before lifting (normally half the combined stretcher+patient+gear to each), verify each carrier's own gear plus share against both actual limits and actual hold/support positions. The same patient's full6Load cannot be counted as6 for each, or as0 for both; shares sum exactly once. Coordinated speed is the slowest eligible carrier after actual Burden/terrain/Strain; one carrier's Dash cannot drag the other through unpaid movement. A larger/heavier casualty needs an actually fitting specified platform/team/vehicle or source effect, not the small stretcher's magic capacity.

NEW calm loading schedule: one active minute per actual discrete fitting bundle of up to50lb, or per indivisible heavier object's actual separately feasible lift; an indivisible heavy object needs enough qualified carriers/hoist/structure and a predeclared positive duration, not a '50lb slice'. For these listed passenger/casualty transfers use two active minutes per actually supported person or ordinary mount, plus actual ramp/securement work if required. Assemble the stretcher one minute; harness/seat fitting has its separate actual time. Independent crew can handle disjoint bundles in parallel, not a shared load with incompatible pulls. Exact small item retrieval/access rules remain shorter when actually applicable. In initiative use Secure Cargo or another actually appropriate Action for EACH real attach/lift/transfer step, with bodies/hands/access and checks; these out-of-combat minute references are not an automatic action-completion promise.

A cooperative patient transfer can finish without a roll when actual safe means and time suffice. An unstable ledge, enemy interference, resisting person or insufficient control uses the actual relevant Core check/contest/attack and predeclared consequences; ordinary loading is not consent to restraint or surgery. An independently required willing-recipient spell cannot obtain willingness from a cargo tag. Unconscious/Prone/dying/Wounds and stabilization/death clocks continue during carrying. Restraints keep only their actual source effect; no default belt prevents all fall damage or incapacitates a conscious passenger. Custody transfer records sender/receiver/current location and actual body/item IDs; a new carrier or container changes neither original material age nor closed harvest claim.

completeTransportDirections.title: One route travel rate and real transfers

originalQuestion.title: Routes, convoy speeds and transfer events
originalQuestion.question: Keep the whole Core Route Quality table as evidence, including deferred specialist labels without interpreting them. Reconcile secured/known/contested/collapsed route time modifiers with Loop Progress, mapping and carrying restrictions. One failure cannot apply both overlapping loss procedures without a named decision. Complete transfers between transport methods, physical bottlenecks and whether riders spend any personal movement; no extra travel or duplicate extraction checkpoint follows from relabeling cargo.

completeTransportDirections.disposition: KEEP Core quality table; NEW bounded normalization with Loop Progress
completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP exact Core travel-time multipliers Secured0.75/Known1/Contested1.25/Collapsed1.50. They are the route's physical quality, distinct from Loop Unknown/Sketched/Mapped/Secured mapping knowledge and Risk1–5. A well-mapped collapsed bridge is still collapsed. Use FL-10's declared route-work tranche: ordinary480-active-minute walking reference at3mph, multiplied by quality and3/actual limiting convoy travel mph, once. A source-specific route mode/duration overrides that normalization only when explicitly recorded. For forced Unknown march, FL-11's480-minute nominal attempt uses this SAME travel-time normalization; do not impose an additional480 minutes or ignore a slow mule/collapsed route. There is no double movement from an eight-hour progress check plus extra hourly mileage.

Travel mph for the listed creatures is NEW current otherwise-legal walking Speed/10 after applicable burden, injury and environment modifiers, with the reviewed Strain5 half-travel modifier applied once. For watercraft use the stated actually available propulsion/current ground rate and proper route. Convoy rate is its slowest necessary moving member/puller/carrier; passengers use their carrier's movement and do not add their own Speed. A stopped/overloaded/unavailable essential carrier means no convoy advancement until actual transfer/repair/new route; leaving it is a real split/abandonment event, not a hidden faster calculation. Distance/fractionalProgress records preserve the actual route segment; a Speed change midway applies only prospectively to remaining real work, not retroactively to completed movement.

KEEP source route-threat modifiers Secured−1/Known0/Contested+1/Collapsed hard checks only where an applicable threat/route test calls for them. NEW binding to this chapter: Secured−1/Contested+1 adjust the effective Pressure for the single ordinary travel complication check, clamped0–6, not the stored Pressure and not an extra roll; Collapsed gives the actual physical difficulty+3 where that obstacle is real. FL-13's already-specific extraction DC uses its own secured−2/pursuit/exposure formula, NOT an added second modifier merely because the same secured route was described twice. A source-specific independent hazard can state a different modifier; apply no universal advantage/damage effect from a table label.

Core's Known1Load/Contested10%/Collapsed20%or reroute failure examples are retained predeclared stake references, not simultaneous automatic penalties on a Loop complication or failed Extraction check. Choose the actual consequence model before the relevant check. If a percentage loss is genuinely declared, base it on the actual at-risk current manifest, select actual complete eligible lots/portions in predeclared priority with permitted unit rounding, and never delete a person or indivisible object fraction merely to reach a target percentage. Unachievable remainder is not banked. Secured 'none' means no routine table-loss rider, not immunity to an actual separate attack, fire, loss or theft.

Changing from mount to cart to ship is an actual transfer interval under TR-12, with receivers/routes/crew ready. Preserve original cargoClass, ownership, time, locked claim and actual material IDs. Checkpoint identities are FL-13's finite itinerary events; cargo renaming or setting transportMode again does not re-cross one. A genuinely new border/route exit/physical handover can be a declared distinct checkpoint, not an unbounded on-change callback. Source Living/Changed and Pact Interdiction labels remain literal specialist/deep-setting receipts with unknown specific route execution where absent; this chapter does not invent their geography, cause or permissions.

completeTransportDirections.title: Living recovery, structural repair and rescue

originalQuestion.title: Injury, recovery, repairs and rescue
originalQuestion.question: Living mounts use their actual creature HP/conditions, death significance, food/rest and healing rules. Vehicles use their actual structural damage and approved repair scope; payment or a repair check cannot restore a dead animal or missing chassis. Decide each named source's destruction/stranding and rescue outcomes, including actual time and transport of a disabled mount. Preserve the 220-item equipment approval without promoting these remaining profiles.

completeTransportDirections.disposition: KEEP separate creature/object rules; NEW bounded defaults for new profiles
completeTransportDirections.authoringWording:
Living mounts use their actual creature HP, currentWounds/conditions, Hit Dice, rest eligibility, nutrition, injuries, healing caps and significance/lifecycle. Positive healing can end actual dying as its source permits; no repair check, quarter-price bill, insurance payout, stable or purchased replacement animal revives the dead individual. The NEW ordinary significant-mount template differs deliberately from the actual Ranger Beast HP-only exception and from no-resource finite creations. A mount killed under the ordinary actual lifecycle leaves only its genuine permitted remains; harvesting uses the once-only existing procedure, not its purchase value or carrying rating as a resource table.

Objects use their structuralHP, real material compatibility and current generic object defenses, not creatureWounds, Death Saves or two simultaneous Integrity penalties. For positiveHP or a genuinely reparable mundaneHP0 main body, KEEP trained appropriate tool self-repair: actual25%undamaged applicable mundane body/material reference,DC10,active time=max(1hour,recorded maximumHP/10hours),Core shifts collapsed binary. A ship300HP therefore needs30 actual work hours, not one Watch or thirty separate restoration awards. Table/vehicle type requires actually appropriate carpenter/smith/vehicle tools and workable support/dry access, not any possession labeled Toolkit. An actual complete service quote at the source10%/15%price is alternative pricing for real qualified work, not an added25% charge; recipe-magical tools retain their exact reviewed restoration rules. The NEW Core hauler has TR-11's separate explicitly authored magical repair bridge, not free mundane dismantling.

Success restores only that same item's currentHP to its existing permitted maximum/function; no missing main chassis, original identity, lost contents, fuel, charges, service interval, magical imprint, flaws or closed source claims are restored unless the actual rule expressly does so. Compatible subordinate parts can be supplied once with real IDs/mass/cost; primary members required by the profile must survive. Failure spends actual work/materials; another ordinary permitted attempt needs new work/materials, not a free reroll. Deliberately dismantled terminal sources remain terminal, not merelyHP0. Recipe/source clocks and actual custody continue during service, storage and repair.

For each new drawn frame/haulerHP0 disables its normal transport and strands the real load pending actual unload/transfer/tow/support. For each new afloat watercraftHP0 uses the catalogue's once-only10-minute flooding/evacuation deadline and the one finite five-minute emergency-shoring attempt: two real workers, one appropriately trained, actual1%reference/min1gp patch supplies,DC15binary-with-Core-shifts. Success holds disabled afloat status60minutes from completion, restores noHP and grants no renewed propulsion; failure leaves the old deadline. The same rupture cannot renew this by repeating the repair label. A real grounding/dock/hoist can support the still-present wreck for full restoration; unsupported water/fall/drowning/exposure uses actual existing procedures.

Rescue never creates a convenient lifeboat, fresh crew, free stretcher, living survivor or lost item. Use actual positioning, available tools/persons, source body/cargo masses and elapsed deadlines; ordinary bounded cargo rescue uses FL-14 when appropriate, encounter rescue uses paid Actions/current threat. Insurance money compensates only an eligible recorded loss and cannot repurchase inaccessible unique bodies automatically. All29 new profile candidates must include at least one admission, overload, control-loss, interrupted movement, damaged/zeroHP, real rescue/repair and provenance-preservation example by family; these are authored expectations pending exact candidate review, not live transport tests.

operational.primaryConstituents: original main frame, principal axle/runner set and bed structure; subordinate wheels, pins, harness fittings or brake pads can be replaced by actual compatible stock
operational.zeroHP: Broken, stops useful self/drawn transport; retains wreck, mass, passengers and custody. No automatic occupant damage from mere HP0. Real collision/fall/dislodgement is a separately declared event. Reaching0 does not erase salvage or restore original frame.
operational.repair: TR-14 ordinary structural repair with source-specific cost/time and original main body; not creature healing. No equipment Integrity track in parallel.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: Each finished body has enhancement +1, maximum 1 charge(s), and acid as its sole charge damage type. An admitted actual weapon adds +1 to its eligible item accuracy comparison and +1 ordinary flat weapon damage once per hit; its unsuppressed ordinary B/P/S damage is magical. Charged Strike costs one Action and one charge before its single actual weapon attack; a hit adds 1d6 acid to that attack's damage event. It is not the Attack Action and grants no Extra Attack; an ordinary critical doubles dice, never flat bonuses. An admitted armor suit supplies +1 in equipment.defense-enhancement only while its worn armor formula is selected. Typed Guard spends a Reaction and charge on a positive resolved acid damage component, after defenses but before HP/positive-damage triggers, reducing it by 1d6 to a minimum of zero. Every other admitted carrier uses Typed Pulse: Action, one charge, one manipulating hand, one perceived creature or physically compatible object within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed +5 nonspell attack, hit 2d6 acid, no ability/PB/flat enhancement added again. Only the profile belonging to the registered body is available. These activations spend no RP, do not enter spell cadence and cannot be Counterspelled. Charges refill to maximum only at an eligible actual campaign 06:00 dawn under EN-06; suppressed/missing/zero-HP items miss that event, with no catch-up or local-sunrise/transfer reset. Titles supply no unprinted flight, command, healing or class focus. EN-01–10 and AC-07 supply the full use and comparison procedures.

paragraphs.text: Choose before any work: EN-armor: Existing Standard Medium chain shirt default; other registered ordinary armor suits retain their exact source body. 50 gp, 20 lb, ordinary B15, structural AC 19, dimensions 30 × 22 × 6 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

paragraphs.label: Before creation
paragraphs.text: Reserve 1 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

paragraphs.label: Creation check and work
paragraphs.text: Enchanting level 4; INT with actual Enchanter's tools training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 12. Untrained otherwise eligible level 1–4 uses no tool PB and disadvantage; trained recipe eligibility is max(4, trade level), with actual formula access. Source duration 8 hours; operational 480 active minutes, or 360 for an eligible Forge Dwarf. The included first stable phase is 15 minutes (15 for that Dwarf); remaining work is 465/345 minutes respectively, in declared phases of at most 480 minutes. Only actual incorporated inputs stabilize; raw/returned catalyst clocks continue. Interruption loses unfinished-phase progress, not costs or completed work.
