profiles.operationalStatus: NEW SOURCE-AUTHORING PROFILE; exact candidate not yet approved

operational.provenance: All size, mass, abilities, natural AC, HP/Hit Dice, senses, behavior, supply quantities, draw capability and reference level below are NEW provisional game values, not inferred anatomy/Strength or external bestiary statistics. Source purchase price, walking Speed and carry pounds alone are retained numbers.

hitDice.restUse: real remaining dice and ordinary creature rest/healing limits; fixed maximumHP is this NEW profile, not regenerated from a class table

operational.saves: ability modifier only unless an actual later source grants proficiency; current Wounds/conditions apply
operational.initiative: DEX modifier plus actual lawful modifiers
operational.senses: ordinary sight, hearing and smell subject to actual light, line, distance/noise; no darkvision, blindsight, special detection or automatic advantage
operational.cargoLoadProvenance: NEW explicit profile Load cap independent of Strength; not claimed source value
operational.burdenedAtLoadOrPounds: positive supported load at least half the respective limit; one Burdened speed penalty, not two for the same state
operational.hardCarryAdmission: must meet both pounds/Load and physical fit; no routine movement above either full cap
operational.riderSizeRule: at least one size smaller; saddle and actual body compatible; both personal gear and rider equipment count
operational.drawLimitProvenance: NEW separate trained-harness capability on firm rolling surface or appropriate ice/snow runners; never a five-times Strength inference
operational.drawMovement: minimum actual puller speed and vehicle cap; a gross draw above half the combined draw rating also causes the one Burdened speed penalty. Loads on a puller and towing constraints are separately checked; the same named penalty is not doubled. No slopes, broken axles or impassable terrain waived.

attack.name: Kick
attack.activation: Action on its own independent regular turn only; one attack
attack.critical: Core natural20 doubles damage dice only; natural1 misses

operational.otherActions: independent actual creature may use physically compatible Core Actions; controlled ridden Action list is Dash, Disengage, Dodge only; no Multiattack or automatic opportunity attack while controlled
operational.deathRule: NEW default registered Expedition mount is significant and uses ordinary Core Wounds/dying/death saves. Mark significance before an encounter; no retrospective designation to dodge death. A later actual Ranger Beast bond uses its expressly different HP-only/immediate-death lifecycle instead.
operational.training: Actual ride/cargo/harness/armor training recorded separately under TR-02/07. Purchase name/price is not proof of present training, willingness or health. War-named template may be sold with documented combat habituation but gains no new controlled attack.

dailyFeed.meaning: NEW one animal-day sold feed quantity for this template at the printed5cp daily reference. Actual species-compatible stock must be supplied; no fodder-to-meat conversion or infinite vendor stock.

operational.foodCare: Use these NEW animal quantities instead of the human Small/Medium/Large Supply basket, with actual safe water and continued rest. Do not add human lamp oil demand to an animal. Unmet daily food/water gives at most1 ordinary expedition Strain for that day; no additional duplicate failure per missing component. No automatic desert-fasting trait.
operational.threatReferenceProvenance: NEW encounter-budget comparison only, not a CR, character class level, Ranger acquisition authorization or XP award
operational.sourceCR: absent; retain absence, and any actual CR-gated ability needs its genuine source/profile predicate rather than treating referenceLevel as CR
operational.custody: actual individual creature ID and original body history; Donkey or mule is one selected individual, not two. Purchase, hire, boarding, battle loss, rescue, bond and sale preserve that history.

operational.priceRule: 4× the selected Standard ordinary armor baseline price; this exact barding rule replaces, not multiplies again by, the general Large price multiplier. A genuine separately sourced grade/fit contract must identify its own rule, never be inferred.
operational.massRule: NEW actual selected baseline armor mass×2 Medium,×4 Large,×8 Huge. Smaller sizes need their own actual fitted model, not a placeholder. The source weight remains null.
operational.maximumHPRule: reviewed base armorHP×1 Medium,×2 Large,×4 Huge (Huge NEW); actual existing workmanship/grade rules apply once
operational.armorRule: actual selected armor AC formula, Dex cap, STR requirement, Stealth penalty and other printed properties; choose among eligible AC formulas under equipment rules, never add its AC to naturalAC
operational.wearerTraining: TR-07 animal armor-category habituation grants only ordinary fitted wearing competence for that category; not a humanoid/class proficiency or new armor source
operational.equipping: actual armor don/doff time from that reviewed model, with one capable helper occupied; no instant barding or resized armor on transformation
operational.capacity: actual mass counts on mount; no cargo space or extra carry rating
operational.repair: actual sized barding-body value and generic armor rule; not the whole animal price/HP
operational.primaryConstituents: actual armor main body and creation history, not an invented virtual rating

profiles.name: Carriage
profiles.operationalStatus: NEW SOURCE-AUTHORING PROFILE; exact candidate not yet approved

operational.provenance: Price retained; Cart maximumHP30 binds the reviewed ordinary cart body. Every other listed body quantity/geometry/handling number is NEW. No passengers, animals, harnesses, operators or contents are included in price.
operational.speedRule: minimum current fitted puller Speed and cap. Each actual puller draw rating, combined gross vehicle+payload draw limit, route fit, stability and terrain must pass. One named Burdened penalty applies when either carried or gross-draw threshold qualifies; no duplicate penalty for the same mount.
operational.terrain: firm wheel-supporting route; no ordinary climbing, stairs, ladders, swimming or unsupported gaps
operational.operatingFootprint: vehicle envelope plus actual puller footprint and at least5ft forward harness gap; route must contain all real widths/heights/turning space
operational.turning: one90-degree turn needs traveled distance at least the vehicle length and a clear swept envelope; sharper/blocked maneuver needs an actual separate route/work plan, not an automatic check
operational.controls: driver uses one Action per regular turn in tactical operation to guide/brake using the actual reins/lever and one hand; NEW manual brakes are included. Pullers expend actual movement in the linked drive event. Driver cannot claim a separate mounted turn for a pulling animal or duplicate movement by changing drivers. Outside initiative driving is continuous actual work, not rest.
operational.movementEvent: one linked vehicle/puller movement event per numbered round; resolve after required current driver Action and puller movement budgets are available. No future crew Action is presumed. All contributing budgets spent once. No vehicle Dash/Disengage/Reaction/attack; actual pullers have only their legal creature Actions.
operational.loadingRule: TR-12, real necessary handling; setup harness is additional, no free load/receivers
operational.brake: actual controlled stop at end of paid move; uncrewed/unhitched vehicle at rest stays at rest unless terrain/force actually moves it; no generic magical parking
operational.primaryConstituents: original main frame, principal axle/runner set and bed structure; subordinate wheels, pins, harness fittings or brake pads can be replaced by actual compatible stock
operational.zeroHP: Broken, stops useful self/drawn transport; retains wreck, mass, passengers and custody. No automatic occupant damage from mere HP0. Real collision/fall/dislodgement is a separately declared event. Reaching0 does not erase salvage or restore original frame.
operational.repair: TR-14 ordinary structural repair with source-specific cost/time and original main body; not creature healing. No equipment Integrity track in parallel.

profiles.name: Sled
profiles.operationalStatus: NEW SOURCE-AUTHORING PROFILE; exact candidate not yet approved

operational.provenance: Price retained; Cart maximumHP30 binds the reviewed ordinary cart body. Every other listed body quantity/geometry/handling number is NEW. No passengers, animals, harnesses, operators or contents are included in price.
operational.speedRule: minimum current fitted puller Speed and cap. Each actual puller draw rating, combined gross vehicle+payload draw limit, route fit, stability and terrain must pass. One named Burdened penalty applies when either carried or gross-draw threshold qualifies; no duplicate penalty for the same mount.
operational.terrain: snow/ice or actual compatible runner surface only; not a wheeled road vehicle
operational.operatingFootprint: vehicle envelope plus actual puller footprint and at least5ft forward harness gap; route must contain all real widths/heights/turning space
operational.turning: one90-degree turn needs traveled distance at least the vehicle length and a clear swept envelope; sharper/blocked maneuver needs an actual separate route/work plan, not an automatic check
operational.controls: driver uses one Action per regular turn in tactical operation to guide/brake using the actual reins/lever and one hand; NEW manual brakes are included. Pullers expend actual movement in the linked drive event. Driver cannot claim a separate mounted turn for a pulling animal or duplicate movement by changing drivers. Outside initiative driving is continuous actual work, not rest.
operational.movementEvent: one linked vehicle/puller movement event per numbered round; resolve after required current driver Action and puller movement budgets are available. No future crew Action is presumed. All contributing budgets spent once. No vehicle Dash/Disengage/Reaction/attack; actual pullers have only their legal creature Actions.
operational.loadingRule: TR-12, real necessary handling; setup harness is additional, no free load/receivers
operational.brake: actual controlled stop at end of paid move; uncrewed/unhitched vehicle at rest stays at rest unless terrain/force actually moves it; no generic magical parking
operational.primaryConstituents: original main frame, principal axle/runner set and bed structure; subordinate wheels, pins, harness fittings or brake pads can be replaced by actual compatible stock
operational.zeroHP: Broken, stops useful self/drawn transport; retains wreck, mass, passengers and custody. No automatic occupant damage from mere HP0. Real collision/fall/dislodgement is a separately declared event. Reaching0 does not erase salvage or restore original frame.
operational.repair: TR-14 ordinary structural repair with source-specific cost/time and original main body; not creature healing. No equipment Integrity track in parallel.

profiles.name: Galley
profiles.operationalStatus: NEW SOURCE-AUTHORING PROFILE; exact candidate not yet approved

operational.provenance: Price retained; EVERY mass,HP,geometry,draft,crew,seat,cargo,propulsion and Speed number is explicitly NEW provisional game-profile authorship. No outside vessel stat block, inherent weapons, crew or cargo imported.
operational.inventoryIncluded: actual hull, principal mast/sail/rigging where sail mode exists, oars/rowlocks for stated oar mode, ordinary rudder/tiller and mooring lines. No crew, food/water, personal gear, cargo, weapons, lifeboat, magic or elemental power.
operational.crewGate: one designated trained Vehicles(Water) helmsman for hazardous navigation; actual capable crew meet each mode minimum and work continuously. Calm ordinary paddling/rowing may be physically attempted untrained without automatic penalty; uncertainty uses TR-09 actual check. Source-specific proficiency gates override.
operational.movementEvent: one vessel drive event per numbered round after a current helm Action and all required actual crew contributions for that mode are available. One person may satisfy rowboat helm+oar in one combined Action, otherwise each required crew member is distinct. Resolve after the last necessary contributing turn/Action, rechecking current feasibility. Contributions cannot also make attacks/Help/guard/beneficial rest. Extra Actions/extra turns or a new helm do not make a second event. No native vessel turn,Reaction,Dash,Disengage or attack.
operational.travel: actual continuous staffed labor on FL-03 clock; speed is one active hour basis, not miles per second. Crew shifts need real people, food and rest. Passengers can perform compatible limited activity only if real movement/environment permits; no automatic rest or full workshop.
operational.currentWind: actual route must supply water-current vector and sail feasibility. No stated current defaults to0 in the synthetic model only, not proof of calm seas. Sail calm or directly unsupported wind course gives0 self-propulsion; oars can still work if supplied. Ordinary usable wind gives stated sail speed; declared adverse-but-usable conditions halve it. Stronger weather needs actual hazard stakes, not an automatic new storm. Tactical actual current displacement is separate from own propulsion; countercurrent subtracts along route, minimum0 ground progress, with actual drift retained.
operational.turning: clear swept envelope required; a90-degree heading change requires at least one hull-length traveled and sufficient water/clearance, or an actual stationary line/anchor maneuver taking10 active minutes with working crew. No instant spin through walls.
operational.docking: actual slow approach, available berth/bank, water depth, lines and capable receiver/crew. Uncontested calm docking needs no roll; hazardous approach uses declared Vehicles(Water) DC and failure under TR-09. Load/unload is extra real handling. Mast lowering is not free; separate actually feasible20-minute crew operation, mast/clearance accounted during it.
operational.primaryConstituents: original principal keel/hull frame and steering body; original primary mast/rig where needed to restore that same sail assembly. Compatible planking, cloth sails, ropes, oars and subordinate fittings may be replaced with actual stock, not invented from a cost quotation.
operational.zeroHP: Broken and propulsion disabled. If afloat and no specific different destruction source governs, NEW begins one10-minute flooding/evacuation deadline; at it the wreck becomes submerged/stranded according to actual depth/bank/support, not deleted. Occupants receive actual fall/swim/drowning/escape procedures, not automatic death or shared hull damage. Repairing, touching or renaming the hull cannot reset that event.
operational.emergencyShoring: NEW once per actual hull-breaking damage episode: two capable workers, at least one trained Carpenter tools or Vehicles(Water), real compatible patch/bracing material priced at1%undamaged body reference (minimum1gp),five uninterrupted active minutes before the flooding deadline; DC15 appropriate tool task,Core collapsed binary. Success keeps that same disabled hull afloat for60 minutes from completion, withoutHP,propulsion or a new seaworthy status; failure spends work/materials and does not alter deadline. It cannot be repeated on that same rupture to bank time. Grounding/towing to genuine support may permit later full repair.
operational.repair: TR-14 actual structural repair, full required original body, trained suitable toolkit, dry/supportable worksite; generic25%body material reference/DC10/max(1h,maxHP/10h) unless a specific actual repair authority differs. Core complete service quote10%/15% is an alternative, not another material charge. No repair while the purported workpiece is irretrievably absent.

blocks.text: Your alignment relative to an NPC's alignment can also affect social interactions:

Remember that Good and Evil alignments are fundamentally incompatible in Aethel, while Harmony and Discord can work together despite tension. Neutral characters can bridge these divides, serving as mediators between opposing forces.
These reputation and alignment systems add depth to social encounters in Aethel, making your character's standing in the world and moral choices mechanically significant beyond combat situations.

Your Reputation reflects how you are perceived by the various factions, settlements, and influential figures across Aethel. It is a dynamic score, influenced by your background, actions, alignment, and affiliations. High reputation with a group can unlock quests, provide discounts, grant access to restricted areas, or earn you valuable allies. Conversely, low reputation can lead to hostility, suspicion, increased prices, or outright refusal of service.
Starting Reputation: Your chosen Background often provides a starting positive or negative reputation with specific groups relevant to your past.

Gaining/Losing Reputation: Completing quests, making significant choices, demonstrating your alignment through actions (helping the needy vs. exploiting the weak), associating with certain NPCs, and even succeeding or failing certain social skill checks can all modify your reputation scores with various factions.
Reputation Tiers: Reputation often functions in tiers (e.g., Hated, Disliked, Neutral, Liked, Honored), with each tier unlocking different interactions and consequences.

Alignment Influence: Actions consistent with your alignment tend to improve reputation with like-minded factions and decrease it with opposing ones. A Good character consistently acting selflessly will gain reputation with temples and righteous orders but lose it with thieves' guilds or dark cults.
Managing your reputation is crucial for navigating the complex social and political landscape of Aethel.

A Charisma check might arise when you try to influence or entertain others, when you try to make an impression or tell a convincing lie, or when you are navigating a tricky social situation. The Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion, and Reputation skills reflect aptitude in certain kinds of Charisma checks.

Deception. Your Charisma (Deception) check determines whether you can convincingly hide the truth, either verbally or through your actions. This deception can encompass everything from misleading others through ambiguity to telling outright lies. Typical situations include trying to fast-talk a guard, con a merchant, earn money through gambling, pass yourself off in a disguise, dull someone's suspicions with false assurances, or maintain a straight face while telling a blatant lie.

Intimidation. When you attempt to influence someone through overt threats, hostile actions, and physical violence, the Director might ask you to make a Charisma (Intimidation) check. Examples include trying to pry information out of a prisoner, convincing street thugs to back down from a confrontation, or using the edge of a broken bottle to convince a sneering noble to reconsider a decision.
Performance. Your Charisma (Performance) check determines how well you can delight an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling, or some other form of entertainment.

Persuasion. When you attempt to influence someone or a group of people with tact, social graces, or good nature, the Director might ask you to make a Charisma (Persuasion) check. Typically, you use persuasion when acting in good faith, to foster friendships, make cordial requests, or exhibit proper etiquette. Examples of persuading others include convincing a chamberlain to let your party see the king, negotiating peace between warring tribes, or inspiring a crowd of townsfolk.

Reputation. Your Charisma (Reputation) check reflects how well you can leverage your standing with various factions and communities throughout Aethel. This might involve calling in favors, being recognized for past deeds, or using your influence to open doors that would otherwise remain closed.
Other Charisma Checks. The Director might call for a Charisma check when you try to accomplish tasks like the following:
* Find the best person to talk to for news, rumors, and gossip
* Blend into a crowd to get the sense of key topics of conversation
In Decennium Descent, your character's reputation with various factions and their alignment can significantly impact ability checks in social situations.
When interacting with NPCs affiliated with specific factions, your reputation level with that faction can provide bonuses or penalties to Charisma-based ability checks:
* Revered (+5): You're a legendary figure to this faction

completeCurrentSocialDirections.title: Want, leverage, authority and one declared uncertainty

originalQuestion.title: Declare the scene before rolling
originalQuestion.question: Keep the Director Want/Leverage/Limit/Clock/Witness frame. Specify the actual requested outcome, who can decide it, available offer/threat, genuine opportunity and disclosed consequence. Define when no check is needed or no current approach can obtain the requested concession; a high roll does not create authority, knowledge or a missing prerequisite.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP complete Director scene frame; ADOPT NEW operational declaration
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP all five Director fields: Want (specific requested obtainable change), Leverage (actual offer/evidence/threat), Limit (what the decision-maker cannot or will not concede), Clock (real deadline and duration), Witness (who can perceive or later learn what). Record actual participants, who owns/controls the requested resource, decision authority, current relationship/source knowledge, available channel and physical setting. One NPC's role title, faction score or a high die is not proof they possess authority, money, a key, information or a spell.

NEW scene declaration: before committing time/resources and before the die, state the concrete success outcome and its actual terms; the failure outcome and any independently offered costly alternative; any extra Critical Success detail and Critical Failure consequence; the approach, skill/ability, fixedDC or opposed procedure, duration and costs. The Director can keep legitimate secret facts private, but cannot declare a feasible rewarded success and after the roll secretly require Critical Success or invent another price. Explain an observable obstacle or that the current approach cannot obtain that concession, rather than invite a meaningless die. Success never promises facts the actual source cannot contain.

No check when actual routine authority/prerequisites and willingness already settle the outcome; record the accepted terms and real performance. No check for an impossible or presently unavailable outcome; the parties may pursue a different feasible request with genuinely different stakes. A possible meaningful uncertainty uses SO-02. Player acting skill, accent or eloquence is not an extra numerical prerequisite; declaring a coherent approach is enough. A scene closes when its committed approach resolves and accepted terms, refusal or actual interruption are recorded. It need not wait for every future consequence to occur, and reopening it requires SO-07's actual change.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.title: Four degrees, three narrative possibilities

originalQuestion.title: Three narrative results and four native task degrees
originalQuestion.question: The manual asks for full success, costly success and refusal/reversal. Reviewed Core uses four fixed-DC task degrees with natural shifts and separate opposed-total ties. Decide exactly which roll procedure applies and how each actual result selects a predeclared narrative outcome. Do not import automatic natural20 obedience, extra degree benefits, hidden tie modifiers or binary-save critical rules.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: ADOPT proposed promised-success/costly-offer mapping; KEEP native opposed rule
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
Use a fixed-DC Core task for an attempt to obtain a declared concession where an actual resisting actor is not making a distinct opposed attempt. Use the Core four degrees from total−DC and normal natural1/20 degree shifts; mandatory failure/impossibility has no invented rolled margin. NEW ordinary DC references10 for a plausible modest concession within authority,13 for substantial reservation,16 for a difficult but genuinely negotiable concession,19 for exceptional but actually possible leverage. Actual precise source DC overrides. Do not add another routeTier/socialStanding modifier to those DCs unless its real source says so.

The exact fixed-task mapping is: Critical Success obtains the promised success on stated terms plus ONLY a predeclared genuinely available extra; Success obtains the promised success on stated terms; Failure obtains the declared refusal/failure, with a separately predeclared costly offer available only if the actual decision-maker can make it; Critical Failure obtains that failure plus ONLY the declared actual reversal/consequence, and a costly alternative only if expressly offered in that branch beforehand. No automatic mind control, compelled confession, magical truth, obedience on natural20, bonus standing or free resource arises from degree alone. A Success atDC is success; reserving the promised concession forDC+10 violates this decision.

A costly offer is a new real agreement at its specified price/condition, not a renamed successful check. The player may accept if able and willing, or decline keeping their unspent resources and the actual refusal. The failed roll remains failed. The offered performance takes its actual time; no reroll is needed merely to accept an already feasible stated bargain. Nothing binds an absent owner, authorizes crime outside an official's powers, spends somebody else's money, sets a player belief or supplies another procedure's willing-recipient predicate.

Use opposed totals only when two actual actors make genuinely opposed attempts, such as a particular deception confronted by active scrutiny. Declare each actual ability/skill beforehand. Higher total wins; a tie leaves the existing situation unchanged, with NO Core task natural degree shifts, invented tie bonuses or extra opposed 'critical' reward. An explicit card using passive Insight or a save retains that exact route instead. Do not select fixed/opposed/passive after seeing a die. Any already operative source-granted reroll uses its exact window/new-result rule and does not become a separate generic retry.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.title: All five Charisma skills and actual Insight

originalQuestion.title: Skills and actual information
originalQuestion.question: Preserve Persuasion/willingness, Deception/believed information, Intimidation/perceived risk and Insight/understanding, while accounting for actual Performance and Reputation skills in the Player source and20-skill foundation. Define fixed DC versus opposed checks and limits of truthful information, misunderstanding, credible threats and investigation. Insight is not a generic lie detector; identify any proposed completion as NEW.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP source skills; NEW approach matrix
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP the actual20-skill foundation and these distinct routes. Persuasion (CHA) changes a genuinely willing/negotiable decision on stated terms; Deception (CHA) attempts belief in the particular communicated claim, not a change to historical fact; Intimidation (CHA) changes a decision through a credible perceived risk, not automatic Frightened; Performance (CHA) obtains the predeclared audience response from actual performance, not a license/crowd-control spell; Reputation (CHA) makes a concrete appeal to genuine recognized credentials/name/social standing using its actual evidence, not an automatic saved-score bonus. Insight (WIS) seeks an obtainable inference about observed motive/hesitation/leverage, not universal truth detection, mind-reading or an inaccessible document's contents. Investigation/History and other actual skills apply to their own evidence tasks; do not call every financial or written task CHA/Reputation.

Apply one applicable proficiency or replacing expertise contribution. No numeric trade level, actor's several persuasive proficiencies, standing score or 'faction PB' is added without its actual rule. A claimed credential must really be known/credible to that recipient; an unknown/private reputation cannot improve a public appeal until its evidence arrives. A reputation skill result itself gives no automatic permanent standing event; SO-10 determines actual attributable consequences.

NEW skill/route completion: fixedDC is the default for a social concession or a bounded inference with no active opposing check; an actual lie-versus-active-scrutiny contest can be CHA/Deception versus WIS/Insight. An uncertain physical forgery examination is the actual INT/Investigation/tool task, not automatic Insight. A genuine threat can be opposed by the defender's declared social strategy if that is the announced uncertainty; it is not automatically a save or attack. A preexisting card using CHA or DEX+PB against passiveInsight, such as Thief Feint, retains that literal special procedure and its combat-only outcome; it does not become a full negotiation or duplicate PB.

Useful true information may settle a request without a roll if the actual authority/willingness make it routine. Misunderstanding must come from the real received channel/text/context; a successful translation does not automatically establish truth. Incomplete Insight can yield 'the observed evidence cannot distinguish those motives', not a fabricated diagnosis or forced player belief. A skill's Critical Success adds only predeclared supported information; spell/class knowledge features keep their actual available-knowledge and 'unknown' limits.

originalQuestion.title: Communication, participation and elapsed time
originalQuestion.question: Apply fulfilled LAX hearing/speech/signed/textual/interpretation and six-second in-encounter limits. Define one scene clock across speakers, interpreters and physically separate participants; roleplay length is not automatic fictional elapsed time. Actual language, sensory and source-specific comprehension prerequisites still apply. Silence, incapacity or a blocked channel cannot be erased by a social skill roll.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP fulfilled LAX in full; NEW ordinary scene-duration reference
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP LAX's actual language/mode/script knowledge, six-second aggregate free speech/signs per creature per numbered round, additional Action per additional six-second segment, actual timing of received interpretation, trained ten-minute/six-cue rehearsal and source-specific spell/class/oath channel requirements. Table accessibility or explaining intent costs no fictional Action and does not itself produce V, audible speech, a signal or violation. Fictional speech still needs its real channel and time.

NEW ordinary noncombat reference: a short request/answer with minimal exchange takes one actual minute; a negotiated concession/evidence presentation uses ten minutes; a formal complex negotiation/hearing uses its actual scheduled time (FL-19's ordinary disputed hearing two hours). Declare which before work and adjust only for a real additional exchange/delay, not a player's actual speaking speed. Full simple routine consent may be immediate within real brief communication; these durations do not replace a printed effect's Action or five exchanges. Every participant's meaningful contribution consumes actual concurrent time, not a separate ten-minute world advance per person.

An interpreter must perceive/understand the original and then deliver a form the recipient can perceive/understand. A ten-minute scene can include its serial renditions within those ten minutes only if the actual exchange fits; don't promise instantaneous full two-way translation or count an already ten-minute source speech AND its rendition in ten minutes without time for both. A3-second warning followed by3-second rendition reaches the final listener at6 seconds, not before. Multiple relays or long exchanges can need actual extra time and Actions. Late delivery cannot backdate a modifier, consent or save prerequisite; no interpreter supplies the caster's V, new fluency, mental link, unknown proper-name meaning or authenticated source truth.

Deafened does not by itself prevent speaking/V; Silenced does prevent ordinary deliberate speech and actual V/Chants/command words, not thinking or separately legal signs/mental effects. Silence the Caster's narrower reaction-component window remains narrow. Losing one overlapping prohibition does not remove others. Maintain actual own-hand/sight/line/distance/hearing requirements for cues and telepathy; an oral instruction cannot reach a closed soundproof compartment by a skill roll. Form-specific speech limits and LAX's bounded Oracle/Paladin meaning bridges remain their own exact exceptions. No class/ordinary/innate/recipe source is merged by a shared spell name.

originalQuestion.title: Assistance, repetition and changed leverage
originalQuestion.question: Define eligible assistance and group participation under the current Help/action rules, and whether a second attempt with unchanged facts is available. One scene should not become unlimited independent retries by rotating speakers. State what genuinely changed evidence, cost, deadline or approach makes another attempt meaningful; preserve paid resources and prior consequences.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP in-initiative Help; ADOPT NEW outside-initiative completion
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
In initiative KEEP actual Help Action and its actual next-regular-start expiration. A useful helper must make the concrete contribution, with required position/channel/tools/information; no social summary waives that Action or extends the expiry until a later convenient check. Multiple sources of advantage do not stack and any advantage/disadvantage cancels under Core. A feature requiring an actual hearing ally or a target in reach remains separate.

ADOPT NEW outside-initiative Help: the helper participates usefully throughout the relevant actual work interval through resolution and supplies advantage on that one check. Their time is occupied and cannot also support incompatible guard/travel/rest/research work. Require the actual language/access/knowledge/tools for that contribution, not a universal new proficiency prerequisite where Help has none. If a specific exact long task instead defines numeric trained assistants/caps, use that specific procedure rather than also this social advantage. Being present, paying a fee or holding a stronger tool alone is not Help. One helper cannot simultaneously participate fully in two negotiations in separate rooms.

One committed approach on the same actual uncertainty receives one resolution. Rotating speakers, repeating a sentence, changing recordID or asking every party member to roll does not create retries. A genuinely new offer, new authentic evidence, changed audience with real authority, newly changed deadline or meaningfully different method can create another actual uncertainty, with the change recorded and new stakes/time before the next roll. Previously refused/paid/consumed consequences remain; a new successful approach does not refund the first offer or restore hidden deleted evidence. A source-authorized reroll, such as the actual Shattered Mind Boon IV failedINT/WIS reroll, retains its cost/window/new-result rule; it is not an unlimited speaker retry or a new scene cap.

KEEP actual Frightened's visibility-dependent check/attack disadvantage and its continuing unwilling-approach restriction; ordinary successful Intimidation applies only the predeclared concession, never that condition automatically. An effect's absence of shared-language requirement is not silently replaced by one; actual hearing/seeing/components still govern where printed.

Use only a legitimately acquired currently operative exact spell/class/oath/item effect, with its real activation,cost,range,target/save,resistance/immunity,concentration,duration,awareness and ending rule. Ordinary social resolution neither substitutes for a spell save nor recreates a payload the target resisted. An actual charm/control immunity blocks what it actually names, not all persuasion. A source that permits refusal/backlash does not become compulsory surrender through SO-02. Keep the412 reviewed/436 pending ordinary authored index and runtime-selection boundary; pending comparison spells/feats are not enabled here, and the136 standalone procedures cannot be truncated to a lossy legacy schema.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.title: Agreements do not manufacture authority or player consent

originalQuestion.title: NPC agreement and player table boundaries
originalQuestion.question: Preserve actual authority, non-negotiable limits and the reviewed Session Zero agreement when characters bargain, threaten or disagree. completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP actual NPC limits and Session Zero
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
An agreement records the parties actually agreeing, their actual authority/property, deliverable, consideration, timing, communication, witness and remedies. A clerk who can grant supervised access cannot transfer their employer's ledger; a guard with a key cannot bind an absent owner to a sale unless genuinely authorized. Passing a check wins the declared feasible concession, not a new power to perform the impossible. Conditions and later actual breach are recorded as events, not retroactive failed dice.

Player table consent remains the reviewed Session Zero procedure, not a character skill contest. Do not impose a fictional punishment for pausing/skipping or communicating an accessibility/boundary need. Ordinary social play can pressure an NPC within the actual fiction, but does not assign a player's beliefs, compelled acting, willingness to a separately willing-target effect or agreement to prohibited PvP. The player can describe their character's actual response without performing a voice. Explicit source control effects still use their own actual player-agency/refusal constraints.

A conditional costly agreement needs the actual payer to accept and fund it; it is not automatically deducted on Failure. An absent person, unavailable item, forged receipt or unknown text cannot supply the missing performance. Consent to an audience or carriage is not consent to spellcasting, surgery, restraint, ownership transfer, dangerous work or disclosure of protected history. Record every actual consent/authority predicate at the time the relevant operation needs it; later agreement does not retroactively legalize a spent action or counterfeit provenance.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.title: Witnessed attributed consequences and standing

originalQuestion.title: Witnesses, attributed events and standing changes
originalQuestion.question: The Director changes standing after public, significant, attributable actions and distinguishes one NPC relationship from a faction. The Loop also gives scene-based numeric caps. Route numeric resolution to FL-23 and its preservation addendum; complete actual witness/evidence/event recording, timing and independent faction responses without assuming every rumor is true or globally known.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP Director event standard; ADOPT FL-23 signed accounting
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
A standing event needs an actual significant attributable act and a real route by which the relevant institution learns of it. Record originating event, subject actors, known witnesses/documents, what each recipient perceives, receipt time, institution's actual interests/authority and established fact versus fallible report. 'Public' means actually exposed to a relevant audience or subsequently documented to it, not omniscient notice by all44 registry categories. A privately rescued individual may alter their own relationship immediately without updating an institution that has never heard of it.

Use FL-23/RP-A06's exact proposed/applied signed scene change and source-version rules. The same deed reported five times is one underlying cause for that institution, not five+1s. Different institutions can have different real responses when their interests and evidence actually differ; a registry description/shared category name is not proof of alliance/enmity. A lie believed by a real institution can produce an actual fallible response, marked as belief/report, without overwriting the historical act. Correcting it later is another recorded evidence/response event, not silent deletion or automatically opposite arithmetic.

No successful social die automatically awards standing, a license or renown; the actual performed significant public outcome can support its declared event. Failed persuasion can still accompany a genuinely witnessed good deed, but its significance and attribution are not invented to compensate a poor roll. Cap ordinary algebraic proposed change per subject/institution/scene at±2, then the numeric scale, retaining overflow without future credit. Already earned nonnumeric title, access, debt and named privilege remains its own record with actual change/expiry terms. Delayed notification keeps its actual time and may not backdate access to an earlier purchase.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.title: Faction turns are paid actions, not return rewards

originalQuestion.title: Faction-turn cadence and paid world actions
originalQuestion.question: The manual gives up to three watched factions one action after each return to Haven/surface. Define the genuine event, fictional interval, eligibility, repeat-return guard and what actual resources/access an action requires. Rival actions must use actual routes/information/time. Prevent repeated boundary crossings or one actor on two fronts from generating free faction actions; distinguish a Director abstraction from simulated runtime.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP up to3/one action each; ADOPT NEW24-hour checkpoint and duplicate guard
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP the Director spotlight: after a genuine Expedition return, review up to three actual watched factions and one eligible action each from recruit,denounce,buy,raid,research,fortify,bargain,conceal,wait. A return closes a real declared episode with objective/outcome, including genuine abandonment or extraction. Crossing the boundary again during that same return is not another episode/action entitlement. A split team returning belongs to its actual episode/checkpoint; it doesn't create an additional whole-party return award. Actions and actors keep persistent IDs across episodes and checkpoints.

ADOPT NEW24-hour review cadence on FL-03's canonical Haven/day clock: at each completed campaign24-hour boundary, review the currently watched factions once, including a long Haven stay. This also provides a report checkpoint for their actual ongoing offscreen work while the party is absent; it never freezes the world until the party returns. Coalesce a genuine return and a due24-hour review at the same timestamp into one checkpoint. Later different genuine checkpoints are allowed, but cannot repeat a resolved action or manufacture its elapsed labor. The watch list is at most three distinct factions per checkpoint, nominated before its resolutions; swapping a fourth name mid-checkpoint does not create another action slot. A changed next watch list reveals only actual lawful history, not a retroactively staffed new faction.

An action has named responsible actors, actual starting knowledge, location/route/access, objective, committed material/coin/staff intervals, positive duration, resolution rule, success/failure consequence and completion prerequisites. A checkpoint is a review/report occasion, not free funds, an Action token transferable to the party, a24-hour time advance or automatic success. One preexisting in-progress action continues under its ID; it cannot be swapped for an instant completed action just because the party returned. If actual work completes between checkpoints its actual effects occur then, subject to the relevant process; the next report acknowledges it once, rather than backdating a new outcome at report time. Parties who directly witness the consequence need not await an administrative report to react.

NEW ordinary minimum-work references where no exact domain rule supplies one: recruit eight active staff hours seeking/interviewing one genuinely available candidate; denounce one active hour preparing/delivering one actually heard attributable statement; buy one active hour arranging/executing one actual available bill; bargain one active hour of a concrete negotiation; conceal eight active hours of an actual finite evidence/route/asset-concealment task. These are one bounded action, not unlimited recruits/goods or disappearance of true history. Research uses its actual formula/language/item/knowledge process (a generic original-evidence research question needs eight active hours and its declared knowledge task); fortify uses FL-07 actual construction; raid uses real preparation/travel/encounter/resolution, never one die to resolve an absent battle; wait records actual interval/status and does not itself create money/healing/knowledge. Exact shorter/specific source procedures still govern their particular operation and cannot be layered with a free faction outcome.

Routine uncontested feasible actions complete without invented rolls; contested/risky actions use their actual social/task/route/encounter procedure. One worker can't serve two incompatible fronts, healers can't work and rest simultaneously, and actual source resource caps remain. Independent staff can work in parallel only when genuinely assigned/supplied. A faction's advertised goals/backer are not an unlimited balance sheet or proof of secret intelligence. The next visible consequence must reach the party through an actual messenger, changed offer, rumor, guard presence or other observable event; preserve report-versus-fact and audience privacy. No ally/enemy/cosmology is inferred from a faction ID.

originalQuestion.title: Rival clocks and usable faction records
originalQuestion.question: Retain the full rival sheet and Depth4–8/Claim4/Grudge4/Collapse4–6 source clocks. Supply finite trigger, tick amount, duplicates, completion and visible-consequence rules; a tick cannot authenticate secret information or erase a real journey. Distinguish44 generic runtime standing IDs from actual named institutions/Expeditions with goals, resources and relations. Produce a source-linked scene/faction record and full ordinary worked sequence. No new world faction history or cosmological truth follows from these fields.

completeCurrentSocialDirections.disposition: KEEP nine fields/four clock lengths; ADOPT proposed one-event ticks
completeCurrentSocialDirections.authoringWording:
KEEP all nine rival-sheet source fields: public identity,backer,current depth,objective,preferred method,professed limit,need from the party,feared disclosure,current relationship. Add actual actor IDs/assets,location/route,known information and source,resources/obligations,ongoing action IDs and audience permissions. A generic standing category from the44-record module is not a fully defined rival Expedition. NEW campaign institution IDs may be bound through RP-A05 without declaring their world histories true by name.

KEEP clock lengths: Depth choose4–8 when the actual route objective starts; Claim4; Grudge4; Collapse choose4–6 when the actual crisis starts. ADOPT NEW one segment per distinct qualifying event per clock: Depth actual travel/support materially advancing the named objective; Claim genuinely obtained relevant proof/witness/legal support; Grudge an attributable humiliation/loss/betrayal/public accusation actually learned by that rival; Collapse an actual casualty,debt,internal conflict or exposure materially advancing that crisis. One event with several synonymous trigger labels is one tick, and repeated reports of the same underlying event give no extra tick. An information-dependent trigger qualifies at the first credible actual receipt, not at an unknowable hidden occurrence. One event may affect different clocks only through independently actual qualifying consequences, all linked to that same event.

Declare the finite completion consequence and real prerequisites when opening the clock. At its threshold resolve once only if those prerequisites actually exist; otherwise retain 'threshold reached / blocked by [specific actual missing prerequisite]' without teleporting, forging title, conjuring a resource or inventing another check. A Depth clock cannot skip the route; Claim cannot authenticate a false witness or replace an authorized hearing; Grudge schedules its real hostile action, not an immediate extra attack; Collapse can trigger the stated real withdrawal/fracture but not delete people/assets. If the actual objective was already genuinely completed, record that completion without demanding meaningless extra ticks.

Close a resolved objective with its events and actual consequence. A new clock needs a distinct new objective/crisis and fixed trigger/length, not resetting the old ID to farm claim/hostility/standing. A real reversal can change a current objective via an explicit event with retained history; no negative tick erases an earlier deed or refunds its resources by itself. These clocks are human-authored Director planning tools and deterministic record conventions, not proof that a companion simulates all faction behavior. Public records expose only known identity/events/consequences, not the full feared-disclosure/backer dossier. The supplied24 proposal scenarios have individual adopted/clarified dispositions in EX58_WORKED_SEQUENCES.json; the once-unadopted text remains preserved and this decision supplies the operational adoption.

originalQuestion.subject: Numeric scale, qualitative bands and unchanged source values

completeCurrentStandingDirections.disposition: KEEP raw values; NEW named derived-view policies
completeCurrentStandingDirections.authoringWording:
The authoritative preservation layer contains the exact original serialized bytes/decoded value/type/presence/key, source path and known version/hash, capture provenance and event history. A derived standing-v1 view is a separate field with its interpretation rule, actual subject/institution binding and evidence. Merely loading, displaying, importing or exporting data never changes the raw layer or invents an interpretation. A numeric value falling in−3…+3 is not proof of its source policy.

NEW named policies: (1) 'standing-v1' validates an actual integral−3…+3 score and existing event chain without normalization. (2) 'companion-score-v1-evidenced' may carry an actually evidenced original companion integral−3…+3 value forward identically; unknown versions, booleans, fractions, numeric strings or pre-clipped history are not certified by this rule. (3) 'loop-1.2-eleven-band-to-standing-v1' is an explicit OPTIONAL interpretation, recorded once only when that source version and institution relationship are established: old−5→−3,−4→−3,−3→−2,−2→−1,−1→−1,0→0,+1→+1,+2→+1,+3→+2,+4→+3,+5→+3. This is NEW semantic compression into the selected ordinary policy, never a claim the old values were those numbers. Preserve old labels and any independently real office/license/title/claim, not just the compressed value. Source-only institutional-authority wording cannot itself authenticate a current official's powers.

(4) 'player-seven-band-check-modifier' records the original Revered/Respected/Friendly/Neutral/Suspicious/Hostile/Hated modifier table as a nonoperative modifier-domain receipt; do NOT import those numbers as standing scores. (5) 'qualitative-five-band-initial-grant' maps a genuinely new explicit source starting grant Hated→−2,Disliked→−1,Neutral→0,Liked→+1,Honored→+2. It is not an inverse function for an existing score. An old label-only Hated represents unresolved endpoints{−3,−2}; Honored{+2,+3}; known single-point bands may be interpreted only with established source and actual relationship, all recorded. (6) unknown/unversioned/malformed records remain raw/unresolved and give no numeric modifier or newly derived active standing.

Using policy(3) requires an explicit recorded interpretation event for that character/record, not an automatic load-time migration or another owner confirmation gate for this review. When version/evidence is unavailable, leave a precise unresolved relationship instead of guessing a format from its value. A valid known qualitative relationship can still support its actual purely qualitative source transaction if no numeric operation is required; that does not reconstruct a lost numeric endpoint. No actual saved characters are accessed or migrated by this conference.

originalQuestion.subject: Unknown faction keys and malformed values
originalQuestion.question: Define a lossless authoritative record plus any derived playable view. Current normalization drops unknown keys and coerces malformed values to0; setters temporarily admit keys that disappear on the next normalize. Preserve unsupported IDs, explicit zero, absence and original invalid values for repair; unknown data must not grant playable standing. Specify a versioned migration, export/import and roundtrip contract before changing any save.

completeCurrentStandingDirections.disposition: REJECT destructive normalizers; NEW nonmutating export/import contract
completeCurrentStandingDirections.authoringWording:
NEW authoritative envelope has schemaVersion, untouchedRawDocumentBytes or an exact raw-blob reference/hash, sourceFormatVersion (explicitly unknown when unknown), subjectId, capturedAt, rawEntries with original key/value/type/presence and original ordering where available, institution-binding records, interpretation records, standing events and a disposable derivedPlayableView. Preserve unknown top-level fields and keys as well as recognized faction keys. Exact raw bytes are necessary to preserve formatting/duplicate-key/number-spelling distinctions a parsed object alone can lose. A parse failure retains the raw blob and error; it does not become an empty map. JSON duplicate keys retain original bytes and ordered occurrences and are unresolved for active interpretation until explicitly reconciled.

Absent, explicitnull, explicit0, booleanfalse, number1, string"1", fraction1.7, invalid text, hidden-to-this-audience and unknown institution are distinct states. Never coerce them to0, round1.7→2, clamp5→3, or discard an unknown institution. A valid numeric score under its evidenced source policy remains valid even if temporarily hidden from a player projection; visibility is not nullification. An unknown key can be preserved and later bound to a real campaign institution without first assigning standing. Setters/adjusters must not make it briefly active only to lose it on the next normalization.

NEW active validation: require known supported policy, finite integral in-range score, resolved actual institution/subject identity and nonconflicting version/history. Booleans are not integers for this contract. Unsupported values remain in an unresolved list with reason and original pointer; they grant no new skill, discount, access or spells. A correction supplies its exact original value/version, proposed interpretation and reason as an append-only event with expected prior version; reject stale/replayed/conflicting writes atomically. It cannot rewrite an unrelated unknown entry or omit its raw data from export.

A roundtrip raw import→view→export→import must reproduce every original raw byte/hash and all extension fields, while preserving separately added approved interpretation/history. A compact public view is not an authoritative save/export. No real save migration or call to the destructive existing normalize/applyBackground helper is authorized here. completeCurrentStandingDirections.disposition: KEEP full background wording; CORRECT Cult Escapee and scope runtime abbreviations
completeCurrentStandingDirections.authoringWording:
The complete source-bound20-background standing register accompanying this verdict preserves every original runtime mapping and every full featureSource. Its operational starting-grant rules are based on the complete reviewed background clause, not an abbreviated builder dictionary. All general guild/faith/community labels need an actual matching relationship/institution binding; being listed among44 categories does not prove membership, opposition, belief or a particular character's past.

Apply Hated−2,Disliked−1,Neutral0,Liked+1 (Honored+2 if ever genuinely supplied) once, with that event's own provenance; keep explicitly grantedNeutral0 as a real record distinct from absence. No existing unrelated/unknown keys are deleted. Reapplying the same initialized background is idempotent and grants0 further change. Conflicting simultaneous starts for one actually identical institution require a recorded scope/identity interpretation before numeric initialization, not additive averaging or a new favorable target choice.

Cult Escapee corrected starting rule is exactly: former cult Hated(−2); religious authorities actually suspicious of that past Disliked(−1); groups actually opposing those cults Liked(+1). The old religious-orders:+1 entry is preserved as the runtime source conflict, not current source truth. Its correction applies only to the identified suspicious-authority relationship. Other explicit scope completions: Arcane Academy Dropout's extra academic-factions−1 is not an additional grant beyond the actually matched formal arcane institution; Dimensional Refugee's academic-factions0 is not a universal extra neutral record; Seeker's religious-orders0 is not a second independent group beyond its actual mainstream orders; Wildling Herbalist's nature-circles+1 is not a duplicate grant distinct from the actual Druidic/wildling clause; Frontier Settler's nature-circles0 has no separate source grant and its actual frontier traders'Liked relation must not be omitted merely because the runtime map lacked it; Celestial Emissary's religious-orders+1 applies only to the source-described actually qualifying orders, never all religious orders. Preserve every runtime extra/omission as source history; don't delete current saved entries merely because the fresh policy would not generate them.

A genuinely changed background in an existing campaign does not automatically reset every relationship to a new starting value or replay new-character equipment/skill grants. For a correction/retcon of the original selection, record the intended replaced initialization, retain raw history and explicitly replay affected subsequent events, leaving unrelated keys intact. For a new in-fiction development, keep the actual existing past and create only real new attributed relationship events if warranted. This standing conference grants no background-respec procedure or new character build choices. All20 full mappings and their source scope are finite decisions; unknown actual former cult, employer, conflict, indigenous community or prophecy believers are ordinary campaign bindings, not a reason for another general source conference or cosmological interpretation.

originalQuestion.subject: Change events, scene caps and record provenance

completeCurrentStandingDirections.disposition: KEEP source event magnitudes with NEW deterministic provenance
completeCurrentStandingDirections.authoringWording:
A standing change event requires unique eventId, originalSceneId, subjectId, actual institutionId, actual cause and information receipt, witnesses/evidence versus rumor, sourcePolicy/rule version, proposed signed integer magnitude, documented campaign-defining exception if any, scene-opening resolved score/version, chronological order, applied scene contribution/score delta, overflow, resulting score/version, timestamp and permitted audience. Licenses, offices, actual debts, NPC attitudes and renown are linked separate records with their own terms. A boolean 'public success' alone cannot prove any of those prerequisites.

NEW deterministic scene calculation: keep all real ordered event records, but calculate ordinary SceneProposal as the algebraic sum of their proposed±1/±2 values; SceneAppliedProposal=clamp(SceneProposal,−2,+2). ResultScore=clamp(SceneOpeningScore+SceneAppliedProposal,−3,+3). Additional notifications recompute from the ORIGINAL scene-opening score and already-recorded events, never apply the cumulative proposal to the latest score again. A genuinely predeclared campaign-defining cap/magnitude replaces only the specified scene limit, not the scale range or past raw values. Preserve both scene-cap overflow and scale saturation; neither is saved future credit. For example opening+2 with+2proposal gives result+3/applied+1/scaleOverflow+1; later actual−2within that same scene returns result+2 rather than+1 from a saturation-order exploit.

Reject duplicate event IDs and duplicate underlying cause/institution/scene claims, stale expected versions, invented source policies or active updates to unresolved raw scores. A source-authorized correction is an appended compensating/replacement interpretation event identifying the original contribution and replay basis; it doesn't delete a real historical deed or overwrite an unrelated faction. Correctly sourced report corrections can change current beliefs through an actual later institution response underSO-10, distinct from correcting an erroneous arithmetic initialization.

The exact candidate must include the12 original probe premises as preservation regressions and concrete fresh-background,corrected-Cult,unknown-key,explicit0/null/absent,+3-label-roundtrip,opposite-scene-events and concurrent-version examples. card.name: False Life
card.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination treats you as undead unless it specifically pierces Oracle curses. Before a healing spell from another creature restores HP to you, its caster may make Wisdom (Insight) against your Revelation save DC. On success healing works normally. On failure roll d2; on 1 the spell restores 0 HP to you but still expends its normal costs. Non-spell healing is unaffected. Social hesitation from life-focused clergy remains narrative unless the scene calls for an ordinary reaction check.

value.name: False Life
value.blurb: Magic mistakes your living breath for death and answers accordingly
limitations: Healing spells cast on you without a successful Insight check have a 50% chance to fail; magic reads you as corpse-cold
Unless you suppress the curse, divination treats you as undead
Clerics of life-deities may hesitate to aid you without proof that you still breathe

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Advantage on saves vs death effects and negative energy. Once per long rest, when you would die, stabilize at 1 HP as your body feigns death perfectly.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Feign death perfectly for 1 minute — undead ignore you unless attacked; you remain conscious but motionless. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When reduced to 0 HP, remain conscious for 1 round before falling — you may move, speak, or cast one Revelation. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Necrotic resilience: +10% DR vs necrotic and negative energy. Undead attackers have 10% chance to miss you entirely, sensing kinship.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, return from death's threshold — after 1 round of appearing dead at 0 HP, rise at 25% max HP with immunity to necrotic for 2 rounds. Undead within 3 tiles treat you as kin until you act, and divination cast during your feigned death returns false results of your choosing.

card.effect: once per short rest reroll a failed Intelligence or Wisdom ability check and use the new result; gain +2 on Insight checks made to read motives.

In tense social scenes, make a Wisdom save or speak a prophetic fragment aloud on an impulse not wholly your own

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Fragmented focus: +2 initiative; immune to being stunned. Your initiative roll may be made twice — take the higher result.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Split thought: maintain two Revelation effects simultaneously for 1 round without paying double charges. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, act twice in a single round — second action may be a Revelation or move only. Each action uses a different fragment of your mind.

card.name: Ancestral Whispers
card.effect: Gain advantage on History checks and you cannot be Surprised while conscious. Once per long rest, spend 1 minute consulting your ancestors about one specific person, place, object or course of action. The Director provides one truthful cryptic clue drawn from knowledge the ancestral spirits could reasonably possess; they do not reveal unknowable future decisions.

value.name: Ancestral Whispers
value.description: Advantage on History checks and immunity to surprise. Once per day, consult ancestors for cryptic but useful guidance.

card.name: Echo Crowned
card.cost: 0 RC to maintain spirits; Revelation costs normally unless stated
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; death prevention ally within 5 tiles
card.frequency: Double-cast 1/long rest; each spirit may be sacrificed once per long rest
card.effect: Maintain three named ancestral Echoes: Offense grants +1 on your first Revelation attack each round; Defense reduces the first damage you take each round by S; Utility grants advantage on one History, Insight or Perception check per round. Once per long rest, when you activate a known Revelation, you may pay its RC cost twice and resolve it twice as part of the same action against different legal targets; copied resolution cannot duplicate resource or action triggers. You may sacrifice one currently available Echo as a Reaction when an ally within 5 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP to leave that ally at 1 HP instead, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum. A sacrificed Echo provides no passive benefit until your next long rest.

value.name: Echo Crowned
value.description: Maintain 3 passive ancestral spirits (offense, defense, utility). Once per day, cast any Revelation twice in one turn using different Echoes. Sacrifice an Echo to prevent a party member's death or restore all Revelation Charges.

card.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
card.duration: Permanent; AC benefit against one attack
card.effect: Gain advantage on Perception and initiative rolls. Once per long rest when a visible enemy declares an attack against you or an ally within 5 tiles, use your Reaction before the roll; you and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack before the end of its current turn.

value.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
value.description: Advantage on Perception and Initiative. Once per day, foretell an enemy's opening strike — you and one ally gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack.

card.name: Ledger's Memory
card.effect: Gain advantage on checks to identify undead, poison and disease. Once per long rest, touch one corpse and learn its identity if the Pale Ledger could reasonably know it, its approximate time of death and the direct physical or magical cause of death. This does not reveal the killer's identity unless the corpse or supernatural Ledger actually knows it.

value.name: Ledger's Memory
value.description: Advantage on checks to identify undead, poison, and disease. Once per day, consult the Pale Ledger for the name and cause of death of any corpse you touch.

card.name: Wound of Creation
card.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving geology, storms, earthquakes, structural stability and unstable terrain. Once per long rest spend an Action to sense the nearest significant structural weak point, unstable surface, hidden fracture or likely collapse point within 10 tiles that is physically connected to your surroundings. You learn direction and broad nature, not an automatic method to destroy it.

value.name: Wound of Creation
value.description: Advantage on checks involving geology, storms, or the Descent's unstable floors. Once per day, sense the nearest structural weak point within 10 tiles.

card.name: Lucid Oracle
card.effect: Gain advantage on saves against magical sleep and Illusion effects. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking the Veiled Threshold one specific question concerning the present situation or a contemplated course of action. Receive one truthful symbolic vision or omen. It cannot reveal another player's unknowable future choice.

value.name: Lucid Oracle
value.description: Advantage on saves vs sleep and illusion. Once per day, ask the Veiled Threshold one question — receive a symbolic but truthful vision.

card.name: Founder's Memory
card.effect: Gain advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar, the Crown of First Flame and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest after failing a saving throw against fire damage or Frightened, reroll that save and use the new result.

value.name: Founder's Memory
value.description: Advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, invoke the Crown's memory to reroll a failed save vs fire or fear.

card.name: Bloom Oracle
card.frequency: Skill benefit always; supernatural diagnosis 1/long rest
card.effect: Gain advantage on Medicine and Nature checks. Once per long rest, examine one willing creature for 1 minute and learn the broad nature of one disease, poison, curse-like affliction or bodily condition affecting it plus one plausible mundane, magical or quest-based countermeasure known to the Verdant Resonance. This identifies rather than automatically cures the condition.

value.name: Bloom Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Medicine and Nature. Once per day, diagnose any affliction by touch and learn one countermeasure the Verdant Resonance suggests.

card.name: Shadow Oracle
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; one creature within 3 tiles that you can perceive
card.frequency: Skill benefits always; fear reading 1/long rest
card.effect: Gain advantage on Stealth and Insight checks. Once per long rest choose one creature within 3 tiles and spend an Action reading its surface fear. If the creature is not protected from mind-reading or divination, the Director truthfully identifies one present fear, dread or aversion known to that creature. This grants information only and does not compel behavior.

value.name: Shadow Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Stealth and Insight. Once per day, read the hidden fear in one creature's heart — learn their greatest dread (DM provides truthful answer).

card.name: Stellar Oracle
card.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving astronomy, astrology and navigation. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes reading the sky or a divination focus concerning one specific party decision. The Director supplies one truthful but cryptic omen about a likely consequence known to the Celestial Concord. It cannot dictate another player's future decision or guarantee an outcome.

value.name: Stellar Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Astrology and Navigation. Once per day, read the sky (or a divination focus) for cryptic guidance on a party decision.

card.name: Spiral Oracle
card.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving history, prophecy and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking whether one specific contemplated action is likely to provoke a serious foreseeable disaster within the next day. The Director answers yes, no or unclear and provides one cryptic truthful hint. This does not reveal player choices or guarantee a deterministic future.

value.name: Spiral Oracle
value.description: Advantage on checks involving history, prophecy, or the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, ask the Turning Spiral whether a specific action will provoke disaster (yes/no with cryptic hint).

card.name: Aura of Authority

card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura

card.name: Heaven's Decree
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet that can hear you
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: State one simple command: Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, Halt or Release. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure, at the start of its next turn it chooses either follow the command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one object interaction, or refuse and take 3 S d6 psychic damage. Player-controlled targets always make this choice themselves. The command cannot require self-harm, confession, belief change or permanent allegiance.

originalObjects.value: Heaven's Decree — command obey or suffer psychic damage (1/rest)

card.name: Sovereign's Ascendance
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
card.effect: Choose up to 3 creatures in your aura. An allied target gains advantage on Charisma saves and +2 on Intimidation checks for 3 rounds. A hostile target immediately receives Heaven's Decree without an initial save and must choose whether to obey its bounded command or take the normal psychic backlash. Until the end of its next turn it also cannot knowingly speak a direct falsehood in your presence. This Final does not permit self-harm commands, forced belief, confession or permanent allegiance.

originalObjects.value: Sovereign's Ascendance — once per day, Heaven's Decree affects all enemies in aura without save; allies gain advantage on Charisma saves and +2 to Intimidation for 3 rounds, and enemies who fail cannot lie or disobey a direct command until end of next turn.

directions.title: One authority map

originalQuestion.title: Authority and already settled conflicts
originalQuestion.question: The older Loop includes end-turn death saves,automatic Wound triggers and control/action shorthand. Bind each to the existing reviewed Core,combat,healing and lifecycle authority rather than reopening or duplicating it. Identify genuinely unresolved domain decisions separately. Preserve the old chapter and give the final player flow one explicit governing route.

directions.disposition: KEEP reviewed domains; REPLACE conflicting Loop summaries
directions.authoringWording:
The final expedition chapter is an integration overlay beside, not an overwrite of, the original Loop v1.2. Use the current reviewed Core roll and damage/Wound/death procedures; combat timing/actions/stances; conditions/control; Strain/rest; body/equipment; creature/device lifecycle; LAX language; exact recipe scopes; and acquired source-specific class/spell procedures. The original Loop's end-turn death saves, automatic critical-hit Wounds, reduced Hit-Dice healing per Wound, Critical half Speed, broad control/action shorthand and one-hour hurried harvesting do not operate where those reviewed replacements govern. Death saves occur at the start of a dying creature's regular turn; Extra turns create none. Wounds arise from the actual reviewed one-save damage event and retain their linked injuries. Critical Wounds reduce Speed by10 and impose their reviewed healing ceiling; they do not impose the old half-Speed rule. Use the actual harvest's size/time/partial/hurried procedure, not a generic eight-hour or one-hour substitute.

Do not add Loop assistance, generic critical output, training, restoration, or 'team activity' rewards on top of an exact domain procedure. An exact recipe or spell name does not establish access, knowledge, components, current charges or permission. The 136 reviewed standalone low-rank procedures remain usable only through their complete authored representation and actual class access, not an invented legacy-runtime conversion; Blink stays null/unavailable. Supporting pending cards retain their status. Carry Core/body/equipment/lifecycle,687 internal/433 public recipe,LAX/NWX/LRX/TEX fulfillments as supplied. This conference issues source directions only; ordinary authored totals remain412 reviewed/436 pending.

directions.title: Roster, offices and real teams

originalQuestion.title: Twelve-person organization and actual team assignments
originalQuestion.question: Keep the12-person expedition cap and distinguish actual encounter participants. Decide whether optimal team-size bands are recommendations or activity prerequisites,who can act in a small expedition,NPC seats,office roles and assistants. A person cannot simultaneously lead,assist,rest and craft using the same hours. Remote team results require actual communication and travel.

directions.disposition: KEEP owner cap; NEW assignment completion
directions.authoringWording:
An Expedition has at most12 member characters, including each recruited NPC or hireling assigned an independent Expedition job. Combat4–6, Recon1–3, Research1–3, Resource2–4 and Support1–3 are recommended sizes, not prerequisites. Any capable member may undertake a physically feasible permitted solo task; a two-person Expedition need not invent ten staff or all five teams. Keep all five team categories and the five named offices. One member may hold several offices; an office grants no skill, Action, compulsory obedience, remote authority or second work interval. Leader tie-breaking concerns accepted Expedition decisions, never another player's table consent or another owner's property.

A contracted porter, bearer, guard or expedition driver counts as a member while assigned to that Expedition. A separate public ship/caravan service keeps its own crew/operator records outside that roster; its crew is not thereby free party labor or combat reinforcements. Forces above12 are distinct cooperating Expeditions with their own charters, allocations and actual communication, sharing the same world clock and finite resources. Animals and noncharacter source-bound companions/devices are not extra roster characters; an intelligent creature serving as an autonomous recruited expedition character does occupy a seat. Their actual combat participation and source caps remain independently recorded.

Before work, assign every member a primary activity or Rest and record actual start/end intervals, lead, assistants, location and intended result. Sequential shorter tasks may fill remaining time; simultaneous incompatible assignments are rejected. Generic expedition tasks permit up to3 trained meaningful assistants,+1 each; exact crafting/harvest/preservation/social/companion rules override this allowance. No office, assistant or distant scout donates a class item effect or knowledge without its actual rule and communication. Resolve parallel teams on one clock; a team whose events reach hour8 waits for other teams' events before hour8, rather than advancing the world by8 again.
