directions.title: One elapsed campaign clock and Watch accounting

originalQuestion.title: One campaign clock across all modes
originalQuestion.question: Define a canonical Watch start/end and actual elapsed time for encounters,one-hour rests,eight-hour activities,delays and parallel teams. An encounter consumes part of a Watch rather than generating duplicate elapsed hours. State partial/interrupted activity outcomes and scheduled Rest Debt processing using existing completed-rest guards. Preserve Opening/Horn numbers as source scheduling only; do not review their cosmological cause.

directions.disposition: KEEP rest rules; NEW scheduling and collision order
directions.authoringWording:
Use integer elapsed seconds from one declared campaign epoch. An Opening's start is a recorded epoch event, not a new clock for each entry. Watch w is [epoch+28800w,epoch+28800(w+1)); day d is three such Watches. Morning/Afternoon/Evening are labels for those three slots. Retain Opening2400 hours and Horn1200 hours as literal scheduling receipts only. Entry, exit, Haven, initiative and split teams never reset them. No post-Opening access or next-Cycle renewal is inferred here.

A six-second combat round, one-hour Short Rest, eight-hour treatment or delay occupies its actual interval inside this clock; do not add an eight-hour Watch again because a task completed. Log work to the second, display minutes/hours. A generic Watch activity needs480 actual active minutes for one completion check. It can carry progress between Watches if genuinely still feasible; no proportional completion award. Interruption retains recorded generic progress unless an actual event undoes it. Exact recipe phase loss, uninterrupted training blocks, treatment, rest and spell interruption retain their own rules. Guarding, spellcasting, travel, command/control, interpreting, assisting and productive work cannot claim the same incompatible seconds. Uninterrupted passive carriage is not automatically rest; an actually suitable safe berth and the actual rest conditions must qualify.

Each day schedules at most two active work Watches and one scheduled Rest Watch per member. KEEP crafting's scope: its two-Watch productive-work ceiling is not a universal ban on emergency noncrafting events in the remaining Watch. NEW: voluntary extra noncrafting travel/guard duty may replace scheduled Rest with its actual costs and Rest Debt; it grants no third crafting/training/research/harvest work Watch. Emergencies still happen, consume elapsed time and interrupt work/rest. Default Rest slot is Evening, changeable prospectively before the affected day's first assignment, never retroactively after a failure.

At an interruption of a scheduled Rest, open one debt after the emergency ends; otherwise open it when the missed scheduled Rest Watch ends. Its deadline is the end of the second following canonical Watch. Missing another scheduled Rest while indebted gives1 expedition Strain and resets that deadline. An unpaid deadline gives1 Strain once for that due debt event and leaves the debt owed; no invented Strain every second/Watch follows. Completing a qualifying safe8-hour Rest Watch clears debt even within the24-hour Long-Rest reward limit. One beneficial Long Rest per24 elapsed hours, two beneficial Short Rests between those rests, existing4-hour Morale Rest and24-hour Haven care remain distinct. Trance shortens sleep, not the eight-hour Long-Rest requirement.

At equal timestamps: finish actual physical transfers/consumption and protection endings under their own precise endpoint rules; evaluate due food/water support and blocks; complete qualifying rest/treatment events (safe Rest may clear debt); process any still-unpaid debt deadline; settle completed activity/travel; coalesce extraction checkpoints; apply once-per-event/Watch Pressure and its bounded complication batch; then run due faction/checkpoint reporting. Combat's own same-timestamp expiration/death/start/periodic ordering remains controlling inside initiative. No later narrative can backdate a supply, protection, completed rest or award. Stable recovery uses its original absolute deadline and is not replayed by a Watch boundary.

directions.title: Supply is coverage of real obligations

originalQuestion.title: Supply demand and actual nutrition
originalQuestion.question: Complete the food/water/fuel/camp-consumable interface for one daily Supply Unit. Existing servings grant only food credit and waterskins hold actual water. Define finite required quantities,partial shortages,daily settlement anchors,donation,containers and storage without charging or feeding a character twice. Preserve Small/Medium1 and Large2 source demand; special anatomy/diet and transformations need explicit source-specific treatment.

directions.disposition: KEEP size demand and shortages; NEW quantitative bill
sourceReferences: DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/COOKING_RECIPE_PLAYTEST.md: Food mass and the food ledger
directions.authoringWording:
NEW standard provision unit:2 lb ration-equivalent edible food,8 pints potable water,1 pint compatible lamp oil in its source flask, and0.25 lb ordinary nonmedical camp sundries. The food/water quantities are one Small/Medium daily demand; Large demands two. This is game accounting, not physiology. Food2 lb is exactly three reviewed Cooking servings; Large4 lb is six. Each food/water allocation names actual lots, recipient, consumed amount and timestamp. The same serving cannot fund a recipe and remain a ration. Partial ordinary ration consumption may credit its real edible mass; fractional consumption never grants a fraction of an indivisible magical meal benefit.

Supply is not a massless currency and 'consume1 Supply' is not permission to erase an unrelated inventory entry. The standard unit is a procurement basket. Daily support settles actual food/water plus the day's declared necessary light/fuel/camp operations. NEW distinction: do not burn unused oil or discard sound equipment just to reach a bookkeeping number. Oil is debited as actually burned/spent under the source lamp's six-hour-per-pint rule; sundries are debited when used. A daylight/no-flame or other actually sufficient safe plan can require no lamp oil. More darkness, heat or productive work needs the actual additional fuel/apparatus. A failed necessary logistics task leaves its actual exposure/visibility hazard and may make the affected recipient unsupported; it does not give universal hunger or automatically add a second Strain. This explicitly replaces the old all-or-nothing virtual daily Supply debit, not the Small/Medium1 and Large2 nutrition demand.

Daily settlement anchors to canonical24-hour campaign-day endpoints; a subject's arrival/departure allocates demand proportionally to seconds genuinely inside the interval. Outside-expedition needs are paid separately by actual Haven/home provisioning, never erased by crossing a gate. Fractions remain rational; no round-up per team transfer. Settlement is idempotent per recipient/day. Predeclare allocation before the deadline, including who receives shortages. A recipient below either actual food or water requirement, or lacking its necessary declared logistics support, gains1 ordinary expedition Strain total for that daily shortfall, not one per missing component. A partly fed character retains exact consumed credit but still has the shortfall. Log the shortfall block; no Strain removal in that unsupported day. At the next day, the block can clear only while a real sufficient provisioning plan is available and maintained; failure later retains/creates its own event, never retroactively refunds previously spent resources. Death/collapse still uses the reviewed Strain source rule.

Voluntary donation is a real transfer, not replenishment of the donor's food history. Exceptions remove only their actual food/water/diet obligation; they create no transferable credit, fuel, camp staff or manufactured material. Source-qualified forms retain their own diet; changing size/form does not refund food already eaten or start another day. With an actual changed dietary coefficient, integrate that coefficient over the day. Unsupported Tiny/Huge/Gargantuan nonmount diets need their actual profile; these new mount diets are supplied in TR-01/07.

For an exact procedure charging a whole Supply (not a daily living debit), reserve and commit one full standard basket when that source charges it, or its already reviewed specifically authorized substitute. For Wound treatment keep the existing one-Supply-at-start cost on success/failure/interruption. Record actual uses within treatment. Food/water genuinely consumed by the named patient/healer during that treatment may satisfy that person's daily requirement once; the procedural packet does not also remain free inventory or feed another person. No automatic double nutrition is awarded simply by logging the procedure.

Goodberry and every other supported source remain their exact recipient/quantity/cost/lifetime rules; no universal 'food spell' conversion is added. Bind exact current source access/status rather than turning a comparison name into a known spell.

NEW source-flask mass completion for exact partial-fuel accounting: retain the printed1-lb full oil flask, but bind an actual compatible ordinary specimen to0.25lb empty flask plus0.75lb for its one pint of oil. An intact empty flask remains the same0.25-lb object, with no automatic resale value or full-flask fuel credit. Where an actual reviewed particular container has another defined tare, retain that particular profile rather than replacing it. originalQuestion.title: Forage and finite local opportunity
originalQuestion.question: Resolve per-team/per-route/per-Watch Sustenance caps,actual gathered food/water versus abstract Supply,critical half-rounded-up output and repeated/parallel teams. Establish what a depleted site means and who certifies refresh. Keep actual catch/harvest donors and ingredients distinct from untyped Supply. A map or route reentry cannot mint repeated output; do not invent species/ingredient availability.

directions.disposition: NEW finite implementation of Loop yield; KEEP exact harvesting
sourceReferences: DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/director-only/GATHERING_TOOL_INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md: preserved Fishing reserve and origin boundaries
directions.authoringWording:
One generic Forage attempt is480 active minutes by a lead with actual suitable gathering implements and access, WIS(Survival) at route tier DC, up to3 meaningful trained assistants unless a specific source replaces this. Preparation must identify a finite local opportunity: site/route-segment ID, bounds, original physical food/water/material quantities, prior claims, ordinary cap S∈0..4 and a real extra recoverable reserve. A route rating is not proof that food, water, lamp oil, named animals or recipe ingredients exist. Sustenance0 allows no routine Forage award.

KEEP normal Success up to S provision-equivalent units and Critical Success up to S+ceil(S/2). NEW reconciliation of the apparently competing cap clauses: S is the normal recoverable allowance; the actual sustainable physical opportunity is an independent hard cap which must include any critical reserve. Critical extra is at most ceil(S/2) from that recorded reserve, never invented because a die succeeded. Forage awards its actual food/water/material vector, not manufactured bundled Supply. A site with enough food but no water yields food credit only. It produces a complete standard basket only if every distinct actual component exists and its lawful gathering/packing method is completed. Do not fabricate lamp oil from herbs or industrial sundries from a survival check.

All simultaneous/serial teams claiming the same local opportunity share the same unresolved claim and allowance. Select one lead/check or preregister genuinely disjoint subparcels, with their aggregate normal/extra allowances bounded by the parent's original amounts. Merely dividing names/containers/teams cannot multiply S. The current Watch identifies the resolution window; the next Watch or reentry does not regenerate the site. Record quantities taken, ruined, inaccessible, forfeited or retained. A later actual growth, replenishment, newly accessed disjoint area or delivered stock can establish another opportunity with its own lineage and quantity; map labels and a Director boolean alone do not.

Failure awards none and closes that attempt; unchanged immediate rerolls are not available. Critical Failure additionally contaminates one actual selected ordinary provision unit if a predeclared contamination hazard supports it; otherwise+1Pressure once for that cause. No invented poison/property or nonexistent victim. It never duplicates a separate actual Fishing/carcass/mining/salvage claim. The class/background exception for actually gathering during a beneficial Long Rest remains limited to its named product and real components; it does not turn the whole Rest into generic Forage480 or create a second local pool.

directions.title: Finite camps and independent safety

originalQuestion.title: Camp establishment and security
originalQuestion.question: Give each camp tier finite required materials,time,location,accumulated successes and storage accounting,including the temporary20,fortified60 andforward150Load capacities. Define whether benefits add or replace,real supply-line capacity,compromise and recovery. Camp labels do not automatically satisfy every safe/secure rest predicate or grant workshops,food,staff,land rights or evacuation.

directions.disposition: KEEP source tiers; NEW complete build/stock rules
directions.authoringWording:
NEW ordinary camp site: a legally accessible stable20×20ft area, actual drainage/weather shelter appropriate to inhabitants and room for all bodies and gear. Each build success requires a completed480-active-minute Support task, STR or WIS with an actually relevant tool/Survival proficiency, tier DC, up to3 trained assistants. Critical Success earns two build marks; ordinary Success one; failure zero. Required materials are reserved before work; install them as recorded, and a failed attempt consumes time plus only actual damaged/spent material, not a free new duplicate bill. Pausing generic unfinished work retains physical progress when feasible. No completed marks without the work. Each site has one build ledger; teams may build genuinely separate necessary portions, not reroll the same finished step.

Exposed bivouac requires no build task, has no certified storage and leaves actual exposure; it is not automatically a safe Rest or Wound-treatment site. Temporary Camp requires1 Support mark, real shelter sleeping places (the source two-person tent provides two Small/Medium places; NEW one Large place), and NEW one mundane camp fitting pack:20lb/2gp, rope/pegs/ground covering and racks sufficient for the site's20Load/200lb/20ft³ storage limit. Existing actual compatible fixtures may replace that pack through recorded quantities, not the word 'camp'. Real tents, bedrolls, tools, light and food remain separate.

Fortified Outpost requires3 total Support marks including Temporary's1 and NEW additional timber/stone/fastener build stock300lb/60gp baseline, plus actual tools. It replaces storage with60Load/600lb/60ft³, not20+60. Maintain guards, barriers and actual access. The source's 'attackers lose surprise' becomes a specific perimeter warning benefit only against attackers using that intact watched perimeter; it does not cancel reviewed Surprise from undetectable infiltration, betrayal, teleportation or unwatched directions. KEEP+1 on feasible repair task checks at the functioning Outpost, not manufacture or the cost/hour bill.

Research Station requires Fortified plus2 completed Research marks (INT with the actual relevant research skill, tier DC) and NEW desk/storage equipment50lb/25gp with weatherproof mundane record storage. This gives the source+2 to legitimate research/identification checks at that functioning installation, not creation checks, universal knowledge, unbounded sample containment or preservation. The relevant library, instruments, exact evidence, active-core vessels and particular recipe station remain independently necessary. Storage remains60Load.

Forward Base requires8 total build marks: the three Fortified Support marks, two Research marks and three additional Support marks; NEW added depot stock500lb/100gp, a named actual faction approval and a functioning contracted supply/evacuation line. Storage replaces the prior cap with150Load/1500lb/150ft³. Record line endpoints, carrier bodies/crew, departure/arrival times, paid charges, quantity/capacity per trip, risk and missed deliveries. 'Haven link' means access to that real service, not instant resupply, resurrection, safe teleport or offscreen evacuation.

These NEW default kits are mundane constructed fixtures, not independent recipes or capital food. They have no automatic salvage value. Site record names occupied sleeping places, guards and alarms, lights, care/work surfaces, closures and current hazards; 'safe/secure' is a result of those actual conditions, not the tier name. No tier invents an all-trade workshop. A Severe complication may degrade exactly one achieved tier or require evacuation when its actual damage/discovery supports that consequence. Keep surviving materials and prior marks; restore only affected functionality through one new necessary build task plus actual lost-material replacement. Exposure ends concealment/warning predicates as actually affected. Lower storage requires relocation of excess cargo, not deletion; no extra intact inventory or reset permits rebuilding for infinite rewards.

directions.title: Pressure event ledger

originalQuestion.title: Pressure changes and event identity
originalQuestion.question: Reconcile duplicated pressure clauses in abort,overcapacity,attention androute sections: state actual application frequency and stacking rather than applying the same event twice. Define source IDs for exposed cargo,ongoing pursuit and camp exposure,base-risk floor,cap6 and maximumtwo reductions. A newly exposed lot and unchanged continued carriage must remain distinct.

directions.disposition: KEEP rates; NEW identity and cohort rules
directions.authoringWording:
Pressure is an integer0..6 for one actual traveling/camped cohort on a route, with one Expedition parent and one world clock. Separated cohorts may face different real risks; splitting/merging creates no fresh pool or reduction. On merge take the greatest current pressure, retain every event/deadline and apply the destination Risk floor. A new unrelated Expedition keeps its own real exposure but cannot erase shared pursued/cargo event histories.

At an active Watch end assess each listed continuing condition once for the affected cohort: open combat/explosion during that Watch;+1 above route Capacity;+1 if any member is missing/captured or there is active pursuit;+1 for continuing after an agreed abort trigger;+1 for an exposed/known-enemy camp actually being used. Several synonymous clauses about the same abort/overcapacity incident do not each add1. Different genuine categories may add together. A combat consisting of many attacks is one open-combat Watch increase. Record per-cause stable IDs and Watch IDs.

Attention differs: each discrete cargo lot contributes+1 only on its first exposed carriage, newly revealed concealment loss or later genuine re-exposure after real restored concealment. Continuous unchanged carriage is not a new increase each Watch. A container split, transfer, new owner or reentry cannot refresh that cause. Its exposed state may still supply the single+1Extraction DC. Initial extraction surcharge is separate and applies only once as FL-12 specifies. Forced-march+2 and successful-retreat+1 retain their own event IDs; never also apply a duplicate textual restatement.

Each qualifying Counter-Ambush, genuine move onto a secured route, full Watch lying low in an actually concealed camp, or completed settlement ending pursuit can earn its listed−1, at most two reduction credits per cohort/Watch including recon and extraction-critical reductions. Conceal Trail cancels one actual pursuit increase, not all pursuit and not an additional free−1. A recorded reduction source cannot be claimed again by another office. Apply signed increases and allowed reductions once, then clamp to6 and to current route baseRisk unless actually Secured (floor0). Floor suppressions are logged, not future reduction credits. BaseRisk is1–5; an explicitly already-secured0 route is permitted as a NEW profile completion, not a general0-risk inference.

Routine complication processing occurs once per active Watch (a Watch with any actual expedition travel/work/exposure-bearing activity). A safe inactive Rest-only interval has no routine expedition roll, but actual raids/hazards/faction events can still occur. Pressure6 means one automatic Severe complication at that checkpoint, not an endless event on every observation. Actual immediate source hazards resolve at their own time; they are not invented solely by seeing a transient arithmetic6 before reductions.

NEW partial-Watch safe-exit completion: when a cohort genuinely leaves its last exposed route for a safe Haven before the current Watch ends, settle its still-unprocessed routine exposure checkpoint once at that last exposed boundary. Include only causes actually accrued so far. If that Watch was already processed for this same continuing exposure, do not process it again. Mark its Watch/cause membership closed; the later canonical Watch end cannot replay it or place a route patrol inside the Haven. A later genuine new exposure uses its own actual cause/remaining interval, not a reset of earlier causes. Archive the actual Pressure history; safe arrival does not by itself refill resources or set Pressure to0. A new descent on the same unresolved cohort history keeps relevant current Pressure/pursuit causes and the new route floor; only an actual qualifying reduction changes it.

directions.title: Total d6 severity and bounded complication processing

originalQuestion.title: Complication severity
originalQuestion.question: Resolve the source line Roll exceeds Pressure by exactly0 because of a modifier or reroll: equality is ambiguous against natural2–6 Standard andnatural1 Severe. Supply a total finite outcome table for modified/rerolled d6,Pressure0 and6. Decide one complication per due Watch versus immediate crises,and prevent a Severe complication -> Extraction Test -> Severe complication unbounded cycle.

directions.disposition: NEW explicit equality arbitration
directions.authoringWording:
Use the final lawfully selected natural d6 n and final modified total r; no reroll/modifier is granted here. Pressure0: no routine roll or complication. Pressure6: one automatic Severe, no die. Pressure1..5: if r>P, none; otherwise n=1 is Severe; otherwise if r=P and a genuinely applied modifier/reroll produced that final equality, Minor; otherwise Standard. Thus an untouched natural3 atP3 is Standard, a legal modifier taking4→3 atP3 is Minor, and a final natural1 that still triggers is Severe. A natural1 modified aboveP does not trigger under this NEW trigger-first rule. Values outside1..6 remain actual modified totals; do not silently clamp the die. This resolves the source's impossible phrase 'exceeds by exactly0' as modified/rerolled equality without deleting the source.

Before the check choose a compatible finite complication entry with actual stakes and source. NEW ordinary table by final severity: Minor chooses a15-minute real access/inspection delay OR exposure of one actual concealed lot; Standard chooses a60-minute obstruction/detour OR one actual low-priority unsecured lot placed at risk under FL-14; Severe chooses an actual encounter/forced evacuation/route closure or one severe cargo/casualty hazard with a declared resolution. No category automatically supplies an unsourced creature, damage, curse or valuable debris. An incompatible outcome is replaced before commitment, not retroactively to defeat a successful response. Patrol can lower the next actual camp complication one tier (Severe→Standard→Minor→none) once when its warning physically applies; it cannot erase an independent actual attack already resolved.

Give each root Watch/checkpoint incident one causal event ID. At one timestamp coalesce duplicate complication requests for the same cohort and physical cause, keeping the highest severity and every source reason; unrelated actual events retain separate IDs. A Severe arising while extracting may schedule one post-complication Extraction Test for the changed convoy. Mark that follow-up as secondary to its root. A complication generated by that secondary test does not recursively request another test in the same causal batch. Root requests, finite route checkpoint IDs and at most one secondary test each bound the queue. Delays advance time and may reach later genuinely new Watch/day events, which resolve once at their actual timestamps. They are not immediate recursion at the old clock.

directions.title: Route progress and mapping

originalQuestion.title: Route Progress and mapping
originalQuestion.question: Define when mapping improvements change current-Watch Progress,unknown-route Recon success versus Map Route accumulation,zero-Risk mapping and forward/backward routes. State exact legal count of reconnaissance benefits and how capacity penalties apply. Multiple officers or teams cannot each reapply the same automatic base Progress.

directions.disposition: KEEP base ratings; NEW precise advancement
directions.authoringWording:
A route record identifies directed endpoints, finite nonnegative Length, Risk, Mapping, CapacityLoad, Sustenance opportunity links, actual method/clearance and terrain. Mapping belongs to observed directions and passages. Reverse travel may reuse the actually recorded geometry, not a guarantee of identical currents, slopes, guards or one-way access. Unknown/severely obstructed passages need actual successful reconnaissance or a resolved forced march before ordinary advancement. Zero Length is a location record, not a free repeating travel/reward engine.

For one completed Advance/Travel tranche of nominal480 minutes, with actual travel labor/duration determined by the explicit transport integration below: start-tranche Mapped/Secured earns2Progress, Sketched1, Unknown0 until reconnaissance makes that actual traverse feasible, then1. Moving reconnaissance/escort can accompany traversal only as one physically compatible integrated activity; stationary research/crafting never advances the convoy. A reconnaissance success may add one shared+1Progress OR−1Pressure; Critical may do both. Across all teams on that cohort/tranche allow at most one recon+1 and one recon−1, not one per officer. A Map Route success also earns one mapping mark (Critical two); after max(1,recordedRisk) marks, improve one step and consume those marks. A0-risk Secured route earns no further mapping levels/rewards. New mapping normally affects the next tranche; an Unknown traverse actually resolved by that tranche's recon can use the expressly permitted base1, not a retroactive full2. A mere map purchase supplies only its actual content and verified rating.

Subtract the source−1Progress for above-route-Capacity once per completed tranche, minimum0, after its permitted recon/forced-march base. This is a route logistics penalty, not permission for any carrier above its own capacity. Pressure's matching+1 is applied once, not again for this equation. Tranche progress may be accrued as an exact rational at shorter elapsed intervals for locating crossed checkpoints; no second completion check or base reward is created by splitting the ledger.

NEW transport integration: normal route effort time is multiplied by Core route-quality time factor (Secured3/4, Known1,Contested5/4,Collapsed3/2) and by3/current convoy travel pace in mph. A fit ordinary unburdened walking30 creature is the NEW3mph reference; other walking paces are current lawful Speed/10mph, mounts similarly, vessels use their specific travel profile. Slowest actually self-moving necessary member/vehicle limits the cohort; passengers use their carrier. Current environment factors apply once, and expeditionStrain5 halves otherwise legal travel once. Mapping is navigation, routeQuality is physical/security condition; their separate specified effects may both apply. No tactical Dash repetition supplies continuous free route speed.

Each Progress corresponds to the next actual traversable route section; the Director records positions and obstacles. Fractional bookkeeping cannot cross an unavailable bridge, fit an oversized boat or relocate a stranded person. A known distance/terrain impossibility must be resolved before awarding its abstract progress. Route-quality encounter adjustments apply once to the final threat label; route loss rows become declared cargo stakes under FL-14, not a second automatic loss roll.

directions.title: Forced march and travel interruption

originalQuestion.title: Forced march and interrupted travel
originalQuestion.question: Preserve Severe route check,+2Pressure andextraSupply per active character on successful forced march. Decide critical outcomes,ordinary travel/encounter interruption,supply affordability and missing/slow members. Reconcile Strain5 half travel and actual Load inability to travel; a route check cannot silently override a physical carrying prohibition.

directions.disposition: KEEP source success costs; NEW complete boundaries
directions.authoringWording:
Forced March here is the Loop's bypass of waiting for Unknown-route mapping, not a generic second travel turn. Declare one nominal480-minute route attempt with actual labor/duration adjusted once under FL-10/TR-13, its participants, feasible movement method and extra provisions before starting. The Routekeeper uses the actual appropriate route skill (normally WIS Survival), route tier DC+6 Severe, with the generic trained-assistant cap unless an exact source overrides it. Actual missing/too-slow/overloaded members require transport, split/withdrawal or a revised task; no roll creates capacity, access or safe geometry.

Success and Critical Success each gain1Progress,+2Pressure and spend one additional complete standard provision basket per active participating Small/Medium character; Large spends two (NEW size-consistent completion of the source's one-per-character shorthand). No extra generic team-critical reward. Commit those extras to the attempt before rolling; on successful resolution consume them for actual forced-march support once, including real nutrition credits only for real consumption. Failure returns genuinely unspent extras, gives0Progress and one Standard complication; Critical Failure gives0 and Severe. Real provisions consumed/lost during unsuccessful work do not reappear. No on-credit success can spend unavailable stock; expected shortage blocks the voluntary attempt before commitment. Food-exempt recipients retain their specific waived components, not donated surplus.

A combat, blocked passage or rest consumes its actual minutes and pauses unfinished travel credit. Resume the same unresolved attempt if still feasible, retain disturbances and costs, and do not reroll a resolved failure by changing its label. A new materially different route/method needs a new actual time/resource commitment. The ordinary two-active-work and Rest Debt rules apply; work in scheduled Rest does not become a beneficial rest. At Strain5 a person cannot lead this active check; lawful carried or slow traveling victims use their actual exception. Halve travel once after other actual pace restrictions; never halve again merely because the travel crossed another Watch.

directions.title: Extraction episode and cargo admission

originalQuestion.title: Extraction declaration and cargo state
originalQuestion.question: Define once-per-actual-extraction initial Pressure from highest Extraction Class and how changing cargo or briefly reentering a site affects it. Keep secured versus hidden/attention/volatile/cursed/living requirements explicit,including actual restraint/consent/care for living people. Cargo classification never grants ownership or changes physical mass.

directions.disposition: KEEP surcharge; NEW episode lifecycle
directions.authoringWording:
An extraction episode starts with a recorded genuine decision and movement toward a real Haven/surface destination. Keep one cargo manifest with original lot/owner/custodian, physical pounds, Load, ExtractionClass0..6, priority1..5, actual condition, current carrier, live participants and every relevant tag. Class is handling risk, not mass, ownership or rarity promotion. Lowest priority is placed at risk first; ties use Quartermaster/Leader's recorded choice before outcome. Living people retain agency, care, legal status and consent/restraint facts; classification never authorizes bondage.

Initial surcharge is min(3,floor(highest carried ExtractionClass/2)), applied once to this real episode. NEW anti-reset/high-cargo rule: retain a surcharge-high-water mark. Later acquisition of genuinely higher-class cargo adds only the positive difference to that episode mark; dropping cargo never refunds the original increase. Reentering a room/site, changing transport, hiding the same cargo, transferring it between allied cohorts or changing the extraction ID cannot renew or erase its history. A genuinely concluded return followed by a new descent may start a new episode; unresolved original cargo still keeps condition, clocks and custody.

Secured, hidden and medically/chemically safe are different facts. Tie each tag's actual securing procedure to a real container/harness/care/containment source. Ordinary Secure Cargo is an Action for one feasible operation, not automatic success, time-free whole-convoy restraint or lowered Class. A hidden volatile core still requires its real containment. A voluntarily traveling passenger is not automatically Living-captive Class3; actual hazard/medical/custody circumstances determine handling. A higher Class6 lot requires its declared dedicated route/handling operation before admission; this table supplies no specialist access.

directions.title: Finite extraction checkpoints

originalQuestion.title: Extraction checkpoints
originalQuestion.question: Resolve tests at crossed Progress thresholds,midpoint/exit/route-transition overlaps,short routes and Severe-complication tests at the same location. Preserve no routine repetition at the same Progress. A Critical Success +1Progress may cross another threshold; decide a finite scheduling rule and record processed checkpoints so reordering or split travel cannot replay them.

directions.disposition: KEEP cadence; NEW coalescing and queue contract
directions.authoringWording:
At extraction-route entry freeze a finite ordered checkpoint set from actual Length and the Mapping currently governing the traverse: Secured at its genuine route transition/exit; Mapped at midpoint Length/2 and exit if Length≥6, otherwise exit; Sketched at each positive multiple of3 below Length and exit; Unknown at each positive multiple of2 below Length and exit. Fractional midpoints remain exact. Distinguish actual route-position IDs from Progress display numbers. A later mapped improvement applies prospectively: preserve processed checkpoints and replace only genuinely future cadence, never replay an earlier position.

Coalesce overlapping midpoint/multiple/exit/route-transition requests at the same actual position and timestamp into one test with all reasons. A transport change counts as a transition only if it is a genuine different method requiring the new operation; relabeling the same carriage is not. Exit from one route and entry to another at the same transfer point use one joint state test unless a distinct later operation truly intervenes. No ordinary repeated test at the same position. A new actual Severe complication changing convoy state can request one test there under FL-09's causal limit.

Use actual Quartermaster or designated capable substitute, ability+one Survival/vehicle/relevant-tool proficiency and permitted meaningful trained assistants. DC=tierDC+min(7,highestClass + exposedAttentionOnce + burdenedConvoyOnce + min(3,unsecuredVolatile/Cursed/Living lot count)) +2if actually pursued −2if Secured. A lot with multiple dangerous tags counts once in the unsecured-lot count. Carrier Burden is computed from actual occupied transport; duplicate body/container records cannot increase/decrease it. Core task degrees and natural shifts apply.

Critical Success chooses source−1Pressure (within the Watch reduction cap) or+1Progress where an actual reachable/compatible onward section makes that gain possible. Record the choice once. Success passes. Newly crossed checkpoint IDs are queued in order, not executed recursively inside an unfinished test. Each frozen checkpoint is processed at most once; generated Progress can cross more, but total routine tests never exceeds the finite distinct positions in that traverse. Secondary-Severe tests retain their separate one-per-root cap. An exit cannot be declared passed while its queued actual final test is unresolved. No new route/room IDs may be fabricated inside the batch to manufacture more critical progress.

NEW ordinary checkpoint work: one active minute of actual convoy/route/receiver verification by the lead and any contributing assistants, at the checkpoint position, with necessary hands/tools/access. That minute is part of a travel tranche only when the declared compatible moving workflow genuinely included it; otherwise stop and add the actual minute. It cannot be supplied by passive carriage, a free off-turn Action or a merely updated number. An exact hazard/transfer profile requiring longer work controls that operation. The check resolves only after that actual work and current-state admission; no second generic minute is added to an already completed exact verification.

directions.title: Failure choices, elapsed delays and cargo response

originalQuestion.title: Extraction failure and eight-hour delay
originalQuestion.question: Preserve the players choosing time-plus-complication versus stated cargo risk after the Director declares stakes. Define whether the eight-hour loss is an actual extraWatch and what work/rest/supply/pressure occurs meanwhile. Set bounded cargo rescue/vehicle/casualty responses and ownership consequences rather than automatic destruction or duplicated time.

directions.disposition: KEEP player branch choice; NEW finite rescue
directions.authoringWording:
Before each test the Director states the real stake, affected low-priority lots/vehicle/person, the physical cause and feasible responses. Failure lets the players choose: an actual8 elapsed hours lost plus one Standard complication, OR one stated low-priority lot at risk. Critical Failure gives a Severe complication and the predeclared two low-priority lots OR one vehicle OR one casualty at risk. Do not invent a second lot/casualty when none exists, or interpret 'at risk' as automatic destruction/death. Ownership is not changed by merely naming a stake.

The8-hour branch advances the one clock by28800 seconds. Record what causes the delay and which people must actually work/guard/handle it. No Progress for the stalled affected convoy during that delay. Other real people may use feasible independent hours, including an actual uninterrupted safe rest; the route failure does not certify such safety. Food/water, timers, Rest Debt, Pressure, rivals and protection continue at their genuine endpoints. The same interval is not8hours plus an extra Watch. Coalesce coincident duplicate complication requests under FL-09 while preserving independent causes.

NEW default noncombat cargo response: one60-active-minute feasible securing/recovery task by an actual capable lead, necessary helpers/rigging, using tierDC plus the affected lot's Class (cap+6), unless the actual source supplies a more specific response. Success/critical secures the reachable actual lot; no extra loot/Progress/HP. Failure leaves it in the declared reachable stranded/abandoned position or applies the declared compatible hazard once; it does not universally destroy the item. A deliberate voluntary abandonment transfers custody/location only; preserve owner/claim and insurance exclusions. A later recovery is a real new rescue operation against that location, not a replayed extraction award. If seconds matter, use actual combat Secure Cargo, movement, attacks, falls and rescue Actions instead of the60-minute abstraction; no free parallel rescue roll.

For Core route-quality loss rows, NEW select their surviving scope as severity/stake guides: Known threatens one actual Load; Contested threatens10% of current carried Load; Collapsed20% or real reroute; Secured has no automatic routine cargo-loss row. Locate real whole lots/portions supporting that amount, respecting indivisibility and actor safety. They do not automatically subtract inventory in addition to the Loop Failure choice. Special Living/Changed or Pact Interdiction rows retain only their actual defined event/seizure service permission; absent that profile, no invented effect. A disabled vehicle/casualty response uses TR-14 and actual physical damage/life rules. Insurance never creates a replacement item or pays for a merely threatened loss.

directions.title: Retreat: one bounded chase round

originalQuestion.title: Retreat resolution
originalQuestion.question: Keep threeEscape-before-threePursuit,lead check,assistance,at mostone ordinaryEscape andpossibletwo onCritical Success. Define opposed/DC procedure,what winning the round means,simultaneous thresholds,eligible actions and one meaningful pursuit threat. Do not combine a full unopposed enemy nova with the source chase abstraction or reset spent encounter resources at the mode change.

directions.disposition: KEEP three-before-three; NEW native check choice
directions.authoringWording:
Declare Retreat at the start of an actual round when a plausible escape route exists. Preserve the same encounter, numbered rounds, actual spent resources, positions, conditions and pursuit actors. NEW default: one withdrawing lead spends its Action on a fixed-DC escape task using its real method; DC=route tier DC, +3 for a declared superior pursuit/obstruction, +6 for a severe version, or−3 for actual favorable preparation. Use Core four task degrees/natural shifts. This explicitly resolves the ambiguous 'Pursuit check' as one declared escape-task DC rather than importing critical degrees into an opposed-total tie procedure. An actual source can instead provide its own distinct opposed chase, but not both checks for this uncertainty.

Success gives1Escape; Critical Success2; Failure1Pursuit; Critical Failure2Pursuit (NEW). A independently achieved declared round objective, sacrificed actual cargo or blocking maneuver can supply1Escape instead of the ordinary lead success, never an additional generic point that round. Cap generic Escape at1, or2 when the actual lead critical supplied2. Losing a real member, route or vehicle may add1Pursuit when that was the declared consequence, with NEW generic maximum2Pursuit per round. Paid express feature points retain only their exact source scope; no fictional gesture supplies free class output.

Each round allows one predeclared meaningful opposing threat: one legal attack, actual hazard or necessary sacrifice, not the full enemy multiattack/nova plus another chase punishment. Ally Actions may Help under combat's advantage/expiry rules, carry, treat, cast, command, move or make actual obstacles; they are not extra lead checks. Threat attacks preserve actual ranges, defenses, costs, damage and source callbacks. Abstract chase displacement itself does not run a second set of tactical opportunity attacks. If exact tactical movement/attack exchange is needed, use Encounter Mode movement and define its single round contribution before resolution, not both full opposing combat and the abstraction.

Resolve the declared round's costs/threats and check once, then assess thresholds. Escape≥3 and Pursuit<3 succeeds; Pursuit≥3 fails, including NEW simultaneous3/3 priority to unresolved pursuit. Success returns to Expedition Mode with+1Pressure, actual survivors/cargo and pursuit history; no refreshed RP/recharge/per-encounter benefits. Failure establishes the opponent's actual next advantageous position/capture opportunity, not arbitrary ownership or automatic death of everyone. Physically trapped routes cannot be bypassed by another check; offer actual surrender/rescue/alternate fight options under their own permissions.

directions.title: Encounter estimate and actual participants

originalQuestion.title: Encounter participants and threat budget
originalQuestion.question: Separate roster12 from actual combat group. Define party level for mixed-level participants,creatureCR fractions,party sizes outside3–6,reinforcements andcompanion contributions. Preserve the source budgets as provisional and its existing balance limits. Explain objective/hazard/surprise adjustments once and exact bossTenacity scope using current condition/control authority; authored procedure is not empirical success-rate validation.

directions.disposition: KEEP provisional budgets; NEW interpolation without balance claim
directions.authoringWording:
Use actual present participating characters, not roster12. NEW mixed-level reference= floor(arithmetic mean of participating characters' actual character levels),minimum1. An actual enemy's assigned creature level wins; otherwise preserve its exact CR as a rational and bin floor(CR−partyLevel) into the source relative rows:≤−4:5;−3:10;−2:15;−1:25;0:40;+1:60;+2:90;+3:135;≥+4:200 ThreatPoints. No inferred creature powers follow from CR. Fractional CR1/4 against level1 bins−1 for this provisional estimate, not an imported monster stat block.

KEEP four-character budgets50/90/130/180/240 and 3/4/5/6 multipliers0.8/1/1.2/1.4. NEW extend linearly m=max(0.2,1+0.2×(N_eff−4)), with N_eff=actual participating independent character turns +0.5 per actual limited attached-phase offensive companion/device contributing to that scene. Do not count passive gear, support-only decoration, absent roster members or the same companion twice. An independent recruited NPC with a full normal turn counts1 and occupies its proper roster/service status. This is an authoring estimate only; record the actual sources, command limits and composition, not a claim that every half actor has identical power. No0-participant encounter budget is generated. Reinforcements are recorded by actual entry time, overlap and separate wave stakes; do not secretly grant a full extra unopposed wave outside the declared difficulty.

Compare summed enemy points and source budgets, then apply each genuine objective/hostile terrain/surprise/active hazard adjustment once. Cargo/hazard generally+1 step; ordinary surprise+1; a genuinely warranted full unopposed enemy round+2, not an automatic second addition for the same surprise. The final label includes those choices; written cargo objectives do not add another step later. Core route-quality−1/+1 encounter steps apply only if not already represented by that same route threat. Keep source calibration percentages as targets, not observed performance. Preserve warnings about low-level lethality, level5–16 softness and level17–20 composition testing; no blanket class buff/HP inflation or assurance of survival follows.

Boss Tenacity applies only to an actually declared source-qualified boss with its real allowance; no enemy becomes a boss by size, price or this budget. Bind Stunned/Paralyzed/full-turn denial replacement, counters and duration to current CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST hard-control arbitration. Gate Guardian's second use requires its actual source. Do not reimpose the old global immunity/turn-loss shorthand or treat fear, Reaction denial and ordinary Speed penalties as identical hard denial.

directions.title: Transport and inventory integration

originalQuestion.title: Transport and inventory
originalQuestion.question: Identify missing actual mount,vehicle,crew,capacity,speed,terrain,load andcasualty-transport profiles needed for a first descent. Existing cartstructuralHP does not imply transport capacity. Keep known pounds,Load,Extraction Class,containers and source-specific weight relief separate,with no duplicated container contents or melded portable cargo.

directions.disposition: KEEP pounds/Load/Class; NEW profiles assigned separately
directions.authoringWording:
Adopt the complete29-row transport profile register and separate Core service profiles supplied with this verdict under TR-01–14. Every NEW value is separate from the untouched source row, including literal comma placeholders and null masses/speeds/capacities. Original CartHP30 remains durability only; Player prices and nine source speeds/carry capacities are retained exactly.

For each actual move separately validate: source-qualified body/control; physical space and route fit; current pounds including carrier-supported living body and all associated gear; inventory/transport Load and actual storage volume; crew/pullers/propulsion; current movement/conditions; legal custody and effect clocks. ExtractionClass modifies the stated handling problem, not any of those capacities. A loaded container counts its own body plus each child once. directions.title: Haven intake, evidence and disposition

originalQuestion.title: Haven arrival and evidence
originalQuestion.question: Give the TierI fast settlement and full ten-step process executable entry/exit conditions,with actual inspections,quarantine,claims,appraisal and uncertain information. State work time and skill/proficiency eligibility and whether spell identification reveals market price/provenance. Public knowledge,legal permission,mechanical functionality and ownership stay distinct.

directions.disposition: KEEP five-step fast/full ten-step routes; NEW bounded work and uncertainty
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP the full order: (1) quarantine/inspection, (2) provenance, (3) appraisal, (4) claims/liens, (5) disposition, (6) settlement, (7) recovery, (8) standing, (9) advancement, (10) next descent. The Tier-I fast route is inspection → appraisal → sale → sponsor settlement → recovery, available only when every arriving lot is within that route and there is no ownership dispute, strategic cargo, lien, quarantine, contraband or faction hearing. A fast route omits redundant administrative passes, not taxes, lawful title, actual costs, care, future standing/advancement records or unknown hazards. A newly discovered disqualifier transfers the same episode to the full route, retaining performed work and charges rather than restarting or charging both routes.

NEW administrative timings: ordinary intake is10 active minutes per arriving Expedition with an available receiving officer and its representative; it records arrivals, actual manifest, restrictions and discrepancies. A genuinely flagged lot needs10 further active minutes of physically possible inspection per distinct homogeneous lot/assembly. Provenance review takes30 minutes per distinct title/evidence dossier; appraisal30 minutes per item or previously constituted homogeneous lot; an uncontested claim check is included in provenance. A disputed claim's ordinary hearing takes two active hours with the actual parties/evidence and an authorized adjudicator; waiting for missing parties, evidence or authority adds actual delay, not guaranteed justice. One buyer negotiation/disposition takes30 active minutes for one coherent offered bill; ledger/sponsor settlement takes30 minutes per Expedition bill. Standing notification and advancement recording take10 minutes each when needed; next-charter planning takes60 actual minutes. Real independently staffed desks can operate on disjoint lots concurrently; the same representative cannot conduct incompatible full participation twice. Routine handing over a previously completed document uses ordinary handling, not another automatic30-minute charge. None of these times replaces an exact identification spell, trade assessment, hearing, specialist or emergency procedure.

Ordinary intake and uncontested bookkeeping need no roll. For genuinely uncertain appraisal choose the actually relevant INT/Arcana, History, Nature, Religion, Engineering or Investigation, or an applicable craft tool, before work; apply one proficiency contribution, no generic trained-only gate and no supernatural ability from proficiency. Use the explicit item/source assessment DC, otherwise the actual material tier DC12/13/15/16/18/19 for I–VI. A tier unknown to the participants can remain private, but the governing record must supply the DC. Unsupported higher-tier/exceptional objects need their own source assessment, not an invented DC. One knowledgeable assistant may provide ordinary Help under SO-07; do not add generic expedition+3 assistance to that advantage.

Success gives the reliable conclusions the actual evidence and chosen method can support and a valuation in the proper FL-20 domain. Critical Success adds the predeclared extra supported detail or access to a real alternative buyer, not universal function/provenance/curse detection or a guaranteed best market. Failure gives only established broad facts and an unresolved valuation. Critical Failure can produce a predeclared mistaken appraisal/report, clearly stored as the appraiser's fallible conclusion, not a change to the object's true identity. Real testing may destroy an actual sample only when separately declared and debited. Rechecking unchanged evidence by rotating assessors gives no new check; new evidence or a genuinely different appropriate test may qualify.

Identification of an enchantment, literal translation of a label, public mention of an ingredient, and a successful title search are different facts. None alone establishes ownership, public availability, safe containment, full mechanical powers or actual selling price. Quarantine is an actual custody/location/access restriction issued by an authorized institution on its real evidence, not destruction, automatic cleansing or a magical containment box. An ordinary secure holding service does not make an active core safe; missing specific containment remains a named lot-level prerequisite. An interrupted administrative task retains actual completed work unless the interruption genuinely invalidated it; paid service time/fees and material ages remain recorded. Do not conceal an unknown object by asserting the fast route is safe.

directions.title: Valuation has one correct domain

originalQuestion.title: Correct valuation domain
originalQuestion.question: Use the reviewed equipment/recipe valuation rules for their actual items and Core artifact formula for real artifacts. Resolve the older Loop multipliers only in their surviving scope; no duplicated Gate/grade/quality/provenance/demand factors. A crafted Masterwork outcome is not automatic artifact marketMasterwork. State actual buyer availability and quote expiry; no guaranteed buyback/arbitrage.

directions.disposition: KEEP reviewed equipment/recipes and Core artifacts; LIMIT old Loop multipliers
directions.authoringWording:
First classify what is actually offered: ordinary equipment; a reviewed crafted item; an ordinary homogeneous material/trade lot; a true artifact under its own profile; or an unvalued/unsupported object. Do not derive this classification from a grandiose name, rarity, high price, source ingredient, magical condition or suppression. Declare the quoted quantity, identity, condition, custody, buyer, lawful disposition and price domain before calculating.

KEEP reviewed equipment: the actual fitted/grade/size undamaged reference, actual known-buyer sale terms, and final copper rounding. For an undamaged mundane item where the reviewed ordinary-buyer schedule genuinely applies, Honored/Liked/Neutral/Disliked/Hated use75/60/50/40/25 percent of that reference, with actual refusal still possible. Those percentages are not magical-item buyback and do not promise a buyer. Damaged goods need a real condition-specific quote. Gem/jewelry/art and ordinary trade goods retain their reviewed particular transaction rules. Apply no second Loop provenance/demand/condition/urgency multiplier to a price already obtained through that equipment rule.

KEEP all687 reviewed recipe references and actual sale restrictions: for the reviewed durable supplemental-body families use the exact source-batch/Standard-Q plus approved body reference once, not final quality yield, legacy price, all reusable capital or an artifact multiplier. Charges, flaw, damage and source-specific disposition affect an actual quote under that item's procedure; they do not create an automatic scrap floor. Manufacturing quality never silently becomes Core artifact quality. A retained catalyst and an unused mundane output reserve remain their own actual stock, not duplicated output value.

NEW surviving Loop scope: ordinary, nonartifact, nonequipment material/trade lots without an overriding exact quote may use Base × Provenance × Demand × Condition × Urgency. Base is the actual recorded source lot reference; if genuinely absent, the Director may establish one finite homogeneous lot at the Loop's provisional band median, explicitly NEW: TierI10gp (range5–15), II30gp (15–50), III100gp (51–148), IV320gp (151–499), V950gp (512–1465). This is a pre-offer appraisal choice for that actual finite lot, not a per-pound conversion, authority to mint a catalog material, or a renewable value obtained by splitting it. No TierVI+ median is supplied. Record quantity/mass and preserve value allocation through subdivisions.

For that limited Loop commodity quote keep provenance undocumented0.5/disputed0.75/documented1/Gate-Sealed1.25; demand glut0.75/normal1/sought1.25/strategic1.5; condition damaged0.5/worn0.75/sound1/exceptional1.25; urgency forced0.75/normal1/patient auction1.10. Apply each once only when its factual predicate is established. An existing Degraded half-value material or an already condition-adjusted source price does not receive the same half-value loss again under 'damaged'; use the applicable existing condition rule and make the duplicate factor1. A preparation step without a price effect never supplies 'exceptional'. Gate-Sealed provenance requires the actual valid seal/evidence, not a copied label. Patient auction needs a real buyer/auction appointment and actual wait; it is not an immediate free10 percent. Disputed provenance reduces a tentative quote but does not authorize disposing of another owner's property.

KEEP Core's true-artifact formula: BaseFunctionValue × GateTierMultiplier × artifact Quality × Provenance × Demand × Legality, then only actual uncounted stabilization/transport/tax/liability expenses. The Core quality values0.25/1/1.5/2.5/5/10 and its stated conditional provenance/demand/legality ranges remain source values. Choose the actual applicable factor from its range before accepting an offer, supported by the actual buyer/profile; no automatic maximum. BaseFunctionValue and GateTierMultiplier are not numerically defined by the supplied general table. They must be explicitly stated in the particular artifact valuation record or finite actual buyer quote, not guessed from an unrelated item or newly invented TierVII–X formula. This is an artifact-specific market input, not an obstacle to authoring the ordinary chapter. A profile/quote without them remains 'unvalued', not zero-priced or infinitely valuable.

Record artifact gross separately from every deduction so FL-21/22 can charge each expense once and apply the actual sponsor contract base. A negative economic net is an exposed liability calculation, not an automatic purchase obligation, negative coin payment to the seller or a material-generation permission. Actual seizure, disposal, buyer consent and insurance retain their own procedures. Preserve every original Loop/Core formula and their conflicting labels in the source layer; this scoped routing, not source deletion, resolves the active conflict.

directions.title: One gross-to-net ledger and one rounding per transaction

originalQuestion.title: Currency rounding and transaction ledger
originalQuestion.question: Resolve Loop nearestgp versus reviewed purchaseceilcp/salefloorcp,with finite examples below1gp and negative artifact netvalue. Keep tax,transport,stabilization,liability andfees in one transaction ledger so Core subtraction is not followed by paying the same cost again. Negative appraisal is not by itself an authorized forced debt or a refund.

directions.disposition: KEEP exact prices/copper rules; NEW ledger contract
directions.authoringWording:
Keep exact rational copper internally. One gp=100cp, one sp=10cp, one pp=1000cp; preserve reviewed regional conversion rates and leave unvalued currency unresolved. Do not infer soul-linked origins. An actual final purchase, tax or fee payable is rounded upward to copper once; an actual final sale receipt is rounded downward once. A homogeneous bill negotiated as one sale is one receipt. Distinct genuinely separate contracts/fees may have their own final rounding, but reclassifying every multiplication or component as another transaction to alter money is prohibited. Displayed intermediate decimals never overwrite exact values.

Every ledger entry names its unique transaction ID, actual payer/payee, currency, item/quantity or service, agreement/authority, exact quoted calculation, rounded actual payment, time, status and linked prior payment. 'Quoted', 'reserved', 'paid', 'owed', 'refunded' and 'written off by an authorized creditor' are distinct. Paying from owned stock removes the actual stock/coin; a reference price alone spends nothing. Never count an already-paid supply, transport premium, reusable tool or sponsor advance a second time. A refundable deposit is applied to the agreed bill, not a second bill. An insurance payout is a separately classified cash inflow, not newly sold cargo.

For the Loop default net-share contract define G as actual sale receipts; T as direct Haven taxes on those receipts; RQ as actual mandatory rescue and quarantine expenses attributable to this episode, counted once whether paid earlier or now. SponsorBase=max(0,G−T−RQ). SponsorShare is its contracted percentage of SponsorBase, finally rounded as its one actual payment. NetExpedition=G−T−RQ−SponsorShare. These definitions preserve the Loop's before-personal-wages/discretionary-purchases base; a different signed gross-share or priority-lien contract uses its own declared base, not this default by resemblance.

TrueProfit is the episode's actual economic inflows minus all distinct actual episode costs once, including that share, wages, spent/replaced supplies, operating fuel, repair, debt interest and other agreed costs. Capital purchases and borrowed principal must be separately shown: financing inflow and repayment are not profit; sale of preexisting personal capital is not earned cargo. 'Cash after reserves' is a further allocation, not automatically the same as accounting profit. Report the actual three charter metrics: gross cargo target, net expedition target and true-profit/distributable-after-required-reserves target, labeling whether an unrealized appraisal or realized sale is being compared. A mere appraised gross does not pay wages.

A mandatory rescue/quarantine cost already deducted in an artifact net valuation remains visible as a separate entry; reconstruct G and its deductions rather than subtracting it again from the net. If there is insufficient cash, retain the actual unpaid obligation and lawful claim; do not create a forced new loan, negative inventory or an unlimited sponsor advance. Allocations cannot exceed available funds. Partition a homogeneous lot's historical reference proportionally using exact fractions; its children's total cannot exceed their parent merely through independent rounding.

directions.title: Claims, sponsors, taxes and finite insurance

originalQuestion.title: Claims,taxes,sponsors and insurance
originalQuestion.question: Reconcile claims priority,tax base/category,sponsor percentages andgross/net/trueprofit thresholds using exact source order. Define insuredvalue,premium,deductible,partial losses,provenance,caps andone payout per actual covered loss. Fees already paid must not reappear. The source exclusions andwritten-contract exceptions remain; human/player consent to actual contracts is a table decision.

directions.disposition: KEEP actual source offers; NEW explicit contract and partial-claim completion
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP Core's claim priority as an entitlement/disposition record: actual emergency survival use during descent; existing liens/charter claims; wages, porter shares and rescue costs; Gate/sovereign taxes and actual authorized seizure; written party division; sale/donation/study/craft/retirement. Emergency use must be an actually authorized necessary use, not a ledger excuse for unlimited consumption. A disputed title or two incompatible orders is held for a real hearing under FL-19; no appraisal decides title. This priority does not waive a legally due sale tax or make one invoice payable twice. Establish permitted disposition and obligations first, then calculate and remit the actual transaction's taxes and written sponsor base. Preserve unmet claims and the claimant's real authority.

KEEP one highest applicable Loop market levy on the same taxable disposition: routine3%; licensed craft materials/goods5%; artifact auction6%; strategic regulated8%; authorized contraband-amnesty disposal12%. These are alternative brackets, not3+5+6+8+12. The actual transaction's category and jurisdiction must be identified before its offer. A written pre-sale exemption modifies only what it actually exempts. The12% bracket is not permission to sell illegal cargo or legalize trafficking. Ordinary purchase prices do not silently acquire a new sale levy. An actual separately authorized toll, hearing fee or sovereign seizure needs its own source/contract entry; 'tax' cannot hide an invented charge.

KEEP Loop default sponsor offers, accepted in the charter before expenditure: self0%, local guild20%, merchant/bank30%, noble/temple35%, sovereign/great institution45% of FL-21 net-share base. Source up-front support must actually be provided; not every sponsor supplies every item. KEEP Core's distinct alternative offers: merchant20–35% gross plus agreed first-purchase option; guild15–25% plus actual dues and stated formula/patent rights; noble25–50% with particular strategic claims; religious tithe/relic priority; consortium30–60% with actual liens/audit; criminal40–70% with actual unlawful risks. A chosen rate, exact base, contributed capital/loan versus grant, material/title exceptions, due date and payer must be fixed in the actual contract. Where a Core row omitted a base or numeric tithe, those are mandatory written offer fields, not defaults inferred from another row. These alternatives remain available as source-priced negotiations; they are never stacked with the default for the same obligation or imposed retroactively. A sponsor's quoted rights do not bypass the institution's actual authority or the party's Session Zero agreement.

NEW standard Loop cargo-policy implementation retains printed premium5% ordinary/10% dangerous-volatile-cursed-living/15% Attention-strategic, highest applicable class once. Declare insured finite lots, value I, provenance class, beneficiary, covered hazards, episode, pre-loss premium payment, exclusions and actual carrier before cover begins. Record an actual safe-access claim notice within72 elapsed hours of return; an earlier authenticated notice is valid. A declared inability to communicate postpones that notice deadline until communication is actually restored; it does not backdate coverage. Routine examination takes two active hours of qualified claim work plus actual evidence acquisition, not a guaranteed two-hour payment on an unproved loss.

For cumulative eligible covered loss L, bounded by the declared insured finite value I, deductible D=0.20I is applied once per policy episode; provenance rate r is0.60 undocumented/0.75 disputed/0.90 documented or Gate-Sealed. TotalEntitlement=max(0,min(I,r×min(L,I)−D)); a later payment is max(0,TotalEntitlement−prior actual payouts), subject to genuine policy terms and the remaining insured value. This NEW partial-loss extension exactly reproduces the source whole-loss formula at L=I. Independent already compensated interests cannot recover the same loss twice; a recovered insured item requires the policy's actual return/subrogation adjustment, not keeping both loss money and a fictitiously destroyed asset. No claim for fraud, undeclared cargo, voluntary abandonment without its prior insured-sacrifice clause, or a loss after knowingly ignoring an applicable abort condition. A policy never restores material, HP, souls or a dead insured person.

Core's separate Life/Return5% expected share, Cargo8–20% value, Gate-Delay3%, Artifact-Liability10%+ and annual ransom bond remain distinct offered products, not duplicate premiums or automatic riders on that Loop policy. NEW common binder rule: before accepting any such product, record an exact premium within its source range where given, currency/value basis, term, named beneficiary, finite payout cap, deductible/rate or fixed-benefit formula, covered trigger, evidence, exclusions and notice/due terms. For Life/Return retain the actual named death-and-body-recovery trigger; for delay require an actual covered closure/Guardian delay rather than poor planning; liability requires the actual lawful-sale loss and disclosed risks; ransom needs an actual capture, authorized payee and release terms. Where the source does not price a term (annual ransom fee, payout size, precise tithe), the actual finite offered value is a campaign input. A binder missing it is incomplete and cannot be purchased or claimed; it needs a completed ordinary quote, not a new source conference. Preserve literal exceptional exclusions as receipts without interpreting their cosmology.

originalQuestion.question: Loop uses-5..+5,Reputation guide/runtime use-3..+3,andruntime qualitative bands map<=-2Hated,+2Honored. directions.disposition: ADOPT NEW−3…+3 operational policy; keep five bands; supersede competing automatic tables
directions.authoringWording:
ADOPT the proposal as NEW ordinary operational policy 'standing-v1': each resolved individual/institution relationship has an integer−3…+3. Its descriptive bands are Hated at−3/−2, Disliked−1, Neutral0, Liked+1 and Honored+2/+3. Keep endpoints distinct in authoritative history; +3 is not rewritten to+2 because both display Honored. Preserve all three complete original tables and their source versions. A source-version interpretation record is required to activate an old record. KEEP the already reviewed no-universal-magic-discount boundary of REPUTATION.md and all actual named grants; no standing score changes RP, RC, spell rank, Dissonance, charges or alignment by itself. Reputation is a real CHA skill contribution when its actual check applies, separately from the saved relationship; add PB once, not PB plus the relationship score.

NEW access guide for the five bands: Hated permits only an actual safe intermediary/exception or willing provider, never an automatic attack or universal exclusion from unrelated public services; Disliked permits a provider's ordinary public dealings with its actual restrictions, not assumed credit/licenses; Neutral supplies ordinary eligibility to ask for public goods/lodging/contracts; Liked permits consideration for that institution's ordinary introduction/license/buyer process; Honored permits consideration for its bonded storage, credit, sensitive desk or senior audience where that institution actually offers them. No band creates an office, ownership, waiver, strategic-auction admission, credit balance or license. Existing real named entitlements survive according to their own terms, not an automatic reset when the numeric score changes. Actual known-buyer equipment sale fractions remain their reviewed special rule, not a universal price or CHA modifier.

A public, significant, attributable normal event may propose±1; a major public success/betrayal may propose±2. NEW signed scene rule: for one subject/institution/scene, cap the algebraic sum of ordinary proposed changes at−2…+2, then clamp the resulting score to−3…+3. Store every signed event, capped contribution, applied delta and overflow, and recompute that scene from its actual opening score so opposite events do not exploit saturation order. No banking overflow, multiplying one deed by the number of witnesses, or replaying a notification. A campaign-defining exception needs its distinct actual event and expressly predeclared magnitude/cap exception, not a favorable die retroactively relabeled defining. Other institutions react only to their own genuine knowledge and stakes under SO-10. One NPC attitude, Expedition renown, legal status and a named privilege remain separate records.

Cult Escapee is an ACTUAL source conflict, not a stylistic alias: the complete reviewed background gives Hated with the former cult, Disliked with suspicious religious authorities, and Liked with anti-cult groups; the runtime background map's religious-orders:+1 contradicts that second clause. For a genuinely fresh initialized character use source-bound−2/−1/+1 respectively, scoped to the actually identified institutions. Do not impose a penalty on every religious order or grant hatred with every cult. Preserve the original runtime+1 and its source version. On an existing character, a recognized wrongly applied +1 initial religious-authority grant can be corrected by an explicit replacement of that initialization contribution with−1 and replay of subsequent real events; no direct overwrite of the current score. Where its origin or later events are unknown, retain the raw+1 and flag exactly that relationship for interpretation rather than guessing whether it is an earned score. RP-A01–06 supplies the lossless field/history contract and all20 background comparisons.

Retain the Loop renown descriptions as historical/cultural milestone descriptors, not numeric faction standing or automatic powers. Whether a particular NPC knows that achievement requires an actual information event. Sixth-Gate/seasonal/deep-setting statements remain receipts only.

directions.title: Haven work, services, instruction and recovery

originalQuestion.title: Haven actions,services and actual clocks
originalQuestion.question: Define one-day HavenTurn versus activeworkhours andrealrest/care schedules,including research,training,crafting,repair,licenses,information anddependence treatment. Preserve longer individual recipe times instead of the generic Brew a Batch one-day shorthand. directions.disposition: KEEP all exact domain durations; NEW service scheduling
directions.authoringWording:
A Haven Turn is24 elapsed hours on FL-03's one clock, not a new currency buying any result. Queue actual activities with named workers, providers, facilities, materials and intervals. Two eight-hour productive-work Watches and real Rest remain the normal schedule; mandatory waiting is elapsed time but not productive work or automatically beneficial rest. The party's presence in a Haven supplies no teacher, complete workshop, purchaser, cure, secure berth, food, licenses or new knowledge. KEEP exact687-recipe creation and formula research/copying, their gates and phases, charge/service/repair separations, full hours (including960-hour orders), finite bodies/ingredients and assistant caps. The old 'Brew a Batch in one day' is an activity label only; it does not complete a longer recipe in a Haven Turn. Keep trade training80 active hours with a qualified instructor,10gp tuition and actual tools/living costs; completion grants only its actual proficiency/trade1/XP0. KEEP LAX ordinary language modules240 spoken+80 literacy (script portion40),320 total or280 with known script,15-minute credited phases, genuine instruction and1gp/8 instruction-hour reference.
