KEEP Short Rest, eight-hour safe Rest/beneficial Long Rest, four consecutive hours of genuine Morale recreation and24 consecutive hours of full Haven care as distinct Strain procedures. Safe debt-clearing Rest can finish without another Long-Rest refill. Wound treatment keeps its actual eight-hour operation/kit/one Supply and success degrees; no Haven label heals Wounds or bypasses a three-Wound healing cap. KEEP dependence recovery from CONDITION_RECOVERY_PLAYTEST: seven consecutive no-dose project days, each actual one-hour treatment and one Supply; designated practitioner chosen skill Medicine/Religion/Alchemy; final substance DC or existing fallback14; failure needs a fresh seven-day project. The qualifying eight-hour daily care activity includes that day's one-hour requirement, gives one nonstockpiled advantage on the next recovery check and prevents only an actually defined ordinary escalation; it does not invent one, remove addiction itself or rewrite crashes/doses/tolerance. Actual interrupted care/project consequences retain that reviewed source.

KEEP Core service reference prices: clean water1cp/person-day in I–III or1sp in IV–VI; hot meal2cp/5sp; safe-rest lodging5sp/person/5gp; verified map update1gp/25gp; preservation service5sp/Load/10gp; ordinary repair service10%/15% of its applicable undamaged reference; escort per floor2gp/person/50gp. These are particular offers, not additional fees on a separately agreed all-inclusive service. NEW physical completion: water/meal use FL-05 quantities; lodging buys one actual qualifying eight-hour stay/berth but no automatic rest reward; map-update desk takes one active hour on an actual relevant available route record, adds only the facts it really contains and records the information source (not free secured terrain or a claimed firsthand map mark). Escort price supplies an actual qualified service team and agreed journey, with its real actors, travel, food and availability, not another independent roster/combat army for that fee. Resurrection remains a specific available operative effect and finite service contract, not a cure authored from a price table.

NEW preservation-service pricing unit: charge once for each begun10lb of the actually accepted material bill (minimum one unit for a nonempty bill); keep source5sp/10gp rate without also charging the party an extra self-treatment fee for the same operation. The provider must furnish compatible real materials/container/work; use the exact relevant preservation method, lot limit,30-minute-per-lot work and24-hour treatment where that is the reviewed method. It cannot preserve an unsupported active core by accepting money. If no feasible provider can offer the published price, that offer is unavailable, not free conjured preservatives. Repair-service work uses the actual repair duration/qualification and source-specific magic-item route, while its agreed complete service price replaces the self-repair materials bill. At least max(1h,maximumHP/10h) for ordinary equipment; special Broken magical reconstruction keeps its own DC/time/primary requirements.

NEW ordinary license administration: one active hour with the actual desk, evidence and applicant; fixed posted fee/required qualification/jurisdiction/scope/expiry must be in the offered license record before work. Routine satisfied requirements issue without a roll; uncertain evidence or persuasion uses its proper procedure; a social success never invents permission outside the officer's authority. Source gave no universal fee, so no flat fee is created. Ordinary patronage/information follows SO scene duration/stakes plus the chosen actual venue/service quote. Core's venue tier/gp rumor-network fee grants its printed advantage only for actual relevant Gather Information work; use the subject-appropriate existing skill, not a new proficiency. Private meeting protects only against the actual ordinary surveillance measures provided. All24-hour faction review checkpoints use SO-11 and do not add work hours or free services.

directions.title: Coin, crime, labor and rescue preserve real status

originalQuestion.title: Contraband,coin assay and person status
originalQuestion.question: Compare Core coin-shaving detection/actualvalue with Loop assayDCs andfees; retain both originals anddecide scope. Bind criminal market stages,Heat,bribes andcomplications to actual operations. Compare Core captive half-to-fourLoad with reviewed casualty transport andLoop3/6/12Load; define voluntary passengers separately. Preserve person agency,legalstatus,wages,rescue/evidence records without creating race-based prices or deciding deferred soul-linked currency origins.

directions.disposition: KEEP source-specific assay and person distinctions; NEW staged administration
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP coins' actual denomination, composition, count/weight, custody and known mint acceptance separately. The Loop assay covers a declared bulk bill: DC10 obvious defect,13 mixed/clipped,16 plated/adulterated,19 expert false mint. Core's specific shaving categories retain their own exact method DCs instead when that is the actual test: trace1–3% shaving/DC12/value95–99% face; light4–8%/DC14/85–95%; heavy9–15%/DC16/70–85%; ruined16–30%/DC10 once weighed/40–70%; washed/plated5–25% recoverable value/DC18 without cutting or magic. Select the method/defect hypothesis before rolling; never require both generic and specific checks to detect the same defect or silently choose the easier after a failure. A known quantity of actual metal and an actual purchaser determine the exact value within a source range; no arbitrary maximum or exact gold recovery follows from passing.

NEW ordinary assay bill limit: up to100 coins or10lb, whichever is reached first, per30 active minutes of actual inspection/sampling; separate materially different variants remain separately identified. Select INT/Investigation or the actual relevant proficient tool once. Keep Core's specific jeweler's-scale/touchstone/milled-edge/merchant-test-kit assistance as access to the proficiency contribution on that appropriate Investigation assay when the actual functioning method applies; it grants no general character proficiency, second PB or supernatural detection. A destructive cut debits the actual coin/sample. Routine already documented weighing is no new roll. Failure leaves uncertainty; only declared false-assessment stakes can supply a fallible report on Critical Failure, never transmute the coin. New genuinely different tests or new evidence permit retry with actual work; speaker rotation does not.

KEEP ordinary assay fees at 1% of the face value of the actual accepted assay bill, minimum 1 gp for that real service, and remint fees at 2% of the recovered legitimate metal value accepted for actual reminting. A combined commissioned assay bill receives its minimum once, not per coin, variant or thirty-minute stage; services not incurred create no fee, and an already-owned private testing toolkit creates no fictional desk fee to its owner. KEEP the Loop greater-of rule for a holder lawfully established to be knowing, not a 10% cap. NEW explicit total-payment and fee allocation: let F be the confirmed false lot's face value, A the actual assay fee, R the actual remint fee, and S=A+R for the same assessed lot/bill; the total monetary liability is P=max(0.10×F,S), allocated to service fees S and an additional criminal fine of P−S=max(0,0.10×F−S). Do not charge P plus those fees or levy another 10% fine on top. Compute on exact amounts under FL-21/EC-10's existing final-transaction copper rounding; allocating the total between fees and fine does not itself create extra transactions. Credit actual prior payments and fees already withheld from returned legitimate metal once against the same liability, leaving only its unpaid balance. Confirmed counterfeit coin or plated false currency is seized in full only through actual lawful authority; seizure is neither a fee nor a payment credit. Genuine coins and legitimate metal remain separately identified and are returned with actual fee deductions accounted for once. An innocent holder with documented provenance pays no criminal fine; absent a lawful knowing-holder finding, this rule imposes no criminal fine. Suspicion, ancestry, a failed die or missing documentation alone does not establish knowledge. Assessment, collection and custody require actual authorized actors; an unpaid amount remains an obligation, not automatic borrowing or remote confiscation. Cutting/reminting takes the provider's actual work and links consumed/replaced coin identities to real metal/output quantities without duplication.

KEEP criminal operation stages as separate real uncertainties: obtain an actual buyer/contact; establish trust/terms; move the actual cargo; undertake any particular concealment/laundering act; receive actual payment. NEW skill routing for legacy undefined labels uses existing skills by actual method: Streetwise→CHA/Reputation or Persuasion for networks; Banking→INT/Investigation or applicable actual commercial records/tools; Forgery→actual forgery kit/DEX or INT as the physical task warrants. This creates no new skill, proficiency, forged legal authority or automatic Scribing recipe. Each ordinary contact/terms/collection scene uses SO's declared time; physical movement uses routes, and actual document production uses its reviewed work rather than a generic free roll. Do not run all five stages when one real transaction already resolves them or when the stage is impossible.

KEEP Underways Heat0…6 per actual operation/institution pursuit history: petty illicit1, restricted2, strategic theft/smuggling3, trafficking/forbidden4; for one triggering act choose its highest applicable category once, rather than summing aliases. NEW duplicate guard: event IDs survive repacking/new fronts; split/join preserves actual investigative histories. At each completed24-hour Haven interval involving an active operation, roll once d6≤Heat for a predeclared enforcement complication; coincident faction reporting does not make another Heat roll. Heat0 has none. Actual investigation, seizure/arrest/hearing/standing consequences need their real authority/actors/means, not instant remote confiscation. Bribes10% actual agreed lot value reduce1,25% reduce2, subject to real accepting recipient and effect; active Heat cannot fall below1, no bribe at0, money actually spent once. Declining/unsuccessfully negotiating a bribe does not buy the reduction. Heat cannot be reset by a new operation ID; ending an operation closes that activity but leaves unresolved evidence/legal consequences.

KEEP people as actors, not salvage or fungible goods. Record factual and asserted legal status separately: Free, Contracted, Debt-Bound, Penal, Enslaved, Rescued/Liberated, Disputed; the two rescue terms are preserved source labels for an actual liberation history, not a new automatic immunity. Core's captive½–4Load shorthand is superseded here by reviewed body/casualty handling: actual pounds plus casualty LoadTiny1.5/Small3/Medium6/Large12, equipment once and additional explicitHuge profile where required. Voluntary mobile passengers use TR-12's actual seat/custody record, not 'captive' ownership. Petrified body×10 pounds does not multiply casualty Load; all passenger equipment including melded counts on an external carrier.

KEEP ordinary lawful wages1gp/day unskilled,3gp skilled,10gp specialist with source dangerous-expedition×2, unless the named porter/service or actual contract gives its own rate; don't charge both. NEW wage day buys at most two actual eight-hour work Watches and a protected Rest opportunity, not24 hours of labor. Extra risky/emergency duty needs actual agreement and costs/Rest Debt, not default coercion. Debt-bond records principal, credited wages and agreed simple interest at no more than10% per literalOpening, no hidden compounding or automatic new debt; coercion/kidnapping/fraud/unlawful confinement cannot demand an invented buyout. Preserve source person-market quotations only as reports of abusive/particular institutions, never universal ancestry prices or a purchasable player-agency rule.

KEEP trafficking Evidence Clock0–4: one actual investigation approach adds1 on Success,2 on Critical Success, capped4; repeated same evidence adds0. NEW default investigation work is one active hour per concrete accessible lead with INT/Investigation or actual relevant skill and declared DC/stakes under Core. At4 it supports asking an actually authorized officer for a warrant/hearing or planning a genuine rescue/raid; it does not conjure police, prove a false report, transfer ownership or resolve combat. A captive's actual guards/restraints/escape opportunities are ordinary scene/encounter facts, not powers granted by a legal-status label. Core's six-step rebellion clock, when used for an actual coercive situation, gains one step per distinct learned abuse/opportunity/allied-help/security-failure event and at6 schedules the predeclared real escape/resistance action; no automatic mind control or remote revolt. Keep consent-based adult services distinct from trafficking; table boundaries remain controlling. All literal soul-linked currency, religious/planar and deep-setting references are preserved without interpretation.

directions.title: Advancement, closure and a real next descent

originalQuestion.title: Advancement and next-session handoff
originalQuestion.question: Use reviewed milestone-or-XP mode andactual class-level progression. Define materially contributing offscreen members,rounding,level-gap changes,scene cap andprevent duplicate rewards for the sameachievement. Finish with a worked objective -> Watch -> encounter -> cargo -> extraction -> Haven -> nextdescent record using the final decisions. Seasonal/cosmology review andnumerical/human validation remain separate.

directions.disposition: KEEP milestone/XP and class gates; NEW unique achievement ledger
directions.authoringWording:
Declare milestone or optional XP mode for the campaign before the award. Do not pay both for the same achievement. Milestone default grants the stated earned level when its genuinely achieved objective is confirmed, not merely after one Watch, gross appraisal or return; apply the actual class/ASI/Arch/Hero schedule and pending acquisition constraints. A level's new maximum is not healing/refilling, an old spent resource is not restored, and the character gets only the actually granted new unspent Hit Die. No source conference promotes a pending spell/feat/class choice.

KEEP optional Loop awards: Routine5%,Standard10%,Hard15%,Severe25%,Guardian40% of that recipient's current level gap; actual declared profitable extraction10%; first qualifying route/text/faction discovery5–15% chosen before resolution. NEW exact timing: freeze each recipient's actual gap to the next level at the beginning of the distinct award scene. Record separate unique achievement IDs, sum its eligible predeclared percentages for that scene, cap at60% of that frozen gap, then round the scene award once to the nearest10XP, halves upward. A value rounded above the exact60% ceiling is capped to floor(0.60×gap/10)×10; this explicitly preserves the scene cap. At the level cap or without a supplied next-level threshold no invented next gap/XP reward is assigned. Do not recompute earlier percentages against a newly larger gap because one award leveled the character midway through the scene.

All materially contributing Expedition members can qualify, including offscreen recon/research/transport/support that actually contributed to the same objective. Presence on the roster, repeated guard-check bookkeeping, using the same evidence twice or waiting somewhere else is not automatic contribution. The award record names actual contribution/events and eligible recipients, rather than splitting one party award into unequal hidden per-roll bonuses. One achievement can be recorded once per eligible recipient; report/claim/auction/extraction notifications of that same accomplishment don't repeat it. Independently awarded domain crafting XP remains its own actual ledger and is not automatically a character-level award. A failed-but-valuable objective may have a predeclared milestone/contribution outcome, but no automatic reward is invented after a failed check.

Close an episode with actual elapsed timestamp, objective outcomes and success metric, party/member locations, route and camp states, Pressure, pursuit/Heat, remaining consumables/containers, HP/Wounds/injuries/Strain/debt/resources, corpse/companion/device histories, cargo title/custody and terminal harvest/salvage claims, quote/payment/liability/insurance records, attributable standing/renown events, pending faction actions, earned advancement and a prospectively accepted next charter. Record unresolved matters honestly; a new descent may proceed only if its actual access, budget and abort conditions allow it, not because every legal dispute was administratively erased.

The integrated worked sequence supplied with this verdict is a synthetic complete source-bound example, not evidence that those persons, route, buyer, coins, supplies or faction actually exist. It uses the same clock through encounters, extraction, Haven and the next departure, with no extra rest/actor/Supply/price benefit. Preserve literal Opening/Horn scheduling and retirement/seasonal references as receipts; this conference grants no next-Cycle renewal, mind continuity, automatic legacy infrastructure or cosmological interpretation. Exact candidates and later whole-game/human/runtime gates remain separate.

directions.title: Want, leverage, authority and one declared uncertainty

originalQuestion.title: Declare the scene before rolling
originalQuestion.question: Keep the Director Want/Leverage/Limit/Clock/Witness frame. Specify the actual requested outcome, who can decide it, available offer/threat, genuine opportunity and disclosed consequence. Define when no check is needed or no current approach can obtain the requested concession; a high roll does not create authority, knowledge or a missing prerequisite.

directions.disposition: KEEP complete Director scene frame; ADOPT NEW operational declaration
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP all five Director fields: Want (specific requested obtainable change), Leverage (actual offer/evidence/threat), Limit (what the decision-maker cannot or will not concede), Clock (real deadline and duration), Witness (who can perceive or later learn what). Record actual participants, who owns/controls the requested resource, decision authority, current relationship/source knowledge, available channel and physical setting. One NPC's role title, faction score or a high die is not proof they possess authority, money, a key, information or a spell.

NEW scene declaration: before committing time/resources and before the die, state the concrete success outcome and its actual terms; the failure outcome and any independently offered costly alternative; any extra Critical Success detail and Critical Failure consequence; the approach, skill/ability, fixedDC or opposed procedure, duration and costs. The Director can keep legitimate secret facts private, but cannot declare a feasible rewarded success and after the roll secretly require Critical Success or invent another price. Explain an observable obstacle or that the current approach cannot obtain that concession, rather than invite a meaningless die. Success never promises facts the actual source cannot contain.

No check when actual routine authority/prerequisites and willingness already settle the outcome; record the accepted terms and real performance. No check for an impossible or presently unavailable outcome; the parties may pursue a different feasible request with genuinely different stakes. A possible meaningful uncertainty uses SO-02. Player acting skill, accent or eloquence is not an extra numerical prerequisite; declaring a coherent approach is enough. A scene closes when its committed approach resolves and accepted terms, refusal or actual interruption are recorded. It need not wait for every future consequence to occur, and reopening it requires SO-07's actual change.

directions.title: Four degrees, three narrative possibilities

originalQuestion.title: Three narrative results and four native task degrees
originalQuestion.question: The manual asks for full success, costly success and refusal/reversal. Reviewed Core uses four fixed-DC task degrees with natural shifts and separate opposed-total ties. Decide exactly which roll procedure applies and how each actual result selects a predeclared narrative outcome. Do not import automatic natural20 obedience, extra degree benefits, hidden tie modifiers or binary-save critical rules.

directions.disposition: ADOPT proposed promised-success/costly-offer mapping; KEEP native opposed rule
directions.authoringWording:
Use a fixed-DC Core task for an attempt to obtain a declared concession where an actual resisting actor is not making a distinct opposed attempt. Use the Core four degrees from total−DC and normal natural1/20 degree shifts; mandatory failure/impossibility has no invented rolled margin. NEW ordinary DC references10 for a plausible modest concession within authority,13 for substantial reservation,16 for a difficult but genuinely negotiable concession,19 for exceptional but actually possible leverage. Actual precise source DC overrides. Do not add another routeTier/socialStanding modifier to those DCs unless its real source says so.

The exact fixed-task mapping is: Critical Success obtains the promised success on stated terms plus ONLY a predeclared genuinely available extra; Success obtains the promised success on stated terms; Failure obtains the declared refusal/failure, with a separately predeclared costly offer available only if the actual decision-maker can make it; Critical Failure obtains that failure plus ONLY the declared actual reversal/consequence, and a costly alternative only if expressly offered in that branch beforehand. No automatic mind control, compelled confession, magical truth, obedience on natural20, bonus standing or free resource arises from degree alone. A Success atDC is success; reserving the promised concession forDC+10 violates this decision.

A costly offer is a new real agreement at its specified price/condition, not a renamed successful check. The player may accept if able and willing, or decline keeping their unspent resources and the actual refusal. The failed roll remains failed. The offered performance takes its actual time; no reroll is needed merely to accept an already feasible stated bargain. Nothing binds an absent owner, authorizes crime outside an official's powers, spends somebody else's money, sets a player belief or supplies another procedure's willing-recipient predicate.

Use opposed totals only when two actual actors make genuinely opposed attempts, such as a particular deception confronted by active scrutiny. Declare each actual ability/skill beforehand. Higher total wins; a tie leaves the existing situation unchanged, with NO Core task natural degree shifts, invented tie bonuses or extra opposed 'critical' reward. An explicit card using passive Insight or a save retains that exact route instead. Do not select fixed/opposed/passive after seeing a die. Any already operative source-granted reroll uses its exact window/new-result rule and does not become a separate generic retry.

directions.title: All five Charisma skills and actual Insight

originalQuestion.title: Skills and actual information
originalQuestion.question: Preserve Persuasion/willingness, Deception/believed information, Intimidation/perceived risk and Insight/understanding, while accounting for actual Performance and Reputation skills in the Player source and20-skill foundation. Define fixed DC versus opposed checks and limits of truthful information, misunderstanding, credible threats and investigation. Insight is not a generic lie detector; identify any proposed completion as NEW.

directions.disposition: KEEP source skills; NEW approach matrix
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP the actual20-skill foundation and these distinct routes. Persuasion (CHA) changes a genuinely willing/negotiable decision on stated terms; Deception (CHA) attempts belief in the particular communicated claim, not a change to historical fact; Intimidation (CHA) changes a decision through a credible perceived risk, not automatic Frightened; Performance (CHA) obtains the predeclared audience response from actual performance, not a license/crowd-control spell; Reputation (CHA) makes a concrete appeal to genuine recognized credentials/name/social standing using its actual evidence, not an automatic saved-score bonus. Insight (WIS) seeks an obtainable inference about observed motive/hesitation/leverage, not universal truth detection, mind-reading or an inaccessible document's contents. Investigation/History and other actual skills apply to their own evidence tasks; do not call every financial or written task CHA/Reputation.

Apply one applicable proficiency or replacing expertise contribution. No numeric trade level, actor's several persuasive proficiencies, standing score or 'faction PB' is added without its actual rule. A claimed credential must really be known/credible to that recipient; an unknown/private reputation cannot improve a public appeal until its evidence arrives. A reputation skill result itself gives no automatic permanent standing event; SO-10 determines actual attributable consequences.

NEW skill/route completion: fixedDC is the default for a social concession or a bounded inference with no active opposing check; an actual lie-versus-active-scrutiny contest can be CHA/Deception versus WIS/Insight. An uncertain physical forgery examination is the actual INT/Investigation/tool task, not automatic Insight. A genuine threat can be opposed by the defender's declared social strategy if that is the announced uncertainty; it is not automatically a save or attack. A preexisting card using CHA or DEX+PB against passiveInsight, such as Thief Feint, retains that literal special procedure and its combat-only outcome; it does not become a full negotiation or duplicate PB.

Useful true information may settle a request without a roll if the actual authority/willingness make it routine. Misunderstanding must come from the real received channel/text/context; a successful translation does not automatically establish truth. Incomplete Insight can yield 'the observed evidence cannot distinguish those motives', not a fabricated diagnosis or forced player belief. A skill's Critical Success adds only predeclared supported information; spell/class knowledge features keep their actual available-knowledge and 'unknown' limits.

directions.title: Standing access is not an added die modifier

originalQuestion.title: Third reputation table and automatic modifier routing

Preserve original scores and labels.

directions.disposition: ADOPT FL-23; explicitly supersede Player modifier table
directions.authoringWording:
Apply FL-23's single standing-v1−3…+3/five-band procedure and RP-A01–06's lossless versioned interpretation. Preserve the full old Player modifier table and Loop eleven-band access table as source alternatives, but neither supplies an automatic active CHA bonus, penalty, advantage, license or institutional authority in this integrated chapter. A known+2 institution score does not supply+2 on top, and +3/Honored is not converted to+2 by display. An original companion-schema+2 and Loop-schema+2 are NOT the same source statement: first is Honored under that recognized policy; second was Favored in the old Loop. originalQuestion.title: Alignment paragraph receipt and pre-push boundary

Ordinary actually communicated goals, trust, promises, threats, beliefs or values can be genuine scene leverage without being a cosmic classification or automatic numerical bonus. Actual acquired source-specific oath/class restrictions still apply their own stated literal predicates; where that particular predicate truly depends on an undefined deep meaning, record that one unresolved use instead of interpreting it here.

The finite deferred questions are: meanings/identities of the named alignment axes; actual compatibility/opposition relationships; which source/version controls the old modifier's eventual operation; whether and how any current ordinary policy should change; and any literal deep-language/currency/faction links. directions.title: One communication clock for all participants

originalQuestion.title: Communication, participation and elapsed time
originalQuestion.question: Apply fulfilled LAX hearing/speech/signed/textual/interpretation and six-second in-encounter limits. Define one scene clock across speakers, interpreters and physically separate participants; roleplay length is not automatic fictional elapsed time. Actual language, sensory and source-specific comprehension prerequisites still apply. Silence, incapacity or a blocked channel cannot be erased by a social skill roll.

directions.disposition: KEEP fulfilled LAX in full; NEW ordinary scene-duration reference
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP LAX's actual language/mode/script knowledge, six-second aggregate free speech/signs per creature per numbered round, additional Action per additional six-second segment, actual timing of received interpretation, trained ten-minute/six-cue rehearsal and source-specific spell/class/oath channel requirements. Table accessibility or explaining intent costs no fictional Action and does not itself produce V, audible speech, a signal or violation. Fictional speech still needs its real channel and time.

NEW ordinary noncombat reference: a short request/answer with minimal exchange takes one actual minute; a negotiated concession/evidence presentation uses ten minutes; a formal complex negotiation/hearing uses its actual scheduled time (FL-19's ordinary disputed hearing two hours). Declare which before work and adjust only for a real additional exchange/delay, not a player's actual speaking speed. Full simple routine consent may be immediate within real brief communication; these durations do not replace a printed effect's Action or five exchanges. Every participant's meaningful contribution consumes actual concurrent time, not a separate ten-minute world advance per person.

An interpreter must perceive/understand the original and then deliver a form the recipient can perceive/understand. A ten-minute scene can include its serial renditions within those ten minutes only if the actual exchange fits; don't promise instantaneous full two-way translation or count an already ten-minute source speech AND its rendition in ten minutes without time for both. A3-second warning followed by3-second rendition reaches the final listener at6 seconds, not before. Multiple relays or long exchanges can need actual extra time and Actions. Late delivery cannot backdate a modifier, consent or save prerequisite; no interpreter supplies the caster's V, new fluency, mental link, unknown proper-name meaning or authenticated source truth.

Deafened does not by itself prevent speaking/V; Silenced does prevent ordinary deliberate speech and actual V/Chants/command words, not thinking or separately legal signs/mental effects. Silence the Caster's narrower reaction-component window remains narrow. Losing one overlapping prohibition does not remove others. Maintain actual own-hand/sight/line/distance/hearing requirements for cues and telepathy; an oral instruction cannot reach a closed soundproof compartment by a skill roll. Form-specific speech limits and LAX's bounded Oracle/Paladin meaning bridges remain their own exact exceptions. No class/ordinary/innate/recipe source is merged by a shared spell name.

directions.title: Actual Help and meaningful retries

originalQuestion.title: Assistance, repetition and changed leverage
originalQuestion.question: Define eligible assistance and group participation under the current Help/action rules, and whether a second attempt with unchanged facts is available. One scene should not become unlimited independent retries by rotating speakers. State what genuinely changed evidence, cost, deadline or approach makes another attempt meaningful; preserve paid resources and prior consequences.

directions.disposition: KEEP in-initiative Help; ADOPT NEW outside-initiative completion
directions.authoringWording:
In initiative KEEP actual Help Action and its actual next-regular-start expiration. A useful helper must make the concrete contribution, with required position/channel/tools/information; no social summary waives that Action or extends the expiry until a later convenient check. Multiple sources of advantage do not stack and any advantage/disadvantage cancels under Core. A feature requiring an actual hearing ally or a target in reach remains separate.

ADOPT NEW outside-initiative Help: the helper participates usefully throughout the relevant actual work interval through resolution and supplies advantage on that one check. Their time is occupied and cannot also support incompatible guard/travel/rest/research work. Require the actual language/access/knowledge/tools for that contribution, not a universal new proficiency prerequisite where Help has none. If a specific exact long task instead defines numeric trained assistants/caps, use that specific procedure rather than also this social advantage. Being present, paying a fee or holding a stronger tool alone is not Help. One helper cannot simultaneously participate fully in two negotiations in separate rooms.

One committed approach on the same actual uncertainty receives one resolution. Rotating speakers, repeating a sentence, changing recordID or asking every party member to roll does not create retries. A genuinely new offer, new authentic evidence, changed audience with real authority, newly changed deadline or meaningfully different method can create another actual uncertainty, with the change recorded and new stakes/time before the next roll. Previously refused/paid/consumed consequences remain; a new successful approach does not refund the first offer or restore hidden deleted evidence. A source-authorized reroll, such as the actual Shattered Mind Boon IV failedINT/WIS reroll, retains its cost/window/new-result rule; it is not an unlimited speaker retry or a new scene cap.

directions.title: Magic and acquired class interfaces do only their own work

originalQuestion.title: Social magic and source-specific agency
originalQuestion.question: Carry actual Charmed/Frightened limits, fulfilled spell procedures and each acquired class feature in full. Charmed alone is not obedience or consent; intimidation is not automatically Frightened. Source-specific magical control retains its own eligibility, cost, save, ending, awareness and immunity rules. Keep remaining pending spells unavailable and avoid promoting class/card comparison records. Identify exact named hook conflicts for a separate disposition.

directions.disposition: KEEP complete current procedures; no comparison promotions
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP actual Charmed: its relation to the identified charmer prevents the specified willing harm and gives that charmer the condition's social-check advantage, not obedience, attraction, surrender, consent, ownership or a truthful answer. KEEP actual Frightened's visibility-dependent check/attack disadvantage and its continuing unwilling-approach restriction; ordinary successful Intimidation applies only the predeclared concession, never that condition automatically. An effect's absence of shared-language requirement is not silently replaced by one; actual hearing/seeing/components still govern where printed.

Use only a legitimately acquired currently operative exact spell/class/oath/item effect, with its real activation,cost,range,target/save,resistance/immunity,concentration,duration,awareness and ending rule. Ordinary social resolution neither substitutes for a spell save nor recreates a payload the target resisted. An actual charm/control immunity blocks what it actually names, not all persuasion. A source that permits refusal/backlash does not become compulsory surrender through SO-02. Keep the412 reviewed/436 pending ordinary authored index and runtime-selection boundary; pending comparison spells/feats are not enabled here, and the136 standalone procedures cannot be truncated to a lossy legacy schema.

Explicit retained named interfaces: Oracle Tongues I is receptive comprehension and its actually heard interpretation bonus, not fluency; III keeps yes/no/unknown and player refusal; IV its exact meaningful-exchange duration/targets; V its bounded command/hearing/save/restrictions and success-damage branch. LAX's narrow meaning completions remain. Heaven's Decree and Sovereign's Ascendance preserve the actual target's obey-in-safest-way OR backlash choice and no confession/belief/allegiance requirement; Aura of Authority can obstruct a lie but supplies neither forced truthful speech nor translation. Tongues' overlapping-voice social−2 and Action suppression10minutes remain when their exact predicates apply. False Life's healing Insight intervention is that particular healing gate, not social suspicion or a blanket restriction on care. The later fulfilled Paladin Wave long-rest amendment stays in force, unchanged.

Mage/Wizard Arcane Insight, Cleric Divine Insight, Oracle's actual knowledge/omen/scout/condition features and mundane research reveal only their legitimately supported bounded subject. They do not authenticate ownership, fabricate a path/buyer/cure or decide deferred cosmology. An 'unknown' result remains possible. A route direction from Ranger Pathfinder's Mark is not an unobstructed route/teleport; Swift Traverse is its paid tactical Dash and cannot double daily travel. Ranger's actual quiet-footstep effect does not silence companions, gear, speech or remove all tracking. Soldier Quick Deploy supplies its source limited cover, not new transferable camp lumber/palisade. Druid forms keep own body history, actual limited movement/attacks and no permanent resource fabrication. Thief Feint/passiveInsight effects remain combat-scoped; Warrior's Intimidation modifiers apply only their actual source windows, and a penalty to 'morale' is not automatically a reduction to Pressure, a saving throw or FL-15 Escape/Pursuit checks. Tinker/class/AEX/hauler controls, one-command budgets, servicing, repair and TEX Efficient Recycling's no-enemy-cause rule remain distinct; these43 crafted devices still do not invent paid deploymentRP.

The companion comparison register includes all17 complete class-dataset references/counts/statuses and the actually relevant selected records; these are preserved comparisons, not promotion of1223 cards. No presently supplied operative hook requires a new generic social permission. An actual particular use needing a secret meaning, unprovided active spell or absent world record remains narrowly unavailable on that predicate, not a reason to restart this conference or invent another feature.

directions.title: Agreements do not manufacture authority or player consent

originalQuestion.title: NPC agreement and player table boundaries
originalQuestion.question: Preserve actual authority, non-negotiable limits and the reviewed Session Zero agreement when characters bargain, threaten or disagree. Separate fictional pressure from a player table agreement and from explicit willing-recipient requirements on effects. A social result must not manufacture a resource, bind an absent owner or override the actual consent prerequisite of another procedure.

directions.disposition: KEEP actual NPC limits and Session Zero
directions.authoringWording:
An agreement records the parties actually agreeing, their actual authority/property, deliverable, consideration, timing, communication, witness and remedies. A clerk who can grant supervised access cannot transfer their employer's ledger; a guard with a key cannot bind an absent owner to a sale unless genuinely authorized. Passing a check wins the declared feasible concession, not a new power to perform the impossible. Conditions and later actual breach are recorded as events, not retroactive failed dice.

Player table consent remains the reviewed Session Zero procedure, not a character skill contest. Do not impose a fictional punishment for pausing/skipping or communicating an accessibility/boundary need. Ordinary social play can pressure an NPC within the actual fiction, but does not assign a player's beliefs, compelled acting, willingness to a separately willing-target effect or agreement to prohibited PvP. The player can describe their character's actual response without performing a voice. Explicit source control effects still use their own actual player-agency/refusal constraints.

A conditional costly agreement needs the actual payer to accept and fund it; it is not automatically deducted on Failure. An absent person, unavailable item, forged receipt or unknown text cannot supply the missing performance. Consent to an audience or carriage is not consent to spellcasting, surgery, restraint, ownership transfer, dangerous work or disclosure of protected history. Record every actual consent/authority predicate at the time the relevant operation needs it; later agreement does not retroactively legalize a spent action or counterfeit provenance.

directions.title: Witnessed attributed consequences and standing

originalQuestion.title: Witnesses, attributed events and standing changes
originalQuestion.question: The Director changes standing after public, significant, attributable actions and distinguishes one NPC relationship from a faction. The Loop also gives scene-based numeric caps. Route numeric resolution to FL-23 and its preservation addendum; complete actual witness/evidence/event recording, timing and independent faction responses without assuming every rumor is true or globally known.

directions.disposition: KEEP Director event standard; ADOPT FL-23 signed accounting
directions.authoringWording:
A standing event needs an actual significant attributable act and a real route by which the relevant institution learns of it. Record originating event, subject actors, known witnesses/documents, what each recipient perceives, receipt time, institution's actual interests/authority and established fact versus fallible report. 'Public' means actually exposed to a relevant audience or subsequently documented to it, not omniscient notice by all44 registry categories. A privately rescued individual may alter their own relationship immediately without updating an institution that has never heard of it.

Use FL-23/RP-A06's exact proposed/applied signed scene change and source-version rules. The same deed reported five times is one underlying cause for that institution, not five+1s. Different institutions can have different real responses when their interests and evidence actually differ; a registry description/shared category name is not proof of alliance/enmity. A lie believed by a real institution can produce an actual fallible response, marked as belief/report, without overwriting the historical act. Correcting it later is another recorded evidence/response event, not silent deletion or automatically opposite arithmetic.

No successful social die automatically awards standing, a license or renown; the actual performed significant public outcome can support its declared event. Failed persuasion can still accompany a genuinely witnessed good deed, but its significance and attribution are not invented to compensate a poor roll. Cap ordinary algebraic proposed change per subject/institution/scene at±2, then the numeric scale, retaining overflow without future credit. Already earned nonnumeric title, access, debt and named privilege remains its own record with actual change/expiry terms. Delayed notification keeps its actual time and may not backdate access to an earlier purchase.

directions.title: Faction turns are paid actions, not return rewards

originalQuestion.title: Faction-turn cadence and paid world actions
originalQuestion.question: The manual gives up to three watched factions one action after each return to Haven/surface. Define the genuine event, fictional interval, eligibility, repeat-return guard and what actual resources/access an action requires. Rival actions must use actual routes/information/time. Prevent repeated boundary crossings or one actor on two fronts from generating free faction actions; distinguish a Director abstraction from simulated runtime.

directions.disposition: KEEP up to3/one action each; ADOPT NEW24-hour checkpoint and duplicate guard
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP the Director spotlight: after a genuine Expedition return, review up to three actual watched factions and one eligible action each from recruit,denounce,buy,raid,research,fortify,bargain,conceal,wait. A return closes a real declared episode with objective/outcome, including genuine abandonment or extraction. Crossing the boundary again during that same return is not another episode/action entitlement. A split team returning belongs to its actual episode/checkpoint; it doesn't create an additional whole-party return award. Actions and actors keep persistent IDs across episodes and checkpoints.

ADOPT NEW24-hour review cadence on FL-03's canonical Haven/day clock: at each completed campaign24-hour boundary, review the currently watched factions once, including a long Haven stay. This also provides a report checkpoint for their actual ongoing offscreen work while the party is absent; it never freezes the world until the party returns. Coalesce a genuine return and a due24-hour review at the same timestamp into one checkpoint. Later different genuine checkpoints are allowed, but cannot repeat a resolved action or manufacture its elapsed labor. The watch list is at most three distinct factions per checkpoint, nominated before its resolutions; swapping a fourth name mid-checkpoint does not create another action slot. A changed next watch list reveals only actual lawful history, not a retroactively staffed new faction.

An action has named responsible actors, actual starting knowledge, location/route/access, objective, committed material/coin/staff intervals, positive duration, resolution rule, success/failure consequence and completion prerequisites. A checkpoint is a review/report occasion, not free funds, an Action token transferable to the party, a24-hour time advance or automatic success. One preexisting in-progress action continues under its ID; it cannot be swapped for an instant completed action just because the party returned. If actual work completes between checkpoints its actual effects occur then, subject to the relevant process; the next report acknowledges it once, rather than backdating a new outcome at report time. Parties who directly witness the consequence need not await an administrative report to react.

NEW ordinary minimum-work references where no exact domain rule supplies one: recruit eight active staff hours seeking/interviewing one genuinely available candidate; denounce one active hour preparing/delivering one actually heard attributable statement; buy one active hour arranging/executing one actual available bill; bargain one active hour of a concrete negotiation; conceal eight active hours of an actual finite evidence/route/asset-concealment task. These are one bounded action, not unlimited recruits/goods or disappearance of true history. Research uses its actual formula/language/item/knowledge process (a generic original-evidence research question needs eight active hours and its declared knowledge task); fortify uses FL-07 actual construction; raid uses real preparation/travel/encounter/resolution, never one die to resolve an absent battle; wait records actual interval/status and does not itself create money/healing/knowledge. Exact shorter/specific source procedures still govern their particular operation and cannot be layered with a free faction outcome.

Routine uncontested feasible actions complete without invented rolls; contested/risky actions use their actual social/task/route/encounter procedure. One worker can't serve two incompatible fronts, healers can't work and rest simultaneously, and actual source resource caps remain. Independent staff can work in parallel only when genuinely assigned/supplied. A faction's advertised goals/backer are not an unlimited balance sheet or proof of secret intelligence. The next visible consequence must reach the party through an actual messenger, changed offer, rumor, guard presence or other observable event; preserve report-versus-fact and audience privacy. No ally/enemy/cosmology is inferred from a faction ID.

directions.title: Finite rival clocks and complete faction records

originalQuestion.title: Rival clocks and usable faction records
originalQuestion.question: Retain the full rival sheet and Depth4–8/Claim4/Grudge4/Collapse4–6 source clocks. Supply finite trigger, tick amount, duplicates, completion and visible-consequence rules; a tick cannot authenticate secret information or erase a real journey. Distinguish44 generic runtime standing IDs from actual named institutions/Expeditions with goals, resources and relations. Produce a source-linked scene/faction record and full ordinary worked sequence. No new world faction history or cosmological truth follows from these fields.

directions.disposition: KEEP nine fields/four clock lengths; ADOPT proposed one-event ticks
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP all nine rival-sheet source fields: public identity,backer,current depth,objective,preferred method,professed limit,need from the party,feared disclosure,current relationship. Add actual actor IDs/assets,location/route,known information and source,resources/obligations,ongoing action IDs and audience permissions. A generic standing category from the44-record module is not a fully defined rival Expedition. NEW campaign institution IDs may be bound through RP-A05 without declaring their world histories true by name.

KEEP clock lengths: Depth choose4–8 when the actual route objective starts; Claim4; Grudge4; Collapse choose4–6 when the actual crisis starts. ADOPT NEW one segment per distinct qualifying event per clock: Depth actual travel/support materially advancing the named objective; Claim genuinely obtained relevant proof/witness/legal support; Grudge an attributable humiliation/loss/betrayal/public accusation actually learned by that rival; Collapse an actual casualty,debt,internal conflict or exposure materially advancing that crisis. One event with several synonymous trigger labels is one tick, and repeated reports of the same underlying event give no extra tick. An information-dependent trigger qualifies at the first credible actual receipt, not at an unknowable hidden occurrence. One event may affect different clocks only through independently actual qualifying consequences, all linked to that same event.

Declare the finite completion consequence and real prerequisites when opening the clock. At its threshold resolve once only if those prerequisites actually exist; otherwise retain 'threshold reached / blocked by [specific actual missing prerequisite]' without teleporting, forging title, conjuring a resource or inventing another check. A Depth clock cannot skip the route; Claim cannot authenticate a false witness or replace an authorized hearing; Grudge schedules its real hostile action, not an immediate extra attack; Collapse can trigger the stated real withdrawal/fracture but not delete people/assets. If the actual objective was already genuinely completed, record that completion without demanding meaningless extra ticks.

Close a resolved objective with its events and actual consequence. A new clock needs a distinct new objective/crisis and fixed trigger/length, not resetting the old ID to farm claim/hostility/standing. A real reversal can change a current objective via an explicit event with retained history; no negative tick erases an earlier deed or refunds its resources by itself. These clocks are human-authored Director planning tools and deterministic record conventions, not proof that a companion simulates all faction behavior. Public records expose only known identity/events/consequences, not the full feared-disclosure/backer dossier. The supplied24 proposal scenarios have individual adopted/clarified dispositions in EX58_WORKED_SEQUENCES.json; the once-unadopted text remains preserved and this decision supplies the operational adoption.

directions.title: Nine real mount profiles

originalQuestion.title: Nine named mounts have partial profiles
originalQuestion.question: Keep all nine exact Player purchase prices, tactical speeds and pound-carry capacities. Complete actual size, body weight where needed, ability/AC/HP/save/action/sense/training profiles from real sources or explicitly NEW authoring. Do not reverse-engineer Strength or size from a capacity or import another game's stat block. The bounded Known Descent search found no exact mount-name paragraphs, including table paragraphs; that is not a claim about every archive.

directions.disposition: KEEP nine exact prices/Speed/carry fields; NEW complete animal templates
directions.authoringWording:
Adopt the nine separately keyed NEW provisional operational profiles in EX58_TRANSPORT_PROFILES.json: Camel; Donkey or mule; Elephant; Horse,draft; Horse,riding; Horse,war; Mastiff; Pony; Warhound. Each preserves its full original row, original null mass/status and exact printed price, walking Speed and pounds capacity. The body's new size/mass/abilities/AC/HP/Hit Dice/senses/attack/training/food/draw/Load fields are explicit game-authoring choices, not recovered monster statistics, real-world animal claims, or Strength reverse-engineered from carrying capacity. Donkey or mule identifies one chosen actual individual, not two animals.

Use the catalogue's fixed naturalAC (already including that body's Dexterity), fixed ordinary maximumHP, current actualHP and real Hit Dice. No class level, RP/RC, class feature, special immunity, darkvision or magical nature is supplied. Listed independent attacks are one Action/one attack using the actual attack bonus, reach, dice/modifier/type and normal Core attack criticals; they have no automatic knockdown, charge damage, Multiattack or mounted-rider attack grant. Saves use actual ability modifiers without new save PB; changes from Wounds/conditions are real. The NEW threat reference level is for FL-16 comparison only and is expressly not CR or class level. An effect requiring an actual source CR or other missing special predicate cannot substitute this reference number; it needs that particular predicate, not another broad transport conference.

Large templates occupy10ft squares, Medium5ft and NEW Huge15ft. The one saddle seat admits an actually compatible rider at least one size smaller. A Small rider on a Medium Pony/Mastiff/Warhound still must satisfy both physical weights and the new explicit Load cap; a Medium rider cannot ride them merely because a small weight fits. Each mount's source carry-pounds cap is a specific profile limit; its separately NEW Load cap is deliberately not recalculated from the independently authored STR. Carried saddle/gear/rider/containers/contents count, with one Burdened penalty where the actual threshold is reached. Draw capacity is its own explicit NEW harness-mode value, not more back-carry capacity.

NEW default registered Expedition mount is a significant actual creature using reviewed Core Wounds/dying/death saves. Actual registered significance is fixed before the encounter, not changed after a fatal result. A truly different source lifecycle wins: an actual bonded Ranger Beast uses its HP-only/immediate-death/no-Death-saves procedure, not this ordinary default, with original animal/remains history. No generic healing, repair, insurance, stabling payment or new template resurrects a dead individual. A healthy template describes an available type, not evidence that the merchant's actual specimen has fullHP, training, supplies or willingness.

directions.title: Riding control, training and actor caps

originalQuestion.title: Living mount control and agency
originalQuestion.question: The Player explicitly distinguishes trained controlled mounts from independent intelligent or untrained mounts. Decide how actual training, willingness and compatible anatomy establish that relation, including rider incapacity and loss of contact. The controlled Action list is Dash, Disengage, Dodge; do not silently add an attack or impose crafted-automaton binding. State any shared actor/command budgets by actual governing source. An independent creature keeps its actual agency, rather than becoming a free second player character.

directions.disposition: KEEP trained controlled versus independent; NEW finite training/command bridge
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP: a trained willing physically compatible mount may be controlled; an intelligent or untrained independent mount keeps its own agency. Independent is a behavioral/turn designation, not permission for a player to direct a third free combat character. A mount's sale, ownership, restraint or payment does not demonstrate willingness or training. An actual independent NPC who joins as a character counts in the12-character roster. A merely ridden animal is not another member seat, but its actor/action/food/cargo records remain real.

NEW riding command bridge: a conscious nonincapacitated seated rider with a usable trained audible or tactile/rein channel can direct the controlled mount's intended movement and choose its one allowed Action (Dash, Disengage or Dodge) for the linked regular-turn sequence. The actual short cue fits LAX's shared speech allowance, or the practiced reins/weight cue uses that existing trained channel; it is not a free universal language. Reins need one actually available hand; trained tactile seat/leg cues may be used only where that individual was trained for them and the current seat/movement permits. No separate Bonus Action is imposed for this ordinary riding direction. It does not issue a class companion/device command, spend/refund its allowance, enable a controlled attack or transfer the rider's class bonuses to the animal. Physical driving a carriage/ship has its own paid Actions under TR-08/09.

A controlled mount has its own regular creature turn under TR-03 and counts as one commanded independent-turn actor toward the Loop's existing limit of two controlled independent combat-capable subordinates per controller; the controller's own character is not one of those subordinates. Source-bound companions using an attached phase and no full turn retain their own shared BA/one-offensive-allowance rules and do not acquire a full turn from the mount label. Do not compress excess ordinary independent animals into a newly invented swarm: a genuine cohort stat block would be needed. Additional ordinary pack animals may be led noncombat at actual handling cost but gain no third controlled combat turn/attack; if independent, the Director resolves their genuine agency rather than taking player attack orders.

When an essential control predicate is lost before the mount acts (rider no longer seated, incapacitated, no usable cue, mount incapacitated/unwilling), its still-existing turn does not disappear or refresh. Without a valid current rider cue it defensively Dodges if able and stays still or moves only to an actually available immediately safer space, chosen by its real agency, not a free tactical attack order. A cue already executed is not undone; an issued but unexecuted ordinary riding cue is rechecked at execution and cannot compel an animal whose current control relation ended. This differs explicitly from the protected already-issued attached companion command, whose owner becoming incapacitated alone need not cancel it. A standing trained noncombat lead/follow cue outside danger may continue when its actual conditions and handler remain available; no unattended mount program or unlimited work follows.

NEW training completion: for a genuinely tame/willing ordinary specimen, basic riding or harness training is one40-active-hour course for that named function; each actual animal can credit at most four training hours/day, and trainer time counts as work. Instructor requires actual Animal Handling proficiency, suitable safe space, properly fitting tack and a usable conditioning method. Credit15-minute completed phases; interruption loses only unfinished phase credit, not actual time/feed/cost. The NEW full-course instruction reference is5gp, actual tuition/voluntary arrangements may differ; feed/water/tack/stabling are real separate provisions unless included in a documented offer. Completion is deterministic after the actual course and demonstrated safe routine behavior, not a magical obedience check; it grants only that practiced ordinary function. Previously genuinely documented training needs no retroactive course. 'Wild' or unwilling is not trained by depositing40 hours: acquiring/taming it requires its actual source/scene and genuine behavior first. War-named sale may include verified combat habituation in its actual contract; the name alone doesn't. These courses grant no attack/skill/class proficiency to the rider and no general Ranger bond authorization.

directions.title: One whole regular turn for a controlled mount

originalQuestion.title: Shared initiative and regular turn order
originalQuestion.question: Complete 'shares your initiative' with a precise controlled-mount phase, whole-turn order, movement splitting and regular start/end markers. Preserve existing effect clocks, Reaction refreshes, full-Action ceilings and spent movement. Mounting, dismounting, changing control or initiative, and extra rider turns cannot mint new mount turns or refresh existing resources. Decide mid-round entry and a mount whose regular turn already occurred.

directions.disposition: KEEP shared initiative; NEW order/entry accounting
directions.authoringWording:
NEW exact shared-initiative binding: at initiative registration, a controlled mount shares the rider's initiative value but takes one complete regular creature turn immediately AFTER that rider's complete regular turn. They do not interleave movement/Actions; the rider cannot ride20ft, pause the mount's turn to attack on an invented extra rider segment, then finish it. The rider can Ready an actually permitted Action, paying its Action and later Reaction, with its real trigger/duration/components; this does not grant a free mounted attack. An independent mount keeps its own initiative and actual choices.

The mount has its own current regular-start and regular-end markers, conditions, movement and one normal Action, subject to its controlled Dash/Disengage/Dodge list. It has an ordinary Reaction budget but, while controlled, no autonomous offensive Reaction or opportunity attack is supplied; a real specific defensive Reaction could operate only if its source permits. It rolls its own Core death saves when appropriate. Each regular start refreshes only its own allowed budgets and ticks its own counters. No rider extra turn creates another mount turn/start/recharge; no attached companion phase becomes a mount regular turn by renaming it.

NEW control/initiative transfer: each physical actor receives at most one scheduled regular turn per numbered round and keeps existing spent budgets/condition deadlines through mounting, dismounting or changing controllers. In-round changes do not move an already allocated or taken slot. A new valid controlled relation adopts the new rider's linked position beginning next numbered round; this round use the still-unspent original slot if any. A mount first admitted mid-round gets an eligible not-yet-passed insertion only under current combat entry rules, otherwise begins next round; never replay the new rider's passed slot. Dismounting to 'independent' does not obtain another turn. Record regularTurnId/round, original slot, prospective next slot, control history and spent move/Action/Reaction for that same animal.

At start/end apply the actual Core condition/death/ongoing/expiry order, not an added vehicle tick. A rider or mount effect expiring at a particular owner's marker follows that marker through the link; identical initiative does not merge the two creatures' clocks. Travel outside initiative accrues actual movement and work continuously without combat rewards/ticks duplicated at reentry. When multiple physical pullers drive one vehicle, TR-08's coordinated movement reservation is the specific NEW exception for its one linked vehicle event, not a general ability to split a ridden mount's turn.

directions.title: Mount, dismount and stay seated

originalQuestion.title: Mounting, dismounting and losing the seat
originalQuestion.question: Preserve half-Speed cost and the printed DC10 Dexterity save when a mount is moved against its will or knocked Prone. Complete reach, remaining movement, Speed0, fitting destination, frequency, prone rider, forced dismount and trigger identity. Distinguish the mount becoming Prone, actual falling and the rider becoming Prone; apply current Core saves and fixed falling procedures without inventing generic natural shifts or repeated saves for one event.

directions.disposition: KEEP half-Speed and DC10 DEX; NEW geometry/trigger completion
directions.authoringWording:
KEEP mounting or voluntarily dismounting costs half the rider's current walking Speed, rounded down in feet, from that rider's actually remaining regular movement budget. NEW: at most one mount OR dismount operation per regular turn; an extra turn does not grant another through this bridge. Rider Speed0, an unavailable required hand, incompatible body/seat, inaccessible destination or insufficient remaining movement prevents that ordinary operation; zero/odd Speed does not create a free mount. A positive Speed whose half rounds below1 costs1ft for this operation. This is ordinary movement cost, not a Bonus Action or the object's free interaction; specific independently operative features can override only their actual clause.

Begin within5ft of the actual accessible saddle/seat at a reachable height, with a stable legal approach, one usable supporting hand and an actual fitting destination. A high Elephant seat may need real steps/help or another legal movement route; an 'exotic saddle' does not lift the rider. A Prone rider first stands through its real movement cost, or needs actual assistance/another procedure; the mount operation alone does not remove Prone. The selected saddle cell/location and real supporting surface are recorded. Dismount to a visible actually free adjacent space within5ft of the relevant body boundary at a reachable level; cannot choose through a wall, onto another creature, inside an inadequate gap or across an unpaid fall. The mount retains its current movement/action/state, with no refill.

KEEP one DC10 Dexterity SAVE when the mount is actually moved against its will OR knocked Prone by one resolved source event while the rider is seated. It is a Core binary save: no natural1/20 shifts unless an actual specific rider grants them. The same event satisfying both descriptions triggers one save, not two. Several genuinely distinct events may each trigger their own save; current immunity/source restrictions apply. No save is created merely by voluntary ordinary mount travel, a harmless template rename, or by the rider's own Prone condition.

On a failed seat save the rider leaves the seat and lands Prone in the first legal adjacent space in its preregistered dismount preference or the Director's neutral accessible order. Resolve any actual height/fall under current falling rules; do not add an invented fixed damage packet just for unseating. On success retain the seat/control only if physical support remains possible. If the mount is Prone, a successful rider remains supported on the actual body but gains no immunity to its awkward seat, blocked movement or required later dismount; the rider does not automatically become Prone solely because the mount did. An impossible destination/support must be resolved as actual fall/entrapment, never occupancy of a wall. If the rider is independently made Prone, apply that condition without inventing a second DEX save; usable seat/control requires actual compatibility and TR-02. If a source physically ejects the rider irrespective of a save, use that source and the real landing instead of treating this ordinary seat save as a universal defense.
directions.scope: Source direction for subsequent exact candidate, not card/runtime/world approval

directions.title: Mounted geometry and opportunity attacks

originalQuestion.title: Opportunity attacks and mounted geometry
originalQuestion.question: The Player permits an opportunity attack provoked by a mount to target rider or mount. Reconcile actual sight, reach, line, legal targeting, Disengage, forced movement, teleport and one Reaction before attack resolution. Define rider position/footprint and area targeting without treating rider and mount as one creature, unlimited cover or a free extra attack.

directions.disposition: KEEP printed rider-or-mount target choice; NEW bounded seat footprint
directions.authoringWording:
NEW ordinary mounted geometry: the mount occupies its own declared space. Record one saddle/seat point or fitting5ft subspace on that physical body before movement; a rider's attacks, interaction reach, line and area exposure originate from its actual seat, not every edge of an Elephant's15ft footprint. Shifting to a different accessible position on the mount requires the rider's actual movement/path/support; it is not a free change of targeting origin. They remain two creatures with separate AC/HP/conditions/attunements/resources. An area can affect both if it actually includes each; roll separate saves and apply separate damage histories. Neither gains automatic cover, a sharedHP shield or a new immunity by riding. Ordinary actual cover from a barrier/body is adjudicated from its real geometry, never presumed whole-mount cover.

KEEP the Player's specific exception: when the mount's own actual voluntary movement provokes a legal opportunity attack, the reactor may select mount OR rider as the target. There must be actual visibility and a legal reach/line to that chosen target at the departure edge. Spend the reactor's one available Reaction and make one ordinary permitted attack before completing that departure step. The choice is not one attack on each, and selecting the rider does not extend a weapon's reach to an unreachable seat. One source movement provoking both labels is one opportunity, not two. The target uses its own actual AC/defenses and any genuinely legal defensive reaction; an attack against the mount does not automatically hit the rider or unseat them unless its actual consequence moves/prones the mount or another effect says so.

The mount's valid Disengage protects against opportunity attacks provoked by its movement and therefore removes this mounted target-choice opportunity for that move. The rider's own Disengage protects the rider's own voluntary movement; it does not give the mount Disengage or erase its provocation. Rider-only movement around/dismounting from the seat uses the rider's actual OA predicates. Forced displacement or teleportation of the mount does not provoke a generic movement OA; it may still trigger TR-04's actual unseating test or another exact source effect. No new OA follows merely from turning initiative into travel. Vehicle carriage is not a living-mount provocation: passive vehicle displacement of occupants gives no generic OA absent an actual source; actual moving pullers may provoke for themselves, not provide a melee attack against a distant enclosed passenger through this mounted exception.

directions.title: Pending mounted feats and motion hooks

originalQuestion.title: Mounted feats and motion-triggered class hooks
originalQuestion.question: Cavalry and Mounted Combatant remain the two exact pending source feat records; they are not granted by the general riding rules. The 17 full class datasets contain no literal mount/vehicle terms under the recorded search, but motion, distance, leap and owner-turn hooks can still interact. Explicitly distinguish moving in a mount's custody from spending the rider's own movement, a leap, forced displacement and movement by another actor. Preserve actual Dragoon Momentum and all source-specific restrictions; no comparison record is promoted.

directions.disposition: KEEP pending status and exact hooks; NEW explicit transport-movement interpretation
sourceReferences: DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/classes/dragoon.md: class engine and protected Weave interface
directions.authoringWording:
Preserve the complete pending Cavalry and Mounted Combatant source records, prerequisites and current statuses; no general riding paragraph grants their advantages or+10 mount Speed. Cavalry's Animal Handling prerequisite, own listed attack scope and mount-Speed clause remain pending comparison; Mounted Combatant's different unmounted-smaller-target melee scope remains distinct. A shared mounted name neither merges them nor establishes stacking or approval. The exact candidate must show their comparison dispositions, not silently add either effect to these29 profiles.

Every movement event records mover, carrier, displacement path/distance, initiating actor, whether self-powered, forced or teleport, whose actual movement budget paid it, whose current regular turn contains it and which body occupied each endpoint. Riding/passenger displacement is real movement of the passenger's position, but is not automatically spending their own movement, a leap, flight, charge, weapon hit or an independent class activation. Do not apply a broad string match to1223 class cards. An exact positional/aura/line/distance test still reads actual positions; effects requiring self-powered movement/own movement budget/own regular turn/paid leap retain those separate predicates.

KEEP Dragoon Momentum: genuine self-powered15ft toward a tactical destination on the actual regular turn gives its one movement gain; a qualifying personal weapon-damage event gives its other default gain; all gains/refunds remain capped2/round. Carried motion, forced displacement, teleport, moving in place, allies/summons and another actor's hit do not satisfy that engine. A mount's leap is not the Dragoon's paid leap technique.
